name: Made on-site visits to two primary schools in Siming District and attended a parent open day.
description: On Sunday, January 19, Song Yajing and her husband Chen Zhiqiang went to Siming District Experimental Primary School and the Primary School Affiliated with the Foreign Language School for on-site visits. They attended the parent open days at both schools to learn about the campus environment, teaching staff, and curriculum. She recorded the admission policies and previous years' advancement rates in detail and talked with current parents, gaining a direct sense of the competitive pressure of school choice. After returning home, the couple initially shortlisted one or two target schools based on their daughter's personality and the family's actual circumstances.

subevent.name: Attended the Parents' Open Day at Siming District Experimental Primary School
subevent.description: In the morning, Song Yajing and her husband Chen Zhiqiang went to Siming District Experimental Primary School to attend the Parent Open Day. They toured the campus environment, classrooms, and activity facilities, sat in on a demonstration teaching class, exchanged school-choice experiences with current parents, and recorded information such as admission policies and previous years' advancement rates.
subevent.location: Xiamen - Siming District Experimental Primary School

subevent.name: Attend the Parents' Open Day at the Foreign Language Affiliated Primary School
subevent.description: In the afternoon, Song Yajing and her husband Chen Zhiqiang went to the Foreign Language School Affiliated Primary School to attend its parent open day. They learned about the school's bilingual curriculum features, teaching staff, and extracurricular activity arrangements, and talked with other parents, giving them an intuitive sense of the competitive pressure of school choice.
subevent.location: Xiamen - Foreign Language School Affiliated Primary School

subevent.name: Returning home to discuss preliminary school-selection preferences
subevent.description: In the evening, Song Yajing and her husband Chen Zhiqiang sorted through the school-choice information they had recorded during the day. Taking into consideration their daughter Chen Lexuan's personality and academic performance, they analyzed the pros and cons of the two schools, preliminarily shortlisted 1-2 target schools, and planned to learn more later.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - living room at home

name: Parent-child reading and craft time
description: On the evening of Wednesday, January 8, after her daughter Xuanxuan finished her kindergarten homework, Song Yajing and her daughter read the newly bought picture book "Reunion" together and made a simple lantern with craft paper, planning to hang it in the shop as decoration for the Spring Festival. During this time, Song Yajing taught her daughter a Hokkien nursery rhyme, and the two shared a warm mother-daughter moment.

subevent.name: Preparing materials for parent-child activities
subevent.description: After her daughter Xuanxuan finished her kindergarten homework, Song Yajing took out the newly bought picture book "Reunion" and materials such as craft paper and scissors from the study, and set up an activity area on the living room coffee table.
subevent.location: Siming District, Xiamen - living room at home

subevent.name: Read the picture book 'Reunion' together
subevent.description: Song Yajing and her daughter Xuanxuan sat side by side on the sofa, reading the picture book Reunion together. As they read, she explained the story and guided her daughter to observe details in the illustrations, engaging in interactive parent-child reading.
subevent.location: Siming District, Xiamen - living room at home

subevent.name: Making simple lanterns.
subevent.description: After reading the picture books, Song Yajing and her daughter made a simple lantern using colored craft paper, scissors, and glue, intending to hang it in the store as decoration for the Spring Festival. During the process, Song Yajing was in charge of cutting, while Xuanxuan did the pasting and drawing.
subevent.location: Siming District, Xiamen - living room at home

subevent.name: Teaching Minnan nursery rhymes.
subevent.description: While making the lantern, Song Yajing taught her daughter Xuanxuan to hum a Hokkien nursery rhyme she had learned as a child. The mother and daughter clapped their hands and sang along together. Xuanxuan quickly picked up the simple melody, and the atmosphere was relaxed and joyful.
subevent.location: Siming District, Xiamen - living room at home

subevent.name: Organizing event supplies
subevent.description: After the parent-child activity, Song Yajing and her daughter cleaned up the remaining craft materials together, put away the picture books and tools, and placed the finished lanterns in a drying area, ready to take to the store the next day.
subevent.location: Siming District, Xiamen - living room at home

name: Attend Sunday Mass and talk with fellow parishioners.
description: Sunday, January 5, Song Yajing took her daughter Xuanxuan to Siming Catholic Church for Sunday Mass, praying for the store's transformation and peace. After Mass, she briefly chatted with fellow parishioners including Lin Xiuying. Aunt Lin asked about her recent situation and offered encouragement, which brought her some comfort.

subevent.name: Pre-departure preparations and heading to the church
subevent.description: In the morning, Song Yajing prepared the going-out items for her daughter Chen Lexuan and herself. After locking the store, they took the bus or walked together to Siming Catholic Church to attend Sunday Mass.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Siming District - at home and on the way to church

subevent.name: Attended Sunday Mass and prayed.
subevent.description: Song Yajing took her daughter to participate in Sunday Mass at Siming Catholic Church. During the Mass, she devoutly prayed for the store's transformation and peace.
subevent.location: Xiamen – Siming Catholic Church

subevent.name: After Mass, chatted with fellow parishioner Lin Xiuying
subevent.description: After Mass ended, Song Yajing had a brief conversation with fellow churchgoer Lin Xiuying outside the church. Aunt Lin asked about her recent situation and offered encouragement, which gave her some comfort.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Siming Catholic Church Square

subevent.name: Return home.
subevent.description: After saying goodbye to the parishioners, Song Yajing walked or took a ride home with her daughter Chen Lexuan to their home on Hubin South Road, ending the morning's church activities.
subevent.location: Home on Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City

name: Received Zheng Kai's samples and displayed them in the community to collect feedback.
description: On January 13, Song Yajing contacted Zheng Kai in advance to confirm the shipping of designer samples. On January 14, she received the samples at the store, immediately took photos and edited them, then posted them in the 'Yajing Lifestyle Store' community and collected feedback. Several regular customers expressed interest in purchasing. She then organized the feedback and replied to customers.

subevent.name: Contacted Zheng Kai in advance to confirm sample shipment.
subevent.description: Song Yajing contacted Zheng Kai via WeChat to confirm the styles and logistics information of the designer samples to be shipped, and informed him that the receiving address was the store.
subevent.location: Xiamen City, Siming District - Boutique Clothing Store

subevent.name: Received the samples, photographed them, and retouched the images.
subevent.description: At the store, Song Yajing received several designer samples sent by Zheng Kai. After carefully unpacking and inspecting them, she used her phone to take photos from multiple angles and used photo-editing software to beautify the images.
subevent.location: Xiamen City, Siming District - Boutique Clothing Store

subevent.name: Posted sample information in the community group and collected feedback.
subevent.description: Song Yajing posted photos and descriptions of the repaired samples to the “Yajing Lifestyle Studio” WeChat community, asking group members about their preferences and purchase intentions. Several regular customers responded enthusiastically.
subevent.location: Xiamen City, Siming District - Boutique Clothing Store

subevent.name: Organize community feedback and reply to customers.
subevent.description: Based on feedback in the community, Song Yajing compiled a list of customers interested in purchasing and their specific style needs, and privately replied to individual customers' inquiries.
subevent.location: Xiamen City, Siming District - Boutique Clothing Store

name: Pre-Spring Festival promotional activity
description: To seize the last business day before the Spring Festival, Song Yajing prepared promotional materials in advance on January 23 and promoted them online. On January 24, she launched a 'spend 500 yuan and get a free drink of your choice' promotion at the store, served customers enthusiastically, successfully increased the day's revenue, and cleared out inventory. After the event, she summarized the results.

subevent.name: Promotional event supplies preparation
subevent.description: Prepare in advance the tea bags, paper cups, fruit tea ingredients, etc. needed for the promotional free drinks, and print the promotional posters and coupons.
subevent.location: Xiamen City, Siming District - No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

subevent.name: Online publicity for the promotional event
subevent.description: Send promotional activity information via WeChat Moments and customer groups, telling regular customers that on the last business day before the Spring Festival, there is a promotion where spending 500 yuan earns a free drink of your choice.
subevent.location: Siming District, Xiamen - home or in the store

subevent.name: On-site execution of the promotional event
subevent.description: From opening in the morning to closing at night, she warmly received customers in the shop, introduced the promotion offering one free drink of choice for purchases over 500 yuan, guided them through trying on and buying, handled checkout and complimentary drink redemption, successfully attracted a large number of customers, and daily sales hit a new high in nearly three months.
subevent.location: Xiamen City, Siming District - No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

subevent.name: Promotional activity wrap-up summary.
subevent.description: After closing, she tallied the day's revenue, counted the remaining inventory and free-drink materials, recorded the event results, and organized customer feedback to provide a reference for future events.
subevent.location: Xiamen City, Siming District - No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: On New Year's Day, discovering a drop in revenue, she started learning about online transformation
description: On January 1, 2025, Song Yajing found that the store's revenue had been declining by 15% over the past three months. After a serious discussion with her husband Chen Zhiqiang, she decided to launch an online transformation. Over the following days, the two jointly made a learning plan. Chen Zhiqiang collected tutorials on short videos and social e-commerce, and on January 4, Song Yajing started watching basic instructional videos, officially taking the first step in online learning.

subevent.name: Checked the transaction records and found a decline for three consecutive months.
subevent.description: On the morning of New Year's Day, Song Yajing carefully went through the sorted transaction statements in her home study, and found that the store's revenue had declined about 15% for three consecutive months since October 2024, leaving her feeling anxious and uneasy.
subevent.location: Home study, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Had a serious discussion with her husband about family finances and the store's difficulties.
subevent.description: In the afternoon, Song Yajing told her husband Chen Zhiqiang about the declining figures. The two had a serious conversation in the living room about the family's financial situation and the shop's operating pressure. They analyzed the causes together and had an initial discussion on the necessity of transitioning online.
subevent.location: Home living room, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City

subevent.name: Decided to start the online transition and accept her husband's offer of assistance
subevent.description: That evening, the couple reached a consensus: to officially launch the online transformation strategy. Song Yajing expressed her unfamiliarity with and fear of short videos and social e-commerce. Chen Zhiqiang took the initiative to promise that he would use his free time after work to help her learn the relevant skills, while keeping investment costs under control to protect family life.
subevent.location: Bedroom at home, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Jointly formulated an initial online learning plan
subevent.description: On the second day after New Year's Day, Song Yajing and Chen Zhiqiang used breakfast time to discuss and draft an online transition learning plan, including learning resources, division of responsibilities (Chen Zhiqiang in charge of technical research, Song Yajing in charge of content creation), and daily/weekly time investment.
subevent.location: Home dining room, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Chen Zhiqiang gathered tutorials on short-video and social media operations
subevent.description: Chen Zhiqiang used his spare time after work to search and filter several free tutorial resources on short video production and Douyin/Xiaohongshu operations on his computer, organized them into a list, and shared it with Song Yajing.
subevent.location: Home study, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Start watching the online short-video basics tutorial.
subevent.description: In the afternoon when foot traffic in the shop was light, Song Yajing opened the first short-video shooting basics course video recommended by her husband in the shop's rest area, took notes carefully, and took the first step in online learning.
subevent.location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen (boutique clothing store)

name: Chinese New Year gathering with close girlfriends
description: On January 31, the third day of Chinese New Year, Song Yajing met up with her close friends Li Meiling and Wang Jia, who had returned to Quanzhou for the holiday. The three went shopping and had afternoon tea in the city center, sharing updates on their lives. Wang Jia gave several optimization suggestions for Yajing’s community pre-sale campaign and recommended simple data analysis tools, which gave Song Yajing new ideas for further attempts after the new year.

subevent.name: Shopping with my best friend on Zhongshan Road in Quanzhou
subevent.description: Song Yajing, Li Meiling, and Wang Jia met up on the iconic Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street in downtown Quanzhou. The three of them strolled while chatting, shopped for local specialty souvenirs and fashionable clothes, and shared updates on their lives and amusing stories.
subevent.location: Quanzhou City - Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

subevent.name: Afternoon tea and community operations suggestions
subevent.description: After shopping, the three of them had afternoon tea at a nearby boutique coffee shop, tasting tiramisu cake and fruit tea. Wang Jia gave optimization suggestions for Song Yajing's store's community pre-sale plan and recommended a simple data analysis tool. Song Yajing took careful notes and said she would try it after the New Year.
subevent.location: A boutique coffee shop in Licheng District, Quanzhou

name: Monthly financial settlement and bank consultation
description: On Friday, February 28, Song Yajing reviewed the full February accounts at the shop: revenue had rebounded thanks to spring clothing new arrivals and community promotions, but after deducting the coffee machine amortization and daily expenses, she still barely broke even, and the working capital warning line had not been lifted. She called Lin Xiaofeng, an account manager at Industrial and Commercial Bank of China, to ask about the possibility of an unsecured micro-business operating loan. Manager Lin suggested that she organize her bank statements and purchase receipts from the past six months and come for an interview assessment early next month. Song Yajing told her husband about the consultation, and Chen Zhiqiang said he would accompany her, emphasizing once again the importance of sound finances.

subevent.name: Reconcile the shop's accounts for February.
subevent.description: In the store, Song Yajing used the computer and ledgers to reconcile the complete accounts for February, calculating revenue, cost expenditures (including the coffee machine amortization), and profit. She found that she barely broke even, but cash flow was tight.
subevent.location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, Shop No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street - boutique clothing store

subevent.name: Call the bank to inquire about a business loan.
subevent.description: Song Yajing called Lin Xiaofeng, a customer manager at ICBC, from the shop to ask about the possibility of an unsecured micro-business loan. Manager Lin suggested she organize the bank statements and purchase receipts from the past six months and come in early next month for an interview and assessment.
subevent.location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, Shop No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street - boutique clothing store

subevent.name: Discussed the financial consulting situation with her husband
subevent.description: After returning home in the evening, Song Yajing told her husband Chen Zhiqiang about the bank consultation she had during the day. Chen Zhiqiang said he would accompany her to the bank for the interview and once again emphasized the importance of sound financial management.
subevent.location: Home - No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Closing the shop to prepare Chinese New Year goods, make desserts, and give them away
description: On the morning of January 25, after finishing up at the store, she officially closed and started the holiday. In the afternoon, she went to the supermarket to buy New Year goods to bring back to Quanzhou. In the evening, she made tiramisu and cookies at home. On January 26, she took the New Year goods and desserts back to Quanzhou to give to elders and relatives.

subevent.name: Closing up the store.
subevent.description: In the morning, went to the shop for final tidying and cleaning, then officially shut down for the holiday, ending business before the Spring Festival.
subevent.location: Xiamen City, Siming District - No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

subevent.name: Buy Chinese New Year goods.
subevent.description: In the afternoon, went to a large supermarket to buy New Year goods to bring back to Quanzhou, including food and gifts, in preparation for visiting relatives during the Spring Festival.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Large supermarket (e.g., Walmart)

subevent.name: Make tiramisu and cookies.
subevent.description: In the evening, carefully made tiramisu and cookies at home, planning to give them to elders and relatives in Quanzhou, enjoying the peaceful time of baking.
subevent.location: Siming District, Xiamen - home kitchen

subevent.name: Distributing New Year goods and desserts
subevent.description: Returned to Quanzhou carrying purchased New Year goods and homemade desserts, and visited elders and relatives including father Song Minghui and mother Lin Xiuying, offering Spring Festival greetings.
subevent.location: Licheng District, Quanzhou - 45 Xinhua North Road, and relatives' homes

name: First online pre-sale attempt
description: From January 16 to 18, Song Yajing tried an online pre-sale campaign for the first time. On the 16th, she designed promotional materials and contacted supplier Zheng Kai to confirm the inventory of designer samples, then posted a teaser in the customer group. On the 17th, she officially launched the pre-sale, offering two discounted sample items, received 5 orders that day, and communicated with each one to confirm. On the 18th, she organized the orders, purchased from Zheng Kai, arranged for shop assistant Xiaomei to help pack and ship, and thanked everyone in the group.

subevent.name: Prepare promotional materials for pre-sale
subevent.description: Song Yajing designed promotional images and wrote copy for the first online pre-sale, and contacted supplier Zheng Kai to confirm the inventory and price details of the two designer samples.
subevent.location: Xiamen City, Siming District - Boutique Clothing Store

subevent.name: Post a pre-sale preview in the community.
subevent.description: Song Yajing posted a pre-sale preview in the store's customer WeChat group, briefly introducing the features and discounts of two designer samples to attract group members' attention.
subevent.location: Xiamen City, Siming District - Boutique Clothing Store

subevent.name: Officially launched online presales.
subevent.description: Song Yajing officially posted the pre-sale link and details in the community group, launched her first online pre-sale, accepted customer reservations, and replied to inquiries in real time.
subevent.location: Xiamen City, Siming District - Boutique Clothing Store

subevent.name: Handle pre-sale orders and customer communication
subevent.description: After receiving 5 pre-sale orders that day, Song Yajing recorded each customer's information, style, and size, and sent private messages to confirm order details and answer customer questions.
subevent.location: Xiamen City, Siming District - Boutique Clothing Store

subevent.name: Pre-sale follow-up confirmation and shipping arrangements
subevent.description: Song Yajing sorted the order list, placed formal purchase requests with supplier Zheng Kai, arranged for Xiaomei to help with packing and shipping, and thanked participating customers in the community group.
subevent.location: Xiamen City, Siming District - Boutique Clothing Store

name: Customer feedback on the beverage corner and preliminary decisions
description: On Thursday, February 13, Song Yajing tallied feedback from more than a week of free samples at the drink corner: most regular customers liked it, but it wasn't very effective at attracting new customers, and the daily coffee bean cost was about 30 yuan. After discussing with Xiaomei, she decided to keep offering it free but switch to limited quantities, and posted in the WeChat group: [Free pour-over coffee with store visit], trying to use the drink service as a customer hook without charging for now.

subevent.name: Compile feedback and costs from the drinks corner tasting
subevent.description: Song Yajing sorted through the free tasting records from the past week or more in the shop, reviewed customers' verbal feedback and online reviews, calculated the daily coffee bean cost at about 30 yuan, and evaluated the effect of drawing in customers.
subevent.location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Discussing beverage options with store assistant Xiaomei.
subevent.description: Song Yajing and store clerk Xiaomei discussed the tasting feedback data in the store, analyzed the problem that regular customers liked it but it was mediocre at attracting new customers, and discussed how to adjust.
subevent.location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Decision: Continue to offer it for free, but limit the quantity.
subevent.description: Based on the discussion with Xiaomei, Song Yajing decided to keep the free hand-drip coffee service, but limit it by time and quantity to control costs, and not charge for it for now, using it as a customer-attraction hook.
subevent.location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Post activity announcement in the WeChat group
subevent.description: Song Yajing edited and posted a preview message in the store's customer WeChat group: "Free pour-over coffee for in-store visits," notifying regular customers of this benefit in order to attract foot traffic.
subevent.location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen

name: Beverage corner trial operation
description: On January 22, after preparing the ingredients and equipment at the drink corner in the shop, Song Yajing made lattes and Americanos and offered them to customers for free tasting. She interacted with customers and collected feedback; after business hours that day, she did the cleanup and closing. On January 23, she and the shop assistant Xiaomei evaluated the trial operation results and planned next steps. Customer feedback was positive, and some regulars suggested officially launching the drink service, which made her full of anticipation for the future.

subevent.name: Prepare ingredients and equipment for the drink station
subevent.description: To ensure the smooth trial operation of the drink corner, Song Yajing purchased coffee beans, milk, syrup and other ingredients in advance, checked and adjusted the coffee machine, grinder and other equipment, and set out tasting cups and promotional signs.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Boutique Clothing Store, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District.

subevent.name: Make and provide the first batch of coffee for free
subevent.description: After the store opened for business on January 22, Song Yajing used the coffee machine at the in-store drink corner to make lattes and Americanos, poured them into sample cups, and proactively recommended them to customers, offering free tastings.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Boutique Clothing Store, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District.

subevent.name: Interact with customers and collect feedback.
subevent.description: While providing free coffee, Song Yajing talked with customers about their taste impressions of the drinks and their experience pairing them with clothing, carefully recording customers' suggestions for improvement and whether they wanted it officially launched, paying particular attention to regular customers' feedback.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Boutique Clothing Store, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District.

subevent.name: Wrap-up and tidying of the beverage corner's trial operation.
subevent.description: After the day's business ended, Song Yajing cleaned the coffee machine and other equipment, organized the remaining ingredients, calculated the consumption from the tasting, and summarized the collected customer feedback.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Boutique Clothing Store, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District.

subevent.name: Evaluate the trial operation results and plan next steps
subevent.description: Based on customer feedback and business data from the trial run day, Song Yajing and staff member Xiaomei discussed and analyzed the feasibility of the beverage corner, decided whether to adjust the recipes or service process, and began to formulate a plan for officially launching the beverage service.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Boutique Clothing Store, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District.

name: Renew the family comprehensive insurance
description: On January 16, Song Yajing received a renewal notice. After discussing with her husband Chen Zhiqiang, she decided to renew the policy and paid a one-time premium of 5,800 yuan through the bank app. On January 17, she received the electronic policy, confirmed the coverage was in effect, and filed it away.

subevent.name: Receiving the insurance renewal notice
subevent.description: Song Yajing received a renewal notice for the family comprehensive insurance sent by the insurance company at home, and reviewed the premium amount and coverage details.
subevent.location: Siming District, Xiamen - Home

subevent.name: Discussing the insurance renewal decision with her husband
subevent.description: Song Yajing and her husband Chen Zhiqiang discussed whether to renew the family comprehensive insurance in the living room at home. They jointly decided to renew it and confirmed the payment method.
subevent.location: Siming District, Xiamen - living room at home

subevent.name: Completed the one-time payment of the insurance renewal fee.
subevent.description: Song Yajing used the family savings card to pay the renewal fee of 5,800 yuan in one lump sum through the bank app.
subevent.location: Siming District, Xiamen - Home

subevent.name: Confirm the policy is in effect and file it for safekeeping.
subevent.description: Song Yajing received the electronic insurance policy from the insurance company, confirmed that the policy had been successfully renewed and would cover through the next year, and saved the file on her phone and computer.
subevent.location: Siming District, Xiamen City - home study

name: Organizing winter clothes and sharing with the community
description: From January 2 to 3, 2025, Song Yajing used her free time during the holiday to systematically organize the family's winter clothing. She packed the children's clothes her daughter had outgrown and the outdated clothes not worn in the past two years, and scheduled a recycling pickup through an online platform. On the morning of January 3, she shared clothing storage tips in the "Yajing Life Studio" community, which unexpectedly sparked a discussion on upcycling old clothes among the moms in the group. In the afternoon, the recycler came to pick up the clothes, completing the recycling process.

subevent.name: Empty out and sort winter clothes
subevent.description: On the morning of January 2, 2025, Song Yajing took all the family’s winter clothes out of the wardrobes at home and sorted them by adult, child, and frequency of wear, in preparation for later organizing and packing.
subevent.location: Siming District, Xiamen - bedroom at home

subevent.name: Selecting and packing unused clothes.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of January 2, 2025, Song Yajing picked out children's clothes that her daughter had outgrown and outdated clothes that had not been worn in the past two years from the sorted clothing, packed them all in storage bags, and prepared them for old-clothing recycling.
subevent.location: Siming District, Xiamen - living room at home

subevent.name: Online booking for old clothing recycling
subevent.description: On the evening of January 2, 2025, Song Yajing used a used-clothing recycling platform on her phone, filled in the pickup address, scheduled the door-to-door pickup time, and submitted the order, preparing to send out the packaged unused clothes.
subevent.location: Siming District, Xiamen City - home study

subevent.name: Community sharing of organizing tips and upcycling discussion.
subevent.description: On the morning of January 3, 2025, Song Yajing shared her methods and tips for storing and sorting her family's clothes in the WeChat group "Yajing Life Studio," and showed photos of packed clothes, which unexpectedly sparked a lively discussion among the moms in the group about upcycling old items.
subevent.location: Siming District, Xiamen - Home

subevent.name: The recycling collector came to the door to pick up the clothes.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of January 3, 2025, according to the scheduled appointment, staff from the used clothing recycling platform came to Song Yajing's home, took away the packed unwanted clothes, and completed the recycling process.
subevent.location: Siming District, Xiamen - front door of home

name: Purchasing a coffee machine and setting up a drink corner
description: On January 20, Song Yajing discussed with her husband the plan to add a drink corner in the shop, and they reached an agreement on the budget and model of the espresso machine. On January 21, she went alone to the appliance mall to pick out and buy the espresso machine, bought coffee beans and other supplies along the way, then returned to the shop to set up a simple drink corner, and finally tested the machine to confirm it was running properly.

subevent.name: Discussing the coffee machine purchase plan with her husband.
subevent.description: At home, Song Yajing discussed with her husband Chen Zhiqiang the plan to add a drink corner to the store, and they reached an agreement on the budget and model for buying an Italian espresso machine.
subevent.location: Living room at home, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen.

subevent.name: Going to the electronics mall to select and buy an Italian espresso machine
subevent.description: Song Yajing went alone to the GOME appliance store in Siming District. After comparing and selecting at several brand counters, she bought a mid-priced Italian espresso machine.
subevent.location: Gome Electric, Zhongshan Road Store, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Purchasing basic coffee and beverage supplies
subevent.description: After leaving the appliance mall, Song Yajing stopped by a nearby food ingredient store on the way and bought basic supplies such as coffee beans, syrup, paper cups, and stirrers, preparing for the operation of the drink corner.
subevent.location: Siming District, Xiamen - Zhongshan Road Baking Ingredients Store

subevent.name: Return to the shop to set up a simple beverage corner.
subevent.description: Song Yajing returned to her boutique clothing store with the coffee machine and supplies. In the back corner of the store, she cleared a spot on the table with a power outlet, set up the coffee machine, placed the syrup cup holder, and arranged a simple beverage preparation area.
subevent.location: Boutique clothing store at No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Test making drinks with the espresso machine
subevent.description: After finishing the setup, Song Yajing operated the coffee machine for the first time according to the manual, ground coffee beans, and made an espresso to test the machine, confirming that it worked properly and tasted up to standard.
subevent.location: Boutique clothing store at No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen

name: Before and After Sister's Visit: Primary School Enrollment Reminder Triggers Anxiety and Family Discussion
description: On January 16, Song Yajing used WeChat to confirm the visit schedule of her sister Song Yawen, who was in Shenzhen, for the 18th. On January 18, her sister arrived in Xiamen. The two sisters went shopping to buy new clothes for Yajing's daughter Chen Lexuan. During the shopping trip, her sister reminded her that early planning was needed for the transition from kindergarten to primary school and mentioned the price of school-district housing in Shenzhen, which heightened Song Yajing's anxiety. That night, Song Yajing had nightmares and had insomnia. On the morning of January 19, Song Yajing had a preliminary discussion with her husband Chen Zhiqiang about school selection.

subevent.name: Communicated with her sister in advance about the visit arrangements.
subevent.description: Song Yajing confirmed via WeChat with her sister Song Yawen in Shenzhen the details of her visit to Xiamen on January 18, including arrival time and plans, and they agreed to go shopping together to buy new clothes for her daughter Xuanxuan.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Home

subevent.name: Elder sister arrived in Xiamen from Shenzhen.
subevent.description: Her older sister Song Yawen passed through on a business trip and took the high-speed rail from Shenzhen to Xiamen North Station. Song Yajing went to the station to meet her, and the sisters exchanged a few brief greetings at the station.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Xiamen North Railway Station

subevent.name: Sisters go shopping to pick out new clothes for Xuanxuan and discuss the transition from kindergarten to primary school.
subevent.description: Song Yajing and her older sister Song Yawen went shopping at children's clothing stores and malls on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street in Xiamen, picking out new spring clothes for her daughter Chen Lexuan. During the shopping, her sister reminded Song Yajing that choosing a primary school for the kindergarten-to-primary-school transition in Xiamen needs to be planned early, and cited the high prices of school-district housing in Shenzhen, which intensified Song Yajing's anxiety about her child's future.
subevent.location: Xiamen-Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

subevent.name: Had nightmares and insomnia at night due to anxiety
subevent.description: After falling asleep that night, Song Yajing felt anxious because of her sister's reminder during the day about the transition from kindergarten to elementary school. She dreamed that her boutique clothing store went bankrupt. She woke up with a start and found it hard to fall asleep again, feeling heavy-hearted.
subevent.location: Xiamen - home bedroom

subevent.name: The next day: preliminary discussion with husband about school selection.
subevent.description: After a sleepless night, Song Yajing mentioned her sister's reminder and her own worries to her husband Chen Zhiqiang the next morning. The two had a preliminary discussion about the direction and plan for their daughter Chen Lexuan's transition from kindergarten to primary school, and decided to start paying attention to school information and policies.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Home

name: Valentine's Day dinner ended in discord and late-night self-reflection.
description: On the evening of February 14, Valentine's Day, Chen Zhiqiang, hoping to ease the tension of the past few days, booked a candlelit dinner at a Western restaurant in Xiamen, expecting the romantic atmosphere to help his wife relax. During the meal, he held Song Yajing's hand and said sincerely, "I support you opening the shop, but I don't want to see you work yourself so hard. Money can be earned slowly." However, just as the shop rent was due and her cash flow was stretched tight, Song Yajing's mind was full of the tens of thousands of yuan needed for next month's rent. His words provoked an emotional outburst, and she blurted out, "Don't worry about me. I'll carry my shop on my own!" The warm atmosphere shattered instantly. Chen Zhiqiang paid the bill in silence, and the two walked home without a word. Late at night, Song Yajing sat alone in the living room, flipping through their wedding album. Tears slid down her cheeks, and she felt guilty and confused. She did not fall asleep until around 3 a.m.

subevent.name: Drove to the Western restaurant for the appointment.
subevent.description: In the evening, Song Yajing and Chen Zhiqiang left home together and drove to the booked Western restaurant. Along the way, the two talked little, and the atmosphere was somewhat dull.
subevent.location: Siming District, Xiamen - Hubin South Road to the Western Restaurant section

subevent.name: Conflict and unpleasant parting at a candlelight dinner
subevent.description: During a romantic candlelit dinner, Chen Zhiqiang held Song Yajing's hand to show concern and advised her not to overexert herself. But Song Yajing, under pressure from the rent collection notice, lost her temper and retorted without thinking, instantly freezing the warm atmosphere. Chen Zhiqiang paid the bill in silence, and the two left.
subevent.location: Siming District, Xiamen - a Western restaurant

subevent.name: Returned home in silence all the way
subevent.description: They returned from the Western restaurant to their home on Hubin South Road. Chen Zhiqiang and Song Yajing were silent throughout, each immersed in feelings of disappointment and grievance. After arriving home, they washed up separately without speaking.
subevent.location: Home, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Late at night, alone, looking through the wedding album and reflecting.
subevent.description: Late at night, Song Yajing sat alone in the living room, opened the wedding album, and recalled the sweetness of the past and the pressures of the present. She couldn't hold back her tears, feeling full of guilt and confusion, and only managed to fall asleep around 3 AM.
subevent.location: Home living room, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City

name: Returning home for Spring Festival and family time on Chinese New Year's Eve
description: On January 24, Song Yajing closed the store and packed her luggage, preparing to return to Quanzhou for the Chinese New Year. On the evening of January 26, the family of three drove from Xiamen back to Quanzhou and arrived at her parents' home that night for a reunion. On Chinese New Year's Eve (January 28), the whole family prepared the New Year's Eve dinner together, shared the reunion dinner and chatted in the evening. During this time, her father Song Minghui lamented that his hearing was declining and he feared becoming a burden. Song Yajing deeply felt her family responsibility.

subevent.name: Close the store and pack for the trip home
subevent.description: On the day before Chinese New Year's Eve, Song Yajing closed the shop for the holiday, sorted the store accounts and merchandise, and locked the door. Then she went home and packed luggage with her husband Chen Zhiqiang, preparing clothes and gifts for returning to Quanzhou for the New Year.
subevent.location: Xiamen - Siming District - boutique clothing store and home on Hubin South Road

subevent.name: Drive back to Quanzhou
subevent.description: In the evening, the family of three—Song Yajing, her husband, and daughter—set off from Xiamen in their own car and took the Shenhai Expressway to their hometown in Quanzhou. They made a brief stop at a rest area and arrived at Licheng District, Quanzhou about an hour and a half later.
subevent.location: Fujian Province - Shenhai Expressway (Xiamen-Quanzhou section) and Licheng District, Quanzhou City

subevent.name: Arrived at her parents' home and reunited
subevent.description: In the evening, Song Yajing's family arrived at her parents' home at No. 45, Xinhua North Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou. Her parents Song Minghui and Lin Xiuying warmly welcomed them. The family had dinner together, chatted about everyday matters, and enjoyed a happy, harmonious time.
subevent.location: Quanzhou City - Licheng District - parents' home

subevent.name: Prepare the New Year's Eve dinner
subevent.description: From morning to evening on Chinese New Year's Eve, Song Yajing and her mother were busy in the kitchen preparing a traditional Minnan New Year's Eve dinner, including signature dishes such as satay noodles and Quanzhou meat zongzi. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang was responsible for setting the table and drinks, and her father Song Minghui played with his granddaughter. The whole family made dumplings together, full of joy and harmony.
subevent.location: Quanzhou City - Licheng District - kitchen and living room at parents' home

subevent.name: Chinese New Year's Eve family reunion dinner and heart-to-heart talk
subevent.description: On New Year's Eve, the whole family sat around the table for the reunion dinner. During the meal, her husband Chen Zhiqiang and her father Song Minghui talked about pension reform. Her father sighed that his hearing had deteriorated badly and he feared he would become a burden to his children. Song Yajing was deeply moved, resolved to care more about her parents' health, and comforted her father not to worry. The family exchanged blessings and stayed up late to see in the new year.
subevent.location: Quanzhou City - Licheng District - dining room at parents' home

name: Dinner for the couple alone
description: On the evening of January 15, Song Yajing left her daughter in the care of her neighbor Auntie Zhang and had dinner with her husband Chen Zhiqiang at a Western restaurant in Xiamen. The two temporarily set aside shop and family chores, recalled amusing stories from their time dating, and discussed plans for a future family trip. Chen Zhiqiang encouraged her not to put too much pressure on herself and said that he would support her no matter how her transition turned out. This dinner made the couple even closer.

subevent.name: Entrusting her daughter to Aunt Zhang, the neighbor
subevent.description: On the afternoon or early evening of January 15, Song Yajing sent her 5-year-old daughter Chen Lexuan to the home of neighbor Zhang Xiuying, asking Aunt Zhang to look after her for a few hours and telling her when she would pick her up.
subevent.location: Song Yajing's home, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Go to the Western restaurant
subevent.description: In the evening, Song Yajing and her husband Chen Zhiqiang left home. Chen Zhiqiang drove to the booked Western restaurant, and the two chatted happily on the way.
subevent.location: Xiamen - on the way from home to the Western restaurant

subevent.name: Had a private dinner for two
subevent.description: Song Yajing and Chen Zhiqiang enjoyed a candlelit dinner at a Western restaurant, temporarily setting aside shop and family chores, reminiscing about funny moments from their dating days, and discussing future family travel plans. Chen Zhiqiang encouraged her not to put too much pressure on herself and expressed his support. The two became closer emotionally.
subevent.location: A French restaurant in Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Picked up her daughter and thanked the neighbor.
subevent.description: After returning to the neighborhood, Song Yajing went to the neighbor Aunt Zhang's home to pick up her daughter Chen Lexuan and thanked Aunt Zhang for her help and care.
subevent.location: Zhang Xiuying's home, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen

name: Annual full-body checkup
description: On February 27, Song Yajing called family doctor Wang Mingyuan to make an appointment for a full physical exam on March 5. On March 5, she went to the community health service center on time and completed a complete blood count, electrocardiogram, and gynecological exam. On March 7, she received the physical exam report, which was all normal, along with health advice, by phone.

subevent.name: Call the family doctor to make an appointment for a physical examination
subevent.description: Song Yajing used her mobile phone at home to call family doctor Wang Mingyuan and made an appointment for the morning of March 5 for a full-body health checkup package at the community health service center, which included a complete blood count, an electrocardiogram, and a gynecological examination. She also confirmed fasting and other precautions.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Siming District - home

subevent.name: Go to the community health center for a full physical examination
subevent.description: Song Yajing went to the community health service center on an empty stomach according to the appointment time, and completed the routine blood draw, electrocardiogram, and gynecological examination in turn. The whole process took about two hours. During that time, Dr. Wang Mingyuan briefly asked about recent lifestyle habits and stress conditions.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Huli District Community Health Service Center

subevent.name: Obtained the physical examination report and health advice via phone consultation.
subevent.description: Song Yajing contacted Dr. Wang Mingyuan by phone to get her physical examination report results. The doctor verbally explained that all indicators in the complete blood count, electrocardiogram, and gynecological examination were normal, and advised her to maintain moderate exercise to relieve work stress.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Siming District - home

name: Learning short video filming and operations.
description: On Saturday, January 4, under the guidance of her husband Chen Zhiqiang, Song Yajing first systematically learned to shoot short videos of clothing with her phone in the living room of her home in Xiamen. She prepared tools and accounts in advance, learned the basics of composition and lighting, practiced shooting material of several outfits, edited it into a 15-second video with CapCut, and finally posted it to Douyin and Xiaohongshu, taking the first step in online content creation.

subevent.name: Prepare filming equipment and accounts.
subevent.description: Reminded by her husband Chen Zhiqiang, Song Yajing installed and signed into Douyin, Xiaohongshu, and CapCut apps on her phone in advance. She also took out a phone tripod from the storage room, adjusted the angle, and selected 3 pieces of premium clothing for the shoot, placing them on the living room sofa as shooting props.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - living room at home

subevent.name: Learn basic smartphone photography skills.
subevent.description: Chen Zhiqiang used his phone memo and live demonstrations to explain to Song Yajing several common short-video composition methods (centered, rule of thirds), natural light and fill light techniques, and how to highlight clothing details through angles. Song Yajing listened while taking notes in her phone memo, asking questions and interacting.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - living room at home

subevent.name: Hands-on filming of a clothing display video.
subevent.description: Under her husband's guidance, Song Yajing put on the selected outfits and practiced showing the front, side, and details (fabric, collar, cuffs, etc.) in front of the phone camera. She tried different standing poses and hand movements, shooting 3-5 clips for each outfit. Her husband pointed out problems such as insufficient lighting and shaky hands, and they reshot.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - living room at home

subevent.name: Learned video editing and completed the first draft.
subevent.description: Chen Zhiqiang opened the CapCut app and started teaching from the basics: splitting clips, adjusting speed, adding background music (recommending popular Douyin BGM), subtitles, and the store logo watermark. Song Yajing followed along, edited her favorite footage into a 15-second short video, and revised it three times until her husband considered it acceptable.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - living room at home

subevent.name: Publish short videos to Douyin and Xiaohongshu
subevent.description: Song Yajing uploaded the edited videos to Douyin and Xiaohongshu. On her husband's suggestion, she wrote eye-catching titles (such as 'Spring Outfits for Petite Women | Height-Boosting Tips') and added popular hashtags like #OutfitIdeas #XiamenFashion. After publishing, she repeatedly checked the posting page to make sure everything was correct.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - living room at home

name: Impulsive investment in a coffee machine leads to a quarrel between the couple and subsequent financial regulation
description: On February 4, 2025, disregarding her husband Chen Zhiqiang's opposition, Song Yajing used nearly 20,000 yuan from the store's working capital to purchase an Italian espresso machine and a simple bar counter, resulting in tight cash flow for that month. That day, after Chen Zhiqiang discovered the large expenditure, he had a fierce quarrel with Song Yajing, accusing her of acting arbitrarily, and their relationship deteriorated. The next day (February 5), the couple fell into a cold war and ignored each other. On February 6, Chen Zhiqiang took the initiative to break the deadlock and reluctantly agreed to the investment, but sternly demanded that detailed income and expenditure accounts be established. Song Yajing agreed verbally but still felt aggrieved inside. On February 7, Song Yajing began to organize the store's income and expenditure details, planning to create a running ledger to standardize financial management.

subevent.name: Impulsively bought a coffee machine
subevent.description: Despite her husband Chen Zhiqiang's earlier opposition, Song Yajing spent nearly 20,000 yuan from the store's working capital to buy an Italian espresso machine and a simple bar counter, leaving the month's working capital tight.
subevent.location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Argument over the accounts erupts.
subevent.description: Chen Zhiqiang found a large expense after checking the store accounts and had a fierce argument with Song Yajing, accusing her of acting arbitrarily and threatening the family's financial security. Song Yajing argued that it was for the store's transformation, and their relationship deteriorated.
subevent.location: Home, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Cold war standoff
subevent.description: After the quarrel, the couple fell into a cold war and ignored each other. The atmosphere at home was tense. Song Yajing felt wronged but stuck to her opinion, while Chen Zhiqiang remained silent.
subevent.location: Home, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Chen Zhiqiang took the initiative to break the ice and compromise.
subevent.description: Chen Zhiqiang actively broke the cold war deadlock, communicated with Song Yajing, reluctantly agreed to the coffee machine investment, but sternly required that detailed income and expenditure accounts be established from then on, and that shop funds could no longer be used at will.
subevent.location: Home, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Verbally agreed to set up bookkeeping.
subevent.description: Song Yajing verbally agreed to Chen Zhiqiang’s request, but inwardly felt that her husband did not understand her determination to change direction. Still, it temporarily eased the tension between them.
subevent.location: Home, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Started sorting the store's income and expense details.
subevent.description: To fulfill her promise, Song Yajing began organizing the store's recent income and expenditure details and planned to establish a transaction ledger in the future to standardize financial management.
subevent.location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen

name: Tried the opera cake again and met with modest success
description: On Tuesday afternoon, February 25, there were few customers in the shop. Song Yajing gathered her courage and tried making the Opera cake again. She strictly followed Master Chen's online video tutorial, prepared all ingredients in advance, and patiently completed each layer of spreading and chilling. The final product was neat in appearance, and the coffee buttercream had a balanced sweet-bitter taste. Excitedly, she took photos and shared them with Master Chen and Zhao Li, and received professional recognition. Zhao Li also suggested that in the future they could make small dessert gift boxes to sell with bouquets. This success made her believe again that she could balance her baking hobby with running the shop.

subevent.name: Preparing ingredients and taking an online course
subevent.description: On the morning of February 25, Song Yajing carefully checked the ingredient list in the online course video at home, prepared ingredients such as almond flour, coffee powder, butter, and chocolate in advance, and reviewed Master Chen's instructional video to ensure the process was clear.
subevent.location: Kitchen at home in Siming District, Xiamen.

subevent.name: Make an opera cake.
subevent.description: In the afternoon, taking advantage of a lull in store traffic, Song Yajing made a cake in the store's back kitchen strictly following the online course steps: she completed the almond sponge cake layers, coffee buttercream, and chocolate ganache in sequence, chilling each layer to set. The final product had a neat appearance and balanced flavor.
subevent.location: No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen - store back kitchen

subevent.name: Taking photos to share and professional feedback
subevent.description: After finishing the cake, Song Yajing took photos of the finished product and sent them via WeChat to her baking teacher, Master Chen, and her friend Zhao Li. She received professional acknowledgment from both — Master Chen praised the clear layers and balanced sweetness and bitterness, and Zhao Li also expressed surprise.
subevent.location: Inside the shop at No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Discuss future plans and tidy up
subevent.description: After receiving the feedback, Song Yajing further communicated with Zhao Li via WeChat. Zhao Li suggested that in the future they could make small dessert gift boxes to sell alongside flower bouquets. Song Yajing seriously considered the suggestion, noted the improvement direction, and then cleaned up the making tools and leftover materials.
subevent.location: Inside the shop at No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen

name: Learning baking, attending Mass, and being comforted by her daughter after failing the cake challenge
description: On February 8, Song Yajing learned pour-over coffee and tiramisu making from Master Chen. On the morning of February 9, she went to Siming Catholic Church to attend Mass and pray for her family and career. On February 10, she tried making the difficult opera cake at home, but failed because the steps were complicated and she was interrupted by a customer's phone call; she cried in sadness after wasting ingredients. That evening, her daughter Xuanxuan drew 'Mommy's Cake Shop' and wrote 'Go Mommy' on a note and stuck it by the bed. When Song Yajing saw it, she was moved to tears and regained her spirits.

subevent.name: Learn to make pour-over coffee and tiramisu
subevent.description: Song Yajing went to Master Chen's baking workshop to learn pour-over coffee brewing techniques and the recipe and preparation process for classic tiramisu, and recorded the key points.
subevent.location: Xiamen - Master Chen's Baking Workshop (Huli District)

subevent.name: Attend Sunday Mass to pray for career
subevent.description: In the morning, Song Yajing went to Siming Catholic Church to attend Sunday Mass, praying for family harmony and smooth store operations. After Mass, she had a brief chat with fellow parishioners.
subevent.location: Xiamen – Siming Catholic Church

subevent.name: Failed the challenge of making an Opera cake.
subevent.description: At home, Song Yajing tried to make a difficult Opéra cake. Because the steps were complicated and she was repeatedly interrupted by customer calls, the cake collapsed and tasted bitter, wasting a lot of ingredients. She cried sadly in the corner of the kitchen.
subevent.location: Xiamen - home kitchen (128 Hubin South Road)

subevent.name: Found her daughter's heartwarming drawing and regained her spirits
subevent.description: That evening, her daughter Chen Lexuan used crayons to create a picture called "Mom's Cake Shop" and wrote "Go, Mom!" on it, then stuck it at the head of Song Yajing's bed. When Song Yajing discovered it, she hugged her daughter and cried, and warmth and motivation were rekindled in her heart.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - home bedroom (No. 128 Hubin South Road)

name: Spring Festival return trip and store reopening
description: On February 2, Song Yajing and her family ended their Spring Festival holiday in Quanzhou and drove back to Xiamen. They encountered some congestion on the way due to the return-travel peak and arrived in the evening. On February 3, Song Yajing went to the store alone to do a thorough cleaning, organize the newly arrived spring clothing, and check the Italian espresso machine she had bought before the New Year, deciding to set it up as a simple drink corner the next day. On February 4, Song Yajing officially returned to work at the store, placed the espresso machine beside the cash register, opened for business, and introduced the new free drink service to customers.

subevent.name: Packing return-trip luggage at home in Quanzhou.
subevent.description: In the morning at her parents' home in Quanzhou, Song Yajing and her husband Chen Zhiqiang packed up the luggage and local specialties they had brought during the Spring Festival. Their daughter Chen Lexuan helped sort out the toys, and they said goodbye to her parents.
subevent.location: Parents' home at No. 45 Xinhua North Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou

subevent.name: Encountered heavy traffic on the drive back.
subevent.description: Around 10 a.m., Song Yajing's family set off from Quanzhou by car back to Xiamen. Due to the Spring Festival return peak, they hit congestion on the Shenhai Expressway from Quanzhou to Xiamen section, and the drive took about 1 hour longer than usual.
subevent.location: Fujian Province - Shenhai Expressway (Quanzhou to Xiamen section)

subevent.name: Arrived home in Xiamen.
subevent.description: Arrived at the home on Hubin South Road in Xiamen around 5 p.m., moved the luggage inside, rested for a bit, and prepared for the store to reopen the next day.
subevent.location: Home, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Thorough store cleaning.
subevent.description: At 9 a.m., Song Yajing came alone to the boutique clothing store on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street and did a thorough cleaning of the store, including mopping the floor, wiping down the shelves and glass display windows, to welcome the reopening with a clean environment.
subevent.location: Xiamen City, Siming District - No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

subevent.name: Organized newly arrived spring clothing.
subevent.description: In the afternoon, Song Yajing unpacked and ironed the new spring clothing she had bought before the Chinese New Year, rearranged them on the shelves by style and color, and updated some price tags to prepare for the official opening.
subevent.location: Xiamen City, Siming District - No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

subevent.name: Coffee machine check and beverage corner planning
subevent.description: In the evening, Song Yajing checked the espresso machine she had bought before the New Year. She tested it, and it functioned normally. She decided to officially place it beside the cash register tomorrow as a simple beverage corner, offering customers a drink experience and improving the store’s service.
subevent.location: Xiamen City, Siming District - No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

subevent.name: The store officially reopened and launched its beverage corner.
subevent.description: On the morning of February 4 (Tuesday), Song Yajing went to the shop, placed the espresso machine beside the cash register, finished debugging, and officially started business. She also introduced the new complimentary drink service to customers entering the store to enhance their experience.
subevent.location: Xiamen City, Siming District - No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: The coffee corner promotion and the first WeChat Channels livestream hit a snag
description: On March 1, Song Yajing quietly launched a "buy clothes, get a free American coffee" promotion in a corner of the store, but because the location was hidden and it wasn't promoted, fewer than 10 cups were given away per day on average. The next day, to explore online customer traffic, she tried live streaming on WeChat Channels for the first time. Unfamiliar with the platform's rules, she received a copyright infringement warning for the background music, and the livestream was also interrupted by a customer's phone call, forcing her to awkwardly end the stream. When she reviewed the replay afterward, only her mother-in-law and her own mother had liked it. Her online transition got off to a bad start.

subevent.name: Execution and observation of the coffee corner activity
subevent.description: After opening the store, Song Yajing launched a 'buy clothes, get an Americano free' event in a corner. Because the location was hidden and she didn't actively promote it, only 7 cups of coffee were given out all day, and customer response was lukewarm. She took time to post a brief event preview on WeChat Moments, but engagement was very low.
subevent.location: Xiamen - Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

subevent.name: First WeChat Channels Livestream Execution and Interruption
subevent.description: At 3 p.m., Song Yajing started a livestream. Unfamiliar with the platform's copyright rules, the pop songs she played triggered a copyright infringement warning. While she was hesitating, a regular customer called to ask about returns and exchanges. After she answered the phone, only onlookers remained in the livestream. After she hung up, the warning was still showing in the bullet comments, so she awkwardly turned off the livestream. The whole session lasted only about 15 minutes.
subevent.location: Xiamen - Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

subevent.name: Post-livestream review and reflection
subevent.description: After the live stream ended, Song Yajing reviewed the replay data and found that only her mother-in-law Lin Xiuying and her mother Lin Xiuying had liked it, with no new followers. Combining this with the coffee corner activity, she realized the importance of offline traffic diversion and spreading knowledge of online platform rules, and listed improvement plans in her notebook.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - home study

name: Afternoon tea with close friend to vent stress and prepare for follow-up communication
description: On February 21, Song Yajing made a WeChat appointment with her best friend Li Meiling for Saturday afternoon tea. On the afternoon of February 22, she went to the Zhongshan Road café to meet Li Meiling, pouring out her marital friction, career-transition setbacks, and anxiety about her daughter's school enrollment. Li Meiling gave her advice and comfort. After saying goodbye, Song Yajing returned home, communicated gently with her husband Chen Zhiqiang, and searched online for the Siming District preschool-to-primary-school online pre-registration policy and required documents list, preparing for registration in early March.

subevent.name: Made an advance reservation for afternoon tea with my besties.
subevent.description: Song Yajing contacted her close friend Li Meiling via WeChat, said she had been under a lot of stress lately, and arranged to meet and talk at a café near Zhongshan Road on Saturday afternoon. Li Meiling readily agreed and set a specific time.
subevent.location: Siming District, Xiamen - living room at home

subevent.name: Going to the cafe on Zhongshan Road
subevent.description: On Saturday afternoon, at the agreed time, Song Yajing set out from home and walked or took transportation to the café near Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, planning to meet Li Meiling.
subevent.location: Siming District, Xiamen - Hubin South Road to Zhongshan Road

subevent.name: Confiding in Li Meiling about life stress
subevent.description: Song Yajing met Li Meiling at a café. Over afternoon tea, she poured out her recent marital friction, business transformation setbacks, and anxiety about her daughter’s transition to primary school. Li Meiling, a primary school teacher, reminded her that online pre-registration for kindergarten-to-primary-school enrollment in Siming District usually starts in early March, and suggested preparing the materials in advance. She also comforted her, saying that it is not easy to start a business, but having family support is a blessing. The two cheered each other up, and Song Yajing felt much more relaxed.
subevent.location: Siming District, Xiamen - café near Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

subevent.name: After saying goodbye, returned home.
subevent.description: After afternoon tea, Song Yajing said goodbye to Li Meiling at the café entrance, then returned to her home on Hubin South Road. On the way, she savored the conversation and her mood clearly improved.
subevent.location: Xiamen, Siming District - Zhongshan Road to Hubin South Road.

subevent.name: After returning home, talk with my husband and look up school enrollment information.
subevent.description: After returning home, Song Yajing proactively brought up the advice she had received during afternoon tea with her husband Chen Zhiqiang. The two had a gentle conversation about their child's school enrollment and their marital relationship. She then searched online for Siming District's online pre-registration policy and required documents for primary school enrollment, preparing for the registration in early March.
subevent.location: Siming District, Xiamen City - home study

name: Elementary school visit triggers education anxiety, shared with her husband.
description: On March 8 (Saturday), Song Yajing, her husband Chen Zhiqiang, and their daughter Xuanxuan visited the designated primary school for their community. They found that this year the school was oversubscribed, and Xuanxuan would likely be reassigned to another school. Meanwhile, the private elementary school tuition was as high as 80,000 yuan per year. After tallying the numbers, the couple walked home in silence. That evening, Chen Zhiqiang took the initiative to suggest taking on side jobs to increase income. For the first time, Song Yajing felt the burden on her husband's shoulders was equally heavy, and the two reached a subtle empathy in their education anxiety.

subevent.name: Visiting the designated primary school.
subevent.description: Song Yajing, her husband Chen Zhiqiang, and their daughter Xuanxuan walked to the primary school designated for their residential community for an admission intention visit.
subevent.location: On the road from the residential community in Siming District, Xiamen, to the designated primary school

subevent.name: Visited a primary school and inquired about enrollment
subevent.description: The family of three toured the campus and learned from the admissions teacher that enrollment was overcapacity this year; Xuanxuan would likely be reassigned to another school.
subevent.location: Xiamen - Siming District - a designated primary school

subevent.name: Calculating private primary school fees caused anxiety
subevent.description: After the visit, Song Yajing and Chen Zhiqiang discussed outside the campus, calculating the financial pressure that 80,000 yuan per year in private elementary school tuition would put on the family; both were heavy-hearted.
subevent.location: Outside the designated primary school, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Silent on the way home.
subevent.description: Song Yajing and Chen Zhiqiang walked home from school with their daughter. The two were each silent because of their anxiety about education, and the atmosphere was heavy.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Siming District - road section from primary school to home

subevent.name: Her husband took the initiative to suggest taking on side jobs to increase their income.
subevent.description: That evening at home, Chen Zhiqiang proactively suggested to Song Yajing that he could take on side jobs such as IT technical support to increase the family income and ease the pressure of education expenses.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Siming District - home living room

subevent.name: Couple achieved empathy over education anxiety.
subevent.description: Song Yajing felt the burden on her husband's shoulders was equally heavy; in their anxiety, the two understood and supported each other, achieved empathy, and made an initial plan for follow-up education.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Siming District - home living room

name: VIP customer appreciation and client relationship maintenance
description: On the morning of February 18, Song Yajing bought ingredients, baked tiramisu in the store, and prepared fruit tea. In the afternoon, she held a tea party for five VIP regular customers, learned about their needs, and noted Vivian's suggestion to add accessories. Afterward, she gave them 20% discount trial vouchers and took photos to post on WeChat Moments for promotion. On the morning of February 19, she went to the small commodities wholesale market to research samples of accessories such as scarves and earrings, planning to introduce them for trial sales.

subevent.name: Purchasing ingredients and preparing refreshments.
subevent.description: On the morning of February 18, Song Yajing went to a nearby fresh-food supermarket to buy ingredients for making tiramisu and fruit tea (mascarpone cheese, ladyfingers, espresso, fresh fruit, etc.), then returned to the store kitchen to make them.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street Boutique Clothing Store

subevent.name: Held an afternoon tea party for VIP customers.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of February 18, Song Yajing held a small afternoon tea party at the store for five VIP regular customers (including Vivian). She personally served tiramisu and fruit tea, chatting with the customers as they ate and learning about their expectations for the new season's clothing. During the party, Vivian suggested adding more accessory pairings, and Song Yajing took careful notes.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street Boutique Clothing Store

subevent.name: Giving away experience vouchers and promoting with photos.
subevent.description: After the tea party ended, Song Yajing gave each guest a 20% off experience voucher, took photos of the event and group photos of the carefully arranged tea refreshments, edited the caption, and posted them on WeChat Moments for promotion, receiving many likes and favorable comments from friends.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street Boutique Clothing Store

subevent.name: Event follow-up and accessory purchasing research
subevent.description: Based on the accessory needs Vivian raised at the tea party, Song Yajing went to the Xiamen Small Commodity Wholesale Market on the morning of February 19 to inspect the goods, looking for accessory samples such as scarves and earrings suitable for the store. She took photos for reference and planned to introduce them for trial sales later.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Lujiang Road Small Commodities Wholesale Market

name: Spring new arrivals procurement and supply chain communication.
description: On the morning of Tuesday, February 11, Song Yajing had a video call with her main clothing supplier, Susan, via WeChat to discuss the selection and order details for the 2025 spring new women's clothing. Susan showed several dresses and shirts that were about to be released. Song Yajing chose 8 styles based on the store customers' preferences and negotiated the initial order quantity and delivery time. In the afternoon, she contacted another independent designer from Hangzhou, Zheng Kai, and asked whether his studio had unique styles suitable for the Xiamen market. Zheng Kai recommended two hand-embroidered tops. Song Yajing added them to the trial-sales list and paid a deposit in advance.

subevent.name: Prepare materials for the video conference
subevent.description: In the morning, at the store, she sorted through recent sales data and customer preference records, prepared materials for a video call with supplier Susan to discuss product selection, and tested the video call equipment on her phone.
subevent.location: Xiamen - Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

subevent.name: Video product selection with Susan
subevent.description: Communicated with supplier Susan in Guangzhou via WeChat video, watched the presentation of new spring dresses and shirts, selected 8 styles based on the preferences of the store's customers, and negotiated the first order quantity, discount, and delivery time.
subevent.location: Xiamen - Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

subevent.name: Organize orders and send confirmations.
subevent.description: Compiled the selected 8 styles, quantities, prices, and shipping dates into an order document, sent it to Susan via WeChat for confirmation, and recorded it in the store's purchase ledger.
subevent.location: Xiamen - Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

subevent.name: Preparing to communicate with Zheng Kai
subevent.description: After lunch, she looked through the photos and descriptions of the hand-embroidered tops that Zheng Kai had sent earlier, sorted out the details she needed to ask about (fabric, size, price, delivery time), and prepared the deposit funds.
subevent.location: Xiamen - Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

subevent.name: Contacting Zheng Kai and prepaying the deposit.
subevent.description: In the afternoon, she contacted Zheng Kai, an independent designer in Hangzhou, via WeChat, asked in detail about two hand-embroidered tops, and after confirming they suited the Xiamen market, added them to the trial-sales list and paid a deposit in advance via WeChat Pay.
subevent.location: Xiamen - Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

subevent.name: Organizing the new procurement information.
subevent.description: Entered the information for Zheng Kai's two hand-embroidered tops into the trial sales list, updated the store's purchasing plan, and adjusted next week's delivery and shelving schedule.
subevent.location: Xiamen - Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

subevent.name: Discuss new stock arrangements with the shop assistant.
subevent.description: Before closing the store, I communicated with staff member Xiaomei about today's purchasing overview, informed her of the upcoming arrival times, and arranged the weekend plan for adjusting the store display.
subevent.location: Xiamen - Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: The entire process of preparing for the transition from kindergarten to elementary school.
description: In late February 2025, Song Yajing handled the enrollment matters for her daughter Xuanxuan's transition from kindergarten to primary school. After checking the admission policy on the 23rd, she discussed countermeasures with her husband Chen Zhiqiang that evening, and decided to prepare the materials and make on-site inquiries; starting on the 24th, she organized the documents, and on the 28th she went to the target primary school to obtain the enrollment brochure.

subevent.name: Check the 2025 primary school enrollment policy.
subevent.description: Song Yajing checked the 2025 primary school enrollment policy released by the Siming District Education Bureau on her computer at home. She found that some popular primary schools require household registration to be transferred in for at least one year, and felt pressure about the timing of her daughter Xuanxuan's household registration.
subevent.location: Siming District, Xiamen City - home study

subevent.name: Discuss school admission plans with her husband.
subevent.description: In the evening, Song Yajing and her husband Chen Zhiqiang had a serious discussion at home about their daughter Xuanxuan's school enrollment. They decided to start preparing materials such as the property ownership certificate and household register next week, and planned to visit the target primary school in person for consultation at the end of the month. Chen Zhiqiang said he would take leave to accompany her.
subevent.location: Siming District, Xiamen - living room at home

subevent.name: Preparing school enrollment materials
