subevent.description: Following the agreed plan, Song Yajing began organizing the certificate materials required for school enrollment, including the real estate certificate, household register, marriage certificate, and birth medical certificate, and verified whether the information was complete.
subevent.location: Siming District, Xiamen City - home study

subevent.name: Go to the target elementary school for an on-site consultation.
subevent.description: Song Yajing and her husband Chen Zhiqiang went together to Siming District Experimental Primary School (the target primary school) to consult with the admissions office teacher about specific enrollment conditions, household registration years requirement, and registration process, and obtained the latest enrollment brochure.
subevent.location: Siming District, Xiamen - Siming District Experimental Primary School

name: Agreed on the co-branding plan for flower art and clothing with Zhao Li
description: On Thursday afternoon, February 27, Zhao Li came to the store again and had a detailed discussion with Song Yajing about a cooperation plan to integrate flower art into clothing sales. The two decided to launch a [Spring Flower Whisper] theme week in early March: the store window would be changed to Zhao Li's dried flower decorations, small bouquets would be given as gifts for purchases over a certain amount, and they would jointly promote it in the community. Song Yajing was responsible for designing outfit copy, Zhao Li provided floral materials, and profits would be split proportionally. That evening, Song Yajing began writing promotional copy and ordered the first batch of flower materials.

subevent.name: Discuss the co-branding plan with Zhao Li in person.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of February 27, florist Zhao Li came to the boutique clothing store and had a detailed discussion with store owner Song Yajing about a cooperation plan to integrate floral art into clothing sales. They finalized the specifics of the [Spring Flower Whispers] theme week: window decoration, gift bouquets with purchases, community promotion, and profit sharing.
subevent.location: Xiamen City, Siming District - Boutique Clothing Store

subevent.name: Writing promotional copy for the theme week
subevent.description: On the evening of February 27, Song Yajing was at home writing outfit recommendation copy for the upcoming [Spring Flower Language] theme week, planning to post it in the store community and on Moments to tie in with the floral co-branding event.
subevent.location: Siming District, Xiamen - Home

subevent.name: Pre-order the first batch of co-branded floral materials.
subevent.description: On the evening of February 27, Song Yajing contacted the flower supplier via WeChat and ordered the first batch of dried and fresh flowers for window decorations and small free bouquets with qualifying purchases, ensuring the materials would be in place when the event began in early March.
subevent.location: Home, Siming District, Xiamen (online)

subevent.name: Execute the [Spring Flower Language] theme week
subevent.description: According to the agreed plan, they carried out a one-week joint event at the store: the window display was changed to Zhao Li's dried flower decorations; customers who spent over a certain amount received a small bouquet; the two promoted it together in their respective communities, with Song Yajing responsible for the styling copy and Zhao Li providing floral arrangement material.
subevent.location: Xiamen City, Siming District - Boutique Clothing Store

subevent.name: Set up the shop window and storefront.
subevent.description: With business partner Zhao Li, she replaced the store window decoration with dried flowers, set up event posters, and organized the flower giveaway area, making sure the storefront matched the spring flower language theme.
subevent.location: Xiamen – Boutique Clothing Store

subevent.name: First release of the joint promotion
subevent.description: Song Yajing posted outfit captions on WeChat Moments and in customer groups, with floral imagery provided by Zhao Li. At the same time, Zhao Li promoted the co-branded event in her floral design community, and they cross-reposted each other's content to expand its reach.
subevent.location: Xiamen – Boutique Clothing Store

subevent.name: Daily Operations and Flower Gifting Event
subevent.description: Ran the store normally and served customers, carried out the activity of gifting small bouquets for purchases above a certain amount, and paid attention to community feedback and answered customer inquiries about the co-branded event.
subevent.location: Xiamen – Boutique Clothing Store

subevent.name: Final sprint preparation for the event
subevent.description: Sorted out the remaining flower bouquets in advance and reminded customers in-store and on WeChat Moments that the event had only one day left, encouraging them to join the spend-threshold flower giveaway, so as to prepare for the closing.
subevent.location: Xiamen – Boutique Clothing Store

subevent.name: Settle the profit split for the co-branded event.
subevent.description: After the themed week ended, Song Yajing tallied the sales during the event and the cost of the complimentary bouquets, calculated and paid Zhao Li's share according to the ratio agreed in advance, and exchanged feedback on the collaboration.
subevent.location: Xiamen City, Siming District - Boutique Clothing Store

name: Store monthly business settlement and strategy adjustment
description: On the evening of March 31, Song Yajing totaled March revenue at about 42,000 yuan and calculated that net profit was less than 8,000 yuan. Her analysis found that online traffic generation and the coffee corner investment had not met expectations, so she decided to adjust her business strategy. On April 1, she formulated specific measures (cut the online budget, suspend coffee corner purchases, strengthen community maintenance) and informed the shop assistant Xiaomei, asking her to focus on fitting guidance and customer maintenance.

subevent.name: Organize the operational documents and data for March.
subevent.description: On March 31, during business hours or before closing, Song Yajing collected and organized the month’s original vouchers, such as sales receipts, purchase invoices, employee attendance records, and utility bills, to prepare for the evening’s financial settlement.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Siming District - Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street (store cash register)

subevent.name: Monthly financial summary and profit calculation
subevent.description: After the shop closed in the evening, Song Yajing used an Excel spreadsheet in the store to summarize the March operating revenue (about 42,000 yuan), purchase costs, employee wages, rent, and all other expenses, and calculated that the net profit was less than 8000 yuan, lower than expected.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Siming District - Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street (store warehouse and office)

subevent.name: Analyze the cost structure and identify problem areas
subevent.description: Based on the financial data, Song Yajing further analyzed and found that the online traffic-driving investment had not brought enough foot traffic, and the equipment and ingredient costs of the in-store coffee corner had not yet generated obvious returns. She identified these two areas as needing adjustment.
subevent.location: Shop No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Formulate next month's business adjustment strategy.
subevent.description: The next day, April 1, Song Yajing formulated April business adjustment measures based on the review: cut the online customer acquisition budget, suspend purchases for the coffee corner, use the saved money to restock best-selling items, and plan to strengthen WeChat community maintenance to improve the repeat purchase rate.
subevent.location: Shop No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Communicated with shop assistant Xiaomei about adjusting the arrangements
subevent.description: Song Yajing informed shop assistant Xiaomei of the adjusted business strategy, making it clear that after cutting the coffee corner service, they needed to focus more on guiding try-ons and customer retention, and discussed the new sales incentive plan.
subevent.location: Shop No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen

name: Annual full-body checkup
description: On March 1, Song Yajing called to schedule a full annual physical exam for the morning of March 5 at the Huli District Community Health Service Center in Xiamen. On the morning of March 5, she set out from her home in Siming District and took the bus to the health center, where she completed blood tests, biochemistry tests, an electrocardiogram, an ultrasound, and other examinations. After the exam, the doctor interpreted the preliminary results on the spot, reminded her to watch out for neck and shoulder strain and stress management, and suggested regular exercise. Afterward she felt relieved and resolved to pay more attention to her health.

subevent.name: Reserve a time for the medical checkup
subevent.description: Song Yajing contacted the Huli District Community Health Service Center in Xiamen by phone to book an annual full-body physical examination for the morning of March 5.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Home

subevent.name: Head to the health checkup center
subevent.description: At 8 a.m., Song Yajing left her home in Siming District and took a bus to the Huli District Community Health Service Center.
subevent.location: Xiamen - on the bus

subevent.name: Complete the physical examination items.
subevent.description: At the physical examination center, Song Yajing completed all the tests in order, including routine blood tests, blood biochemistry, electrocardiogram, and ultrasound. The whole process took about 2 hours.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Huli District Community Health Service Center

subevent.name: Doctor's explanation and advice
subevent.description: After the physical exam, the doctor interpreted the preliminary results on site, reminded Song Yajing to pay attention to neck and shoulder strain and stress management, and recommended regular exercise.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Huli District Community Health Service Center

name: Book a shoulder and neck massage to relieve fatigue.
description: After the medical checkup, the doctor reminded her to watch out for neck and shoulder strain. On the afternoon of March 12, Song Yajing took advantage of a lull between shifts at the store, went to a massage clinic near her home, and booked a 60-minute neck and shoulder massage. The therapist noted that her neck and shoulder muscles were severely stiff and recommended weekly therapy sessions. After the massage she felt much more relaxed and decided to schedule at least one massage a month from now on to relieve work stress.

subevent.name: Go to the Tui Na massage clinic and book an appointment
subevent.description: During a lull in her store shift, Song Yajing walked to a massage parlor near her home and booked a 60-minute shoulder and neck massage.
subevent.location: Tuina massage parlor near Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Received a shoulder and neck massage.
subevent.description: At the massage clinic, Song Yajing received a 60-minute shoulder and neck massage from a therapist. The therapist noted that her shoulder and neck muscles were severely stiff and recommended weekly therapy. After the massage, she felt much more relaxed.
subevent.location: Tuina massage parlor near Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Make a massage plan.
subevent.description: After the massage, Song Yajing decided to schedule a massage at least once a month in the future to relieve work stress, and recorded this plan in her phone's memo.
subevent.location: Tuina massage parlor near Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen

name: Ran into Zhao Li at church and started a floral arrangement collaboration.
description: On the morning of Sunday, February 16, 2025, Song Yajing went to Xiamen Siming Catholic Church to attend Mass. After Mass, she met a woman from her hometown named Zhao Li in the courtyard, and the two hit it off immediately and exchanged WeChat contacts. After seeing photos of Song Yajing's shop on her Moments, Zhao Li took the initiative to suggest remodeling the shop window with dried flowers and green plants, charging only cost price. Song Yajing gladly agreed. The next day (February 17), Zhao Li brought floral materials to Song Yajing's boutique clothing store on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, and the two remodeled the shop window together. The result was fresh and elegant. From then on, Zhao Li agreed to provide floral arrangement support for online content shoots, and the two established a long-term cooperative relationship.

subevent.name: Went to church to attend Mass
subevent.description: Due to busyness and anxiety, Song Yajing went alone to Siming Catholic Church in Xiamen on Sunday morning to attend Mass and seek inner peace.
subevent.location: Xiamen – Siming Catholic Church

subevent.name: Met Zhao Li in the church courtyard.
subevent.description: After Mass ended, Song Yajing met a gentle, refined woman with her daughter in the church courtyard. After chatting, she learned that the woman was named Zhao Li, the same age, a fellow native of Quanzhou, and ran a flower arrangement studio. The two hit it off immediately and exchanged WeChat contacts.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Siming Catholic Church Courtyard

subevent.name: Zhao Li proposed a floral design collaboration online.
subevent.description: That evening, browsing Song Yajing’s Moments and seeing the shop photos, Zhao Li took the initiative to send a WeChat message suggesting using dried flowers and green plants to redesign the shop window, charging only the cost price. Song Yajing was overjoyed and immediately agreed.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Home

subevent.name: Zhao Li prepares flower materials and heads to the store
subevent.description: The next morning (Monday), Zhao Li selected suitable dried flowers and green plants according to the store's style, and took the floral materials to Song Yajing's boutique clothing store on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street.
subevent.location: Xiamen City-Siming District Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

subevent.name: Together remodeling the storefront window
subevent.description: After Zhao Li arrived at the store, she and Song Yajing worked together to carefully arrange the dried flowers and green plants they had brought in the display window, creating a fresh and elegant display. After the makeover was completed, the two took a photo together and discussed floral arrangements for future online content.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Song Yajing Boutique Clothing Store.

subevent.name: Follow-up communication and confirmation of cooperation.
subevent.description: After the successful window display renovation, Zhao Li agreed to provide floral arrangement support for Song Yajing's online content shoots in the future, and the two formally established a long-term cooperation relationship.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Song Yajing Boutique Clothing Store.

name: Adjusted financial plan after having a business loan application rejected.
description: On the morning of March 5, Song Yajing organized materials such as bank statements at the store to prepare for a business loan application. In the afternoon, she went to the bank to submit the application and was told by account manager Lin Xiaofeng that her self-employed business cash flow was insufficient and that her husband needed to co-sign the loan or provide property as collateral. That evening, feeling her dignity wounded, she decided not to tell her husband for the time being and thought about easing cash flow pressure by reducing purchases and running promotions. On March 6, she formulated a specific adjustment plan at the store, planning to cut next month's purchases by 20% and launch promotions for old styles. On the evening of March 8, while discussing education expenses with her husband, she mentioned the rejected loan and the financial pressure; together they readjusted the family's monthly budget and increased the store's emergency reserve.

subevent.name: Preparing business loan application materials
subevent.description: On the morning of March 5, Song Yajing was in the store organizing the bank statements, sales reports, and business vouchers of the past few months, preparing to submit a 100,000 yuan business loan application to the bank.
subevent.location: Xiamen City, Siming District - Boutique clothing store on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street.

subevent.name: Contact the bank relationship manager to submit a loan application
subevent.description: On the afternoon of March 5, Song Yajing went to the Siming Sub-branch of ICBC Xiamen Branch and contacted account manager Lin Xiaofeng to submit a 100,000 yuan business loan application, but was told that her self-employed business’s cash flow was insufficient and that her husband would need to be a co-borrower or provide property as collateral.
subevent.location: Siming District, Xiamen - ICBC Siming Sub-branch

subevent.name: Emotional adjustment and decision after the loan was rejected
subevent.description: On the evening of March 5, Song Yajing returned home feeling humiliated by the rejection of her loan application. She decided not to ask her husband for help for the time being, and thought about easing cash flow pressure by reducing purchase volumes and running promotions.
subevent.location: Home on Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen.

subevent.name: Develop a short-term financial adjustment plan for the store
subevent.description: On March 6, Song Yajing worked out a detailed adjustment plan in the store, planning to cut next month's purchasing volume by 20% and launch a spring discount promotion on older styles to speed up capital recovery.
subevent.location: Xiamen City, Siming District - Boutique clothing store on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street.

subevent.name: Discuss education expenses with her husband and re-plan the family budget
subevent.description: On the evening of March 8, when Song Yajing and her husband Chen Zhiqiang were discussing their daughter's education spending plan at home, they mentioned the rejected loan and the financial pressure on the shop. Together they readjusted the monthly family budget and increased the shop's emergency reserve.
subevent.location: Home on Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen.

name: Formally enrolled in the advanced baking course.
description: On February 26, 2025, Song Yajing contacted Master Chen via WeChat at Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, to ask about and sign up for a four-week online advanced French pastry course. After confirming the course details and one-on-one Q&A service, she paid the fee. She then planned her study time around the store's low-traffic afternoon periods and put the course schedule behind the cash register.

subevent.name: Contacted Master Chen to inquire about baking courses
subevent.description: Song Yajing contacted Master Chen through WeChat, expressed her intention to enroll in a four-week online advanced French pastry course, and asked in detail about the course schedule, fees, and one-on-one Q&A service.
subevent.location: Xiamen City, Siming District - No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

subevent.name: Formally registered and paid the course fee.
subevent.description: After confirming the course details with Master Chen, Song Yajing decided to officially enroll and paid for the four-week advanced French pastry course via WeChat transfer or bank transfer.
subevent.location: Xiamen City, Siming District - No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

subevent.name: Plan store work and study time.
subevent.description: Song Yajing, based on the class schedule and the store's daily operating rhythm (especially the low-traffic afternoon period), planned how to reasonably allocate time over the next four weeks for baking course study, and adjusted her shop work arrangements to ensure both learning and business were not compromised.
subevent.location: Xiamen City, Siming District - No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Video-called my mother and received emotional support.
description: On the evening of February 18, after closing the shop, Song Yajing had a video call with her mother Lin Xiuying, who was far away in Quanzhou. Her mother asked with concern about the shop's recent situation and the couple's relationship. Song Yajing confided her worries about the coffee machine investment and the Valentine's Day quarrel. Her mother patiently comforted her, said in Hokkien, “When husband and wife are of one mind, they can cut through metal,” and taught her a recipe for making Minnan meat zongzi to take her mind off the stress. The call lasted nearly an hour. After hanging up, Song Yajing wrote the recipe down in detail in her phone memo, and her mood improved noticeably.

subevent.name: Had a video call with mother to pour out worries
subevent.description: Song Yajing made a video call with her mother Lin Xiuying. Her mother asked with concern about the recent situation of the store and the couple's relationship. Song Yajing confided her troubles caused by the coffee machine investment and the Valentine's Day argument. Her mother comforted her in Hokkien and taught her the recipe for Hokkien meat zongzi to help take her mind off the stress. The call lasted about an hour.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - living room at home

subevent.name: Record the meat zongzi recipe and sort out emotions.
subevent.description: After hanging up, Song Yajing carefully recorded the Minnan meat zongzi recipe her mother dictated in her phone memo, and her mood improved noticeably. She cleared her thoughts and decided to try making meat zongzi the next day according to the recipe to relieve stress.
subevent.location: Xiamen - home kitchen

name: Lantern Festival parent-child activity: making tangyuan and lanterns
description: On February 12, 2025, the Lantern Festival, Song Yajing closed the shop an hour early and went home to knead glutinous rice flour with her husband Chen Zhiqiang and daughter Chen Lexuan to make sesame tangyuan, and made simple rabbit lanterns from old red envelopes and bamboo skewers. She recorded the process as a short video and posted it in the community group with the caption, 'No matter how busy business is, we should still make life round,' and received many likes from customers. Afterwards, the family sat together and tasted the tangyuan they had made. The warm parent-child interaction eased the subtle tension between the couple caused by the recent investment in a coffee machine.

subevent.name: Closed the store early and went home
subevent.description: Song Yajing closed her boutique clothing store one hour early on the afternoon of the Lantern Festival, tidied up the shop, and walked home to prepare for spending the festival with her family.
subevent.location: Xiamen City, Siming District - No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

subevent.name: Making black sesame tangyuan
subevent.description: Song Yajing, together with her husband Chen Zhiqiang and daughter Chen Lexuan, kneaded glutinous rice flour and filled it with sesame filling in their home kitchen to make traditional yuanxiao (glutinous rice balls), enjoying the fun of parent-child teamwork.
subevent.location: Home, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Making rabbit lanterns
subevent.description: Using old red envelopes and bamboo skewers from home, Song Yajing and her daughter made a simple rabbit-shaped lantern together, while her husband helped with cutting and fixing. When it was done, her daughter carried the lantern and played with it.
subevent.location: Home, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Filmed and posted a Lantern Festival short video.

name: Health crisis from overwork, spiritual awakening, and the decision to delegate
description: Because she had been working nonstop on sale items and restocking, Song Yajing suddenly felt dizzy and collapsed in the warehouse on April 18, hitting her forehead on a shelf. The clerk Xiaomei was so frightened that she burst into tears. After receiving the call, Chen Zhiqiang dropped his work and rushed home, then took her to Dr. Wang Mingyuan for treatment. She was diagnosed with hypoglycemia, autonomic nervous system dysfunction, and severe sub-health, and the doctor ordered her to keep a regular schedule and reduce stress. After returning home, Chen Zhiqiang flew into a rage at his wife for the first time: 'Do you want money or your life? Do you want a divorce?' Their daughter Xuanxuan hid in her room and later drew a picture of her mother lying in a hospital bed, with the words 'Mommy, get better soon' written beside it. From April 19 to 20, Song Yajing lay in bed for two days and thought seriously about death for the first time. She opened the Bible and read, 'What does it profit a man to gain the whole world and lose his own life?' and tears streamed down her face. She sincerely apologized to her husband and made a major decision: she formally handed over the daily shop management to Xiaomei, keeping only product selection, the community, and key client maintenance for herself. At the same time, she booked a full physical examination for early May, and her mindset completely shifted from being a relentless workaholic to 'staying alive is what matters most.'

subevent.name: Collapsed from overwork in the warehouse.
subevent.description: Song Yajing, due to working nonstop on sale items and restocking, suddenly felt dizzy and collapsed in the store warehouse, hitting her forehead on a shelf. Employee Xiaomei found her, panicked, cried, and immediately contacted Chen Zhiqiang.
subevent.location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen (store warehouse).

subevent.description: After receiving the phone call, Chen Zhiqiang rushed home and took Song Yajing to see Dr. Wang Mingyuan. Dr. Wang diagnosed her with hypoglycemia, autonomic nervous system dysfunction, and severe sub-health, and instructed her to maintain a regular schedule and reduce stress.
subevent.location: Xiamen Huli District Community Health Service Center

subevent.location: Siming District, Xiamen - No. 128 South Hubin Road (home)

subevent.location: No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen (home bedroom)

name: Allergic rhinitis recurrence and initial management
description: On March 22, Xiamen entered the spring pollen season. When Song Yajing got up in the morning, she kept sneezing and had a stuffy nose, and only then realized that her mild allergic rhinitis, which had not acted up for years, had recurred. Because it did not affect her daily routine, she went to a pharmacy and bought loratadine to take. Her symptoms eased slightly but she still sounded nasal. That day she opened the store as usual. When talking with her friend Zhao Li on the phone, her heavy nasal tone was teased as 'like she was crying,' and she explained with a laugh that it was a pollen problem.

name: Returned to hometown during Qingming Festival, ran into an old friend who had lost his job, and prayed for him.
description: On April 3, the eve of the Qingming Festival, Song Yajing took her daughter Xuanxuan to Quanzhou to pay respects to their ancestors. Her husband, Chen Zhiqiang, was unable to go due to an urgent business trip. On April 4, during the Qingming Festival, she ran into Zhang Wei, a middle school classmate who had also come back to sweep his ancestors' tomb. He looked more gaunt than when they had messaged each other on WeChat the previous month. The two sat on the stone steps and chatted for half an hour. Zhang Wei frankly admitted that the mortgage pressure was too great and that he was considering driving for ride-hailing as a stopgap. Song Yajing wanted to comfort him, but found her own anxieties equally hard to relieve, so in the end she just silently held his hand. After returning home, for the first time she sincerely prayed for a friend, and felt an indescribable sense of responsibility.

name: The couple discussed the family budget and education savings.
description: On the evening of March 25, after their daughter fell asleep, Song Yajing and her husband Chen Zhiqiang checked the family's income and expenses for the month in the study. They found that after the shop's business loan hit a setback, cash flow was tight, and their daughter's education expenses were urgent. Chen Zhiqiang took out his pay stub, and together they made a new savings plan: set aside 2,000 yuan from Chen Zhiqiang's salary every month as an education fund and cut non-essential expenses. This was the first time the two had planned family finances so formally together. They felt pressure, but it also made them more united. The next day, they began taking concrete actions to cut expenses.

After discussing, they decided to set aside a fixed 2,000 yuan from his monthly salary as an education fund, and listed specific items for cutting non-essential expenses (such as ordering less takeout and postponing non-urgent purchases). This was the first time the couple had planned their finances together so formally; although they felt pressure, it brought them closer.

name: Supplier color difference dispute and response to the store-closure crisis
description: On April 10, Song Yajing confirmed the spring clothing order with supplier Susan, requiring shipment before April 13. On April 13, when she received the goods, she found serious color differences in a batch of chiffon tops, and regular customer Vivian immediately returned them and complained. After contacting Susan and arguing, Song Yajing only got a 50% refund of the payment and no shipping costs. On April 14, facing the defective goods, Song Yajing seriously considered closing the store for the first time, and after confiding in her husband that evening, she broke down emotionally. On April 15, she went to the store to count inventory, assess losses, and consider supply chain adjustment plans. This crisis exposed the fragility of supply chain management and customer trust, prompting her to reflect on her business model.

Xiaomei took charge on her own for the first time, called three times for remote assistance, and in the end the transaction volume reached 80% of an ordinary day. When she returned to the shop in the evening to check the accounts, Song Yajing realized the feasibility of delegating authority. On May 2, the two held a brief wrap-up meeting, praised Xiaomei, and planned for future independent operations.

name: Same-city low-sugar cookies sustain a close friendship
description: At the end of the month, her best friend Li Meiling, overwhelmed by schoolwork and severe second-pregnancy symptoms, had not seen Song Yajing for over a month, only exchanging brief greetings on WeChat. Song Yajing realized friendship requires proactive effort, so she baked a tray of low-sugar cookies herself and sent them to Li Meiling's school via same-city courier. When Li Meiling received them the next day, she replied, "This is so you." The distance immediately melted away, and the friendship warmed up again through small, thoughtful gestures.

name: Contact suppliers remotely to finalize orders for the new summer collection
description: On the morning of May 8, while recuperating at home, Song Yajing first checked the sample materials for French floral dresses and lightweight sun-protection jackets sent by her supplier Susan on her phone. Then, in her study, she used WeChat to confirm details such as styles, sizes, prices, and logistics with Susan one by one, finally finalizing an order of 30 pieces with a total amount of about 6,000 yuan, and notifying Susan to prepare the formal order and invoice. Afterward, Song Yajing shared the order details, expected arrival time, and promotion suggestions with her store clerk Xiaomei, so that she could prepare for listing and sales in advance. This was the first time she had remotely completed a major purchasing decision after trying to delegate authority, verifying the feasibility of remote collaboration.

name: A full-body checkup found breast hyperplasia, and she returned to Quanzhou to recuperate.
description: On May 11, Song Yajing made an appointment for a full physical examination and arranged store affairs. The next day, accompanied by her husband Chen Zhiqiang, she completed the examination and was found to have mild breast hyperplasia. The doctor said it was related to emotional suppression. Song Yajing immediately called her elder sister Song Yawen to confide, and her sister suggested she return to Quanzhou to recuperate. That evening, after discussing with her husband, she decided to take the suggestion. On May 13, she booked a high-speed train ticket for the next day and informed her parents. On May 14, Song Yajing took the high-speed train back to Quanzhou. Her father picked her up at the station, and she reunited with her parents and discussed the recuperation plan.

subevent.name: Appointment and arrangement before the physical examination
subevent.description: Song Yajing called a comprehensive physical examination center in Xiamen one day in advance to book a full-body checkup, informed her husband Chen Zhiqiang of the accompanying plan, and adjusted the next day's store schedule, entrusting staff member Xiaomei with temporary daily reception duties.
subevent.location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City - home.

subevent.name: Went to the hospital for a full physical examination.
subevent.description: On the morning of May 12, Song Yajing, accompanied by her husband Chen Zhiqiang, arrived on time at the physical examination center of a Grade III Level A hospital in Xiamen and completed a full set of health check-up items, including routine blood tests, B-ultrasound, and breast color ultrasound.
subevent.location: Physical Examination Center of a Class 3A Hospital, Xiamen, Fujian Province

subevent.name: Listen to the doctor explain the physical examination report
subevent.description: After the physical exam results came out, the doctor told Song Yajing that, besides the known low blood sugar, mild breast hyperplasia was newly discovered. The doctor clearly told her that this condition was closely related to long-term emotional suppression, and she needed to seriously adjust her mood and avoid anxiety.
subevent.location: Xiamen, Fujian - a doctor's office at a top-tier hospital

subevent.name: Calling her elder sister to confide the physical examination results
subevent.description: After getting the report, Song Yajing took the initiative to call her older sister Song Yawen and, choking up, told her about the physical examination results and the doctor's advice. Her sister comforted her softly and suggested, “If you're tired, come back to Quanzhou for a few days; I'll pay.” Both sisters choked up together.
subevent.location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City - at home or in the hospital corridor

subevent.name: Discussed the plan to return to Quanzhou with my husband.
subevent.description: That evening, Song Yajing told her husband Chen Zhiqiang about her sister's suggestion. The two discussed it together and decided to adopt it: Song Yajing would return to her parents' home in Quanzhou in the coming days for a period of rest, so as to adjust her mood and improve her health.
subevent.location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City - home.

subevent.name: Ordered a train ticket back to Quanzhou.
subevent.description: The next day, Song Yajing booked a bullet train ticket from Xiamen to Quanzhou through the 12306 mobile app (departing on the morning of May 14), and told her parents via WeChat that she would be coming home soon.
subevent.location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City - home.

subevent.location: Fujian Province, Quanzhou City - Licheng District, home

On the first day, she clumsily fell and scraped her knee, but she kept practicing. On the evening of July 26, she skated smoothly on her own for 3 kilometers home for the first time. Excitedly, she posted a helmet selfie in the community group with the caption: “I learned a new skill at the ripe old age of 38!”

subevent.name: First day practice: clumsy fall.

The first time (April 12) was on the beach at Huandao Road. Song Yajing's movements were stiff and she was resistant inside, but after the class her body felt relaxed. The second time (June 7) was at Bailuzhou Park; she gradually loosened up and joked that she was like a piece of wood. Although she still doesn't enjoy exercise, she experienced the joy of trying something new.

name: The whole family jointly builds a mini herb garden on the balcony
description: On Saturday morning, June 14, neighbor Aunt Zhang brought over a pot of mint. After drinking it, her daughter Xuanxuan really liked it. Song Yajing then bought basil and rosemary seeds and a long flowerpot online, and together with her husband Chen Zhiqiang and her daughter, she created a mini herb garden on the 5-square-meter south-facing balcony. The three divided the work: Xuanxuan was responsible for digging soil and burying seeds, Chen Zhiqiang installed the flowerpot brackets, and Song Yajing watered the plants and watched short videos to learn about water control and fertilization. At first, overwatering caused the mint to turn yellow and wilt, but after the whole family adjusted together, they gradually got the hang of it. Since then, Xuanxuan has gotten up early every day to water the plants, and the herb garden has become a new corner for family interaction.

She turned off notifications on her phone and, at the pottery studio, shaped a lopsided cup with unevenly thick walls. After firing, the glaze had a unique rustic charm. She took it home and put a small bunch of chamomile in it. When her husband Chen Zhiqiang came home from work and saw it, he said seriously, 'The one you made is far more interesting than a store-bought one.' His words warmed her heart and made her appreciate the unique value in imperfection.

In the evening of July 5, the whole family went for a walk along the beach on Huandao Road. Looking at her thin face, her father suddenly said, “You’ve lost weight. Don’t push yourself too hard.” Song Yajing’s eyes instantly filled with tears. She held her father’s arm tightly, feeling that she had owed her parents too much companionship over the years.

subevent.location: Xiamen – Siming Catholic Church

subevent.name: Conversation with Aunt Lin in the courtyard
subevent.description: After Mass, Song Yajing met Aunt Lin Xiuying, a fellow churchgoer, in the church courtyard. The two sat down to chat. Song Yajing shared recent worries about running the shop and family life, and Aunt Lin, speaking from experience, comforted and encouraged her.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Siming Catholic Church Courtyard

name: The whole family went to the cinema to watch the re-release of Inception.
description: On Monday afternoon, August 12, Song Yajing closed the shop early and went to Siming Wanda Cinema with her husband Chen Zhiqiang and daughter Chen Lexuan to watch the rerelease of Inception. It was their daughter's first time seeing a sci-fi film on the big screen; she asked excited questions throughout, and her husband answered patiently. After the movie, the family of three strolled around the mall and ate ice cream, spending a relaxed and pleasant afternoon. This movie outing allowed Song Yajing to temporarily set aside shop and family chores and enjoy a rare moment of family entertainment.

subevent.name: Close the store early to prepare
subevent.description: Song Yajing closed the boutique clothing store early in the afternoon, told shop assistant Xiao Mei to take the afternoon off, tidied up briefly, and locked the shop door.
subevent.location: Xiamen City, Siming District - Boutique clothing store on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street.

subevent.name: Heading to Wanda Cinema
subevent.description: Song Yajing walked or took a taxi from the store to Siming Wanda Cinema, while Chen Zhiqiang brought their daughter Chen Lexuan from home and they met at the cinema entrance.
subevent.location: Xiamen City, Siming District - Wanda Cinema

subevent.name: Ticket purchase and entry preparation.
subevent.description: The family of three picked up tickets at the self-service ticket machine at Wanda Cinema (or bought tickets on site), bought popcorn and drinks, then entered the auditorium and found their seats.
subevent.location: Xiamen City, Siming District - Wanda Cinema

subevent.name: Watch the movie 'Inception'.
subevent.description: The family watched the re-release of Inception in the theater. The daughter, watching a sci-fi film on the big screen for the first time, asked questions excitedly throughout; the husband answered patiently, and Song Yajing enjoyed the rare movie time.
subevent.location: Siming District, Xiamen - Wanda Cinema screening hall

subevent.name: Went shopping after the event.
subevent.description: After the movie ended, the family of three strolled around Wanda Mall, visiting clothing stores, toy stores, and so on. The daughter was very interested in the amusement facilities in the mall.
subevent.location: Siming District, Xiamen City - Wanda Mall

subevent.name: Eating ice cream
subevent.description: The family bought ice cream at a dessert shop in the mall, chatted about the movie plot while eating, and spent a relaxed and happy afternoon.
subevent.location: Dessert shop, Wanda Mall, Siming District, Xiamen

name: Organize vaccination records and prepare enrollment materials
description: On the afternoon of July 23, Song Yajing took her daughter's vaccination record booklet and household registration book out of the file cabinet, photographed every page of the vaccination records and saved them to her phone's album, and made two photocopies with the printer as backup. Then she put the original and copies of the vaccination records, the household registration book, birth certificate, and other enrollment materials into a document folder, preparing for the elementary school registration at the end of August. Finally, she took a screenshot of her daughter's health record page in the parenting app and sent it to her parents in Quanzhou via WeChat to let them know everything was fine.

subevent.name: Take out the vaccination record and household registration booklet.
subevent.description: She took her daughter's vaccination record and household registration booklet, along with other documents needed for school enrollment, out of the home file cabinet and put them on the desk for the next steps.
subevent.location: Home, Hubin South Road, Xiamen, Fujian Province

subevent.name: Take photos to store vaccination records
subevent.description: Used the phone camera to take photos of her daughter's vaccination record book page by page and saved them in the "Important Documents" folder in the phone album as an electronic backup.
subevent.location: Home, Hubin South Road, Xiamen, Fujian Province

subevent.name: Copy the vaccination records for backup.
subevent.description: Use the home printer to print two copies of the vaccination record to ensure complete paper backups, one as a spare and the other possibly for school submission.
subevent.location: Home, Hubin South Road, Xiamen, Fujian Province

subevent.name: Organize school enrollment materials
subevent.description: Put the original and photocopy of the photographed vaccination record together with the household registration booklet, birth certificate, and other materials needed for primary school registration into one document folder for use at the end of August.
subevent.location: Home, Hubin South Road, Xiamen, Fujian Province

subevent.name: Took a screenshot and sent it to her parents to let them know she was safe.
subevent.description: Screenshot the page of her daughter's health records in the parenting app and send it to her parents in Quanzhou (Song Minghui and Lin Xiuying) via WeChat, letting them know the child's vaccination records have been sorted out so the elderly couple can be reassured.
subevent.location: Home, Hubin South Road, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Go to Guangzhou to purchase new autumn merchandise
description: From August 3 to 5, Song Yajing went to the Shisanhang Clothing Wholesale Market in Guangzhou, accompanied by supplier Su Shan, and selected more than 30 styles of autumn women's clothing, including knit sweaters, trench coats, and skirts. She also negotiated bulk discounts and logistics arrangements on the spot. During the trip, she stopped by the Guangzhou International Apparel and Accessories Expo to learn about the season's fashion trends, laying a foundation for the store's autumn/winter product selection.

subevent.name: Pre-departure preparations and itinerary confirmation.
subevent.description: Song Yajing packed her luggage at home, sorted out her shopping list, confirmed the meeting time and place for August 3 with Guangzhou supplier Susan via WeChat, and booked a high-speed rail ticket from Xiamen to Guangzhou.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Home

subevent.name: Travel from Xiamen to Guangzhou and conduct a preliminary inspection
subevent.description: Song Yajing took an early high-speed train from Xiamen to Guangzhou. In the afternoon, she went to Shisanhang Wholesale Market to meet Susan, visited several familiar stalls, and got an initial understanding of the new autumn styles on the shelves.
subevent.location: Guangzhou - Shisanhang Clothing Wholesale Market

subevent.name: Centralized procurement of new autumn products
subevent.description: Accompanied by Susan, Song Yajing spent the whole day at Shisanhang Market selecting more than 30 styles of autumn women's clothing, including knitwear, trench coats, and midi skirts, and negotiated bulk discounts and shipping logistics arrangements with suppliers one by one.
subevent.location: Guangzhou - Shisanhang Clothing Wholesale Market

subevent.name: Visit the Guangzhou International Garment and Accessories Expo and return.
subevent.description: In the morning, Song Yajing went alone to the Pazhou Exhibition Center to visit the Guangzhou International Clothing and Accessories Expo, learning about the season's fashion trends and design elements; in the afternoon, she took the high-speed rail back to Xiamen and arrived home in the evening.
subevent.location: Guangzhou - Pazhou International Exhibition Center

subevent.name: After returning, organized and arranged the shelving
subevent.description: Song Yajing sorted and categorized the sample items she had purchased, checked the order details, and arranged for the store clerk Xiaomei to do inventory entry and display preparation, planning for the fall new arrivals.
subevent.location: Xiamen – Boutique Clothing Store

name: Quarterly creative exchange with Lin Wei
description: On September 24, Song Yajing made a WeChat video call with Lin Wei during her lunch break to fulfill their quarterly exchange agreement. Lin Wei shared her latest watercolor flower works, and Song Yajing sent photos of the newly developed Minnan cake and the shop's autumn window display design. The two encouraged each other's creative work. Lin Wei suggested incorporating hand-drawn elements into the cake packaging, which inspired Song Yajing. This cross-field exchange made her more perceptive about color and composition.

subevent.name: Prepared quarterly communication materials.
subevent.description: In the morning, Song Yajing baked a new sample of Minnan cake for herself and used her phone to take photos of the shop's autumn window display design, preparing for the quarterly exchange with Lin Wei during her lunch break.
subevent.location: Xiamen - home kitchen

subevent.name: Quarterly creative video exchange with Lin Wei
subevent.description: During lunch break, Song Yajing and Lin Wei had a WeChat video call to fulfill their quarterly exchange agreement. Lin Wei showed her latest watercolor flower works, and Song Yajing shared photos of Minnan rice cakes and autumn window display designs. They encouraged each other, and Lin Wei suggested incorporating hand-drawn elements into the pastry packaging.
subevent.location: Xiamen - Boutique clothing store rest area

subevent.name: Organize the inspiration from the exchange and follow-up actions.
subevent.description: After the video call, Song Yajing noted Lin Wei's suggestion to incorporate hand-drawn elements into pastry packaging in the store notebook, and thought about how to apply the new inspiration to the store's autumn promotional packaging design.
subevent.location: Xiamen – Boutique Clothing Store

name: Parent-child cycling in the park and outdoor activities.
description: On Saturday, August 30, taking advantage of the fine weather, Song Yajing and her husband took their daughter Chen Lexuan to Bailuzhou Park in Xiamen to ride bicycles. Her husband taught their daughter how to keep her balance, while Song Yajing took photos and recorded the moment. The three also had a picnic on the lawn, sharing homemade fruit salad and sandwiches. The daughter happily chased butterflies, and Song Yajing felt that the family's close bond was strengthened through outdoor activities, which also made up for her guilt over spending less time with her daughter due to her busy work.

subevent.name: Prepare picnic and cycling supplies
subevent.description: Song Yajing and her husband Chen Zhiqiang prepared picnic food in the home kitchen, including homemade fruit salad and sandwiches, and checked their daughter's bicycle, helmet and other cycling gear before packing them into a backpack.
subevent.location: Xiamen - home kitchen

subevent.name: Drive to Egret Island Park
subevent.description: The family of three brought a picnic basket and bicycles. Chen Zhiqiang drove the family car from their home on Hubin South Road to Bailuzhou Park in Siming District, Xiamen, about a 15-minute drive.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Bailuzhou Park

subevent.name: Daughter's bike-riding practice
subevent.description: Chen Zhiqiang taught 5-year-old Chen Lexuan to ride a bicycle hands-on in the park clearing, helping her keep her balance and encouraging her to try boldly; Song Yajing stood by using her phone to capture the warm moment.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Bailuzhou Park Cycling Path

subevent.name: Lawn picnic and parent-child interaction
subevent.description: The family of three spread a picnic blanket on the lawn and shared the salad and sandwiches Song Yajing had made. Their daughter happily ate fruit and chased butterflies among the flowers, while Song Yajing and her husband sat side by side chatting.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Bailuzhou Park Lawn

subevent.name: Packed up and headed home.
subevent.description: After the afternoon activities ended, the family cleaned up the picnic trash, folded the picnic mat, loaded the bicycles back into the trunk, and drove back to their home on Hubin South Road.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Bailuzhou Park / Home

name: Store typhoon emergency response
description: On the morning of August 8, the Xiamen Meteorological Observatory issued an orange typhoon warning. After receiving it, Song Yajing immediately decided to suspend business to prepare for the typhoon. She and her shop assistant Xiaomei set up a notice sign and evacuated customers. Then she reinforced the shop windows with windproof boards, raised the electronic equipment and inventory off the floor, and sealed the gap under the door with sandbags. Finally, she turned off the power and left the shop.

subevent.name: Received an orange typhoon warning.
subevent.description: On the morning of August 8, 2025, Song Yajing learned from the weather app on her phone and the warning notice from the Xiamen Meteorological Observatory that Typhoon "Haiou" would make landfall in the evening, and immediately decided to suspend business and reinforce the store against the typhoon.
subevent.location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen City.

subevent.name: Suspend business and evacuate customers
subevent.description: Song Yajing and shop assistant Xiaomei placed a temporarily closed sign at the store entrance and guided customers who were shopping inside to leave safely, explaining the typhoon warning situation.
subevent.location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen City.

subevent.name: Reinforce the shop window with windproof boards.
subevent.description: Song Yajing and Xiaomei moved out the pre-prepared windbreak boards from the warehouse and used screws and tape to firmly secure the shop's street-facing display windows to prevent the typhoon from shattering the glass.
subevent.location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen City.

subevent.name: Raise the electronic equipment and inventory in the store
subevent.description: Song Yajing moved electronic devices such as the cash register and computer to higher shelves, while Xiaomei moved boxes of new clothing to the middle and upper storage shelves and covered them with waterproof cloth to prevent damage from rainwater backflow.
subevent.location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen City.

subevent.name: Use sandbags to seal the gap under the door.
subevent.description: Song Yajing and Xiaomei tightly stacked the sandbags they had prepared in advance to seal the gap at the bottom of the shop entrance, preventing rainwater from seeping in through the door crack.
subevent.location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen City.

subevent.name: Turned off the store's power and evacuated.
subevent.description: After all reinforcement work was completed, Song Yajing and Xiaomei checked and confirmed everything was in order, turned off the store's main power, locked the door, and quickly left the shop to return to their respective homes for safety.
subevent.location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen City.

name: Discuss and purchase bank wealth management products and adjust the savings plan
description: On the evening of August 11, Song Yajing discussed with her husband Chen Zhiqiang at home and decided to take 20,000 yuan from the family safety fund to buy low-risk wealth management products, and transfer the monthly 2,000 yuan savings into a money market fund. On the morning of August 12, she went to the Siming Branch of ICBC. After consulting with account manager Lin Xiaofeng, she purchased a 20,000-yuan wealth management product with a 6-month term and an annualized return of 3.2%, and set up the money market fund transfer. That evening, she updated the family financial records at home.

subevent.name: Discussed the family financial plan with her husband.
subevent.description: On the evening of August 11, Song Yajing discussed matters with her husband Chen Zhiqiang at home and decided to withdraw 20,000 yuan from the family emergency fund to purchase low-risk wealth management products, and adjusted the monthly savings allocation, transferring 2,000 yuan into a money market fund.
subevent.location: Siming District, Xiamen - living room at home

subevent.name: Go to the ICBC Siming Sub-branch
subevent.description: On the morning of August 12, Song Yajing walked to the ICBC Siming Sub-branch in Siming District, preparing to handle wealth management business.
subevent.location: Siming District, Xiamen - ICBC Siming Sub-branch

subevent.name: Consulting about wealth management products and emergency savings plans.
subevent.description: On the morning of August 12, at the ICBC Siming Sub-branch, Song Yajing consulted account manager Lin Xiaofeng about low-risk wealth management products. Manager Lin introduced several products and a family emergency savings plan. Song Yajing decided on the spot to buy a 20,000-yuan wealth management product with a 6-month term and an annualized return of 3.2%, and to transfer 2,000 yuan from her monthly savings into a money market fund.
subevent.location: Siming District, Xiamen - ICBC Siming Sub-branch Wealth Management Room

subevent.name: Handle the purchase of wealth management products and adjustment of money market funds.
subevent.description: On the morning of August 12, after consultation and confirmation, Song Yajing, assisted by Manager Lin at the bank counter, completed the purchase procedures for a 20,000-yuan wealth management product and the transfer setup for her money market fund account.
subevent.location: Siming District, Xiamen - ICBC Siming Sub-branch counter

subevent.name: Updated family financial records.
subevent.description: On the evening of August 12, after returning home, Song Yajing recorded in detail the amounts, terms, and maturity dates of this wealth management purchase and money market fund adjustment in her ledger, and updated the family's monthly savings plan.
subevent.location: Siming District, Xiamen City - home study

name: Held a 5th birthday party for daughter Chen Lexuan
description: In early July, Song Yajing brought her parents to Xiamen to help take care of her daughter. On July 16 she invited relatives and friends, and on July 20 she decorated the home venue and successfully held her daughter's 5th birthday party. Kindergarten friends, family, church friends, and neighbors were invited. Activities included singing the birthday song, opening gifts, and parent-child games. Song Yajing personally baked a tiramisu cake and made fruit tea. After the party, the whole family cleaned up together.

subevent.name: Bringing parents to Xiamen for the summer vacation
subevent.description: Song Yajing drove to her parents' home in Quanzhou, picked up her father Song Minghui and mother Lin Xiuying, and returned together to her home in Xiamen to prepare for the summer together and for her daughter's birthday.
subevent.location: No. 45 Xinhua North Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou City, to No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen.

subevent.name: Invite relatives and friends and confirm attendance
subevent.description: Song Yajing invited, one by one via WeChat and phone, her daughter's kindergarten friends, family members (including her parents, who had already been brought to her home), and close church friends and neighbors, confirming that they would attend the July 19 party and counting the number of guests.
subevent.location: No. 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen - home

subevent.name: Set up the party space at home
subevent.description: Song Yajing, her husband Chen Zhiqiang, and her parents decorated the living room and dining room with balloons, ribbons, and a birthday banner, set up tables and chairs, and prepared tableware and party game props.
subevent.location: No. 128, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen - home living room and dining room

subevent.name: Held her daughter's birthday party
subevent.description: Held a 5th birthday party at home for her daughter Chen Lexuan. Relatives and friends attended, with activities such as singing the birthday song, eating cake, opening gifts, and parent-child games. Song Yajing personally baked a tiramisu cake and prepared fruit tea.
subevent.location: No. 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen - home

subevent.name: Party cleanup and wrapping up
subevent.description: After the party, Song Yajing and her family cleaned up the tableware, disposed of the trash, put the furniture back in place, sorted the gifts received, and wrote down thank-you messages.
subevent.location: No. 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen - home

name: Independently promoted improvement of nighttime lighting in the community and installed a smart doorbell.
description: Because Li Meiling had severe pregnancy sickness, the community patrol team was suspended this month. On August 20, Song Yajing alone suggested in the owners' group that nighttime lighting in the residential complex should be improved, and she proactively contacted the property management to discuss installation, winning support from neighbors. At the end of the month, on August 28, she installed a smart doorbell at home to enhance security. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang voluntarily took on the testing task and shared remote access to the doorbell feed with his parents in Quanzhou, so they could check anytime, giving the whole family more peace of mind when out.

subevent.name: Owners' group proposed improving lighting.
subevent.description: Because her close friend Li Meiling could not join the patrol due to pregnancy sickness, Song Yajing went to the community owners' group on her own and proposed strengthening nighttime lighting in the residential area to improve safety, attaching specific suggestions.
subevent.location: At home on Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen (operated by mobile phone)

subevent.name: Neighbor responds and confirms the lighting plan
subevent.description: Led by Song Yajing, several neighbors responded with support in the group chat. After completing an on-site inspection, the property management consulted with homeowner representatives (including Song Yajing) and confirmed the plan to install several additional streetlights.
subevent.location: Siming District, Xiamen - Hubin South Road community owners' group / residential common area

subevent.name: Purchased a smart doorbell.
subevent.description: To enhance home security, Song Yajing ordered a smart doorbell with remote viewing on an e-commerce platform and selected next-day delivery.
subevent.location: Home on Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen (online shopping).

subevent.name: Install the smart doorbell and test sharing
subevent.description: After receiving the smart doorbell, Song Yajing and her husband Chen Zhiqiang installed it together. Chen Zhiqiang tested the doorbell functions and the phone app connection, then shared remote access with their parents in Quanzhou (Song Minghui, Lin Xiuying), allowing the whole family to check the door area at any time.
subevent.location: At the doorstep of home, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen

name: Zhao Li’s mother had a stroke, and Song Yajing gave her full support and stayed up late chatting with her to get through the crisis.
description: On August 16, Zhao Li's mother suddenly had a stroke and was hospitalized, leaving her floral design studio unattended. Without a word, Song Yajing lent her clerk Xiaomei to Zhao Li for half a day that very day, covered the shop herself, and urgently mobilized her community groups to help Zhao Li share the pre-sale of flower bouquets to maintain cash flow. For the next two weeks, she went to Zhao Li's studio after work every night to help trim flower stems until ten, her hands covered with scratches from rose thorns. One night, the two talked until past midnight in a room full of flowers. Zhao Li, eyes reddened, revealed that her husband might not be transferred back to Xiamen and that she was considering divorce. Song Yajing did not try to persuade her; she simply stayed with her in silence, recalling her own marital hardships and understanding all the more a friend's duty not to question in times of crisis.

subevent.name: Emergency response and same-day support.
subevent.description: After learning that Zhao Li's mother had suffered a stroke, Song Yajing immediately lent her employee Xiaomei to Zhao Li for half a day that day, covered the shop herself, and urgently mobilized her community to help Zhao Li forward the pre-sale information for flower bouquets to maintain cash flow for her studio.
subevent.location: Xiamen - Shop 36 on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street and online communities

subevent.name: Two consecutive weeks of nighttime help and emotional support.
subevent.description: Starting from August 17, Song Yajing went to Zhao Li's flower studio after work every evening for two consecutive weeks to help trim flower branches and organize materials. She often worked until 10 PM, and her hands were pricked by rose thorns. During this period, the two frequently talked in depth during breaks. One night, Zhao Li poured out her marital troubles, and Song Yajing quietly stayed by her side, providing emotional support.
subevent.location: Xiamen – Zhao Li Floral Studio

subevent.name: First Week of Nighttime Help
subevent.description: For several consecutive evenings after work, she hurried to Zhao Li's floral studio to help trim flower branches and arrange floral materials, often staying busy until ten at night, and her hands were pricked by rose thorns. She and Zhao Li exchanged brief everyday conversation during work breaks.
subevent.location: Xiamen – Zhao Li Floral Studio

subevent.name: Late at night, listened to Zhao Li pour out her marital difficulties.
subevent.description: After the helping was over, Zhao Li was feeling down. Song Yajing stayed with her in the studio to rest. Zhao Li poured out her marital difficulties, and Song Yajing listened patiently and gave her emotional support, leaving only late at night.
subevent.location: Xiamen – Zhao Li Floral Studio

subevent.name: Second week: helped in the evenings and continued to encourage.
subevent.description: Continue going to the studio every evening to help, deliberately staying longer to keep Zhao Li company, encouraging her amid the busyness, sharing her own experience in managing a family, and showing support through action.
subevent.location: Xiamen – Zhao Li Floral Studio

subevent.name: Follow-up care and deepening friendship.
subevent.description: After the emergency support phase ended, Song Yajing called Zhao Li to ask about her mother's recovery, and they agreed to stay in touch. Having gone through this difficult time together, their friendship grew even deeper.
subevent.location: Xiamen - Song Yajing's home

name: Celebrated her father’s birthday via video call, a warm family exchange.
description: August 15 was the 63rd birthday of her father, Song Minghui. Song Yajing used her lunch break to video-call her parents and gave him a carefully selected polo shirt as a gift. Her father told her to take care of her health and keep a calm mindset, while her mother shared her recent baking insights. On the video call, the family was harmonious and joyful, and Song Yajing felt her parents' unconditional support and love, filling her heart with warmth.

subevent.name: Choose a birthday gift for my father
subevent.description: Song Yajing used her afternoon break to carefully select a dark blue polo shirt as a birthday gift for her father Song Minghui at a men's clothing store on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, knowing that her father prefers a low-key and steady style.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Siming District - Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

subevent.name: Video-call her parents to celebrate her father's birthday
subevent.description: During the lunch break, Song Yajing video-called her parents in faraway Quanzhou via WeChat from the store's rest area, showing and giving them the POLO shirts she had prepared in advance. Her father reminded her to take care of herself and maintain a calm mindset, while her mother shared baking tips. The family atmosphere was warm.
subevent.location: Xiamen - Siming District - Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street (inside a boutique clothing store)

name: Shop assistant Xiaomei officially signed a long-term contract and is learning management matters.
description: On September 22, staff member Xiaomei officially signed a long-term contract. Song Yajing began to teach her bookkeeping and ordering processes step by step, and promised her a year-end bonus. Watching Xiaomei skillfully greet customers, Song Yajing was reminded of herself when she first entered the workplace in early 2009, and was overcome with emotion. That night, she wrote a diary entry, Ten Years, recording the milestone of nurturing her team and the shift in her own role.

subevent.name: Preparing the contract for signing and communicating the intent to sign
subevent.description: Before opening the store, Song Yajing prepared the long-term labor contract documents and communicated with store clerk Xiaomei to confirm the signing details.
subevent.location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Formally signed a long-term employment contract
subevent.description: In the shop, Song Yajing and Xiaomei formally signed a long-term labor contract, clarifying the rights and responsibilities of both parties and the year-end bonus terms.
subevent.location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Teaching the bookkeeping and ordering process
subevent.description: After signing the contract, Song Yajing walked Xiaomei through the specific procedures for daily store bookkeeping and ordering from suppliers.
subevent.location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Observed Xiaomei serving customers and was moved by her growth.
subevent.description: Song Yajing watched from the side as Xiaomei skillfully attended to customers, recalling her own experience of first entering the workplace in 2009 and reflecting on her role transition from employee to manager.
subevent.location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Wrote a diary entry titled 'Ten Years' to record the team's milestone.
subevent.description: That evening, in her home study, Song Yajing wrote a diary entry titled "Ten Years," recording the milestone of the team nurturing Xiaomei into a long-term core member, along with her own mental journey from being an employee to becoming an entrepreneur.
subevent.location: Home, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen

name: Helped her daughter through the school adjustment period and shared picture book insights in the community group.
description: On September 1, her daughter Xuanxuan officially started kindergarten. For the first week, she cried every day and refused to enter the school gate. Song Yajing accompanied her patiently, and the two of them read the picture book "The Kissing Hand" at the school gate, agreeing that a kiss on the palm would keep her from being afraid. Xuanxuan gradually adjusted after three days. On September 3, Song Yajing shared this picture book and her own reflections in the community group, which caused the mothers to collectively recall their anxiety about starting school, and they shared tips and encouraged each other, making the community atmosphere warm.

subevent.name: First day of school drop-off: reading a picture book to comfort her daughter.
subevent.description: On the morning of September 1, Song Yajing took her daughter Chen Lexuan to the kindergarten gate. The daughter cried from separation anxiety and refused to go in. Song Yajing squatted down, took out the picture book The Kissing Hand, told her daughter the story, and they agreed that she would kiss her daughter's palm, so that whenever she missed her mother, she could feel the love in the palm of her hand. The daughter felt a little reassured, wiped away her tears, and walked into the kindergarten.
subevent.location: At the entrance of Experimental Kindergarten, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: After school on the first day: review and encouragement.
subevent.description: After school in the evening, Song Yajing picked up Xuanxuan and went home, proactively asking about her feelings on the first day of school. Xuanxuan said that when she missed her mother, she pressed her palm to her cheek and felt much better. Song Yajing hugged her and praised her for being brave. Mother and daughter recalled the promise from 'The Kissing Hand' and agreed to keep using this 'magic' tomorrow.
subevent.location: Siming District, Xiamen - living room at home

subevent.name: Second-day school drop-off: continued reassurance and adjustment
subevent.description: On the morning of September 2, Xuanxuan was still briefly anxious at the school gate but no longer cried loudly. Song Yajing took out "The Kissing Hand" again to encourage her, reminded her daughter of yesterday's success, and kissed her palm again. After hesitating for a moment, Xuanxuan proactively reached out to accept the 'magic' and walked into the school gate herself, her mood visibly improving.
subevent.location: At the entrance of Experimental Kindergarten, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: After school the next day: witnessing progress
subevent.description: After picking up her daughter in the evening, Song Yajing noticed that Xuanxuan was clearly in a relaxed mood and took the initiative to talk about fun things at kindergarten. Song Yajing praised her daughter's progress that day and told her that she had adapted halfway, and with one more day of persistence, she would be fully adapted. The mother and daughter revisited the promise of The Kissing Hand.
subevent.location: Siming District, Xiamen - living room at home

subevent.name: Third day of school drop-off: fully adapted
subevent.description: On the morning of September 3, Xuanxuan voluntarily performed the 'kiss the palm' ritual with her mother at the school gate. She no longer cried or made a fuss. She waved goodbye confidently and walked straight into the school. Song Yajing stood at the gate watching her, full of relief, and confirmed that her daughter had successfully gotten through the school adjustment period.
subevent.location: At the entrance of Experimental Kindergarten, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Shared the picture book "The Kissing Hand" and reflections in the community.
subevent.description: On the evening of September 3, Song Yajing shared the picture book 'The Kissing Hand' in the mothers' WeChat group, along with her real experiences and reflections from three days of accompanying her daughter as she adjusted to school. She described in detail the process of reading the picture book, the palm-kissing ritual, and her daughter's transition from crying to settling in. The mothers in the group all resonated with the post, recalling their own children's separation anxiety on starting school. They shared tips and encouraged one another, and the community atmosphere was warm and lively.
subevent.location: Siming District, Xiamen - at home, in front of the phone

name: Balcony herb harvest: from cooking to sharing with the community.
description: In mid-July, the basil and rosemary were thriving. She successfully made pesto pasta for her family with the basil, and the rosemary-roasted potatoes were also a big hit with her daughter. At the same time, she put the clipped mint leaves at the store's drink corner for free use, and fresh mint tea became a summer favorite for several regular customers. In early August, she went further by dividing the extra herb seedlings into small potted plants and giving them to active community members, along with handwritten care cards. This unexpectedly sparked a "Balcony Spring Scenery" sign-up relay in the group, which both strengthened community bonds and helped her regain a sense of control and peace from the soil.

subevent.name: Picked fresh basil and rosemary.
subevent.description: In mid-July, the herbs on the balcony were growing well. Song Yajing picked basil leaves and rosemary sprigs in the early morning to prepare fresh ingredients for home cooking.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Siming District - home balcony

subevent.name: Made pesto pasta with basil for the family
subevent.description: Song Yajing made pesto with fresh basil leaves picked that day, along with pine nuts, garlic, and olive oil, and cooked pesto pasta for her husband Chen Zhiqiang and daughter Chen Lexuan. The family tasted it and were full of praise.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Siming District - home kitchen

subevent.name: Rosemary roasted potatoes are greatly loved by her daughter.
subevent.description: Song Yajing roasted the rosemary sprigs she had picked together with potatoes as a side dish for dinner. Her 5-year-old daughter Chen Lexuan loved the dish and ate a lot, which made Song Yajing feel gratified.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Siming District - home kitchen

subevent.name: Put mint leaves in the shop's drink corner for customers to take free of charge.

It has become the store's signature summer drink, and Song Yajing keeps restocking mint leaves.

subevent.name: Brewed mint tea for a regular customer for the first time.
subevent.description: Song Yajing used the newly arrived mint leaves to brew mint tea for regular customers such as Vivian at the store, introduced its refreshing and heat-relieving benefits, and recorded the customers' feedback.
subevent.location: Shop No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: A regular customer visited again and highly recommended the mint tea.

subevent.location: Shop No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Replenished the mint leaf stock.

subevent.location: Xiamen City - Siming District - Farmers' Market

subevent.name: A new regular customer tries the mint tea.
subevent.description: At Vivian's recommendation, two regular customers came to the shop to taste mint tea. Song Yajing brewed it herself and introduced the source of the mint. The customers were very satisfied and planned to come regularly.

subevent.description: Vivian brought a close friend to the store. Song Yajing used chilled mint leaves to make iced mint tea. As they drank and chatted, the friend said she would buy mint leaves to make it at home.
subevent.location: Shop No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Organize mint tea bags and improve service.
subevent.description: Song Yajing washed and air-dried the remaining mint leaves, then packed them into small tea bags together with Xiaomei. She placed them at the counter for regular customers to take, and set up a daily limited-supply plan.
subevent.location: Shop No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.description: In early August, Song Yajing divided the overgrown basil, mint, and other herb seedlings on the balcony into small clay pots, and handwrote care cards for each plant, preparing for community sharing.
