subevent.name: Gift small herb potted plants to active community members and start a chain
subevent.description: Song Yajing brought the prepared small potted herb plants to the store and gave them to several active members who frequently interacted in the community (the store's customer WeChat group), along with care cards. This unexpectedly sparked a 'Balcony Spring Colors' themed chain in the group, with members posting photos of their houseplants, and the community atmosphere became lively.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Siming District - Shop No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street (and online community)

subevent.name: Planting and harvesting herbs on the balcony.
subevent.description: Since mid-July, Song Yajing has been tending herb plants on her balcony: on the morning of July 17, she watered them to kick off the herb season; on July 24, she pruned and cared for them; on August 1, she picked mint and rosemary to make desserts; and on August 10, she wrapped up and took stock. The whole process gave her a sense of tranquility and control from the earth, providing relaxation from running the store and family chores.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Siming District - home balcony

subevent.description: In the early morning, watered the herb plants on the balcony, checked the growth of new shoots, and spent 15 minutes enjoying the tranquility of soil and plants, starting the day with a relaxing ritual.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Siming District - home balcony

subevent.name: Regularly prune and tend the herbs.
subevent.description: During the morning free time, trim the overgrown leaves and branches of the herbs to promote ventilation and growth, remove dead leaves, and experience a sense of control and focus from caring for the plants.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Siming District - home balcony

subevent.name: Harvest vanilla and use it to make desserts
subevent.description: Picked ripe mint and rosemary from the balcony, tried making mint tiramisu and rosemary cookies in the kitchen, and enjoyed the joy of life and sense of accomplishment that herbs bring.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Siming District - home balcony and kitchen

subevent.name: Vanilla season wrap-up and summary.
subevent.description: Gave the balcony herbs a final trim, cleared away dead branches and fallen leaves, took photos to document their growth over the whole herb season, felt calm and fulfilled, and made plans for next season's planting.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Siming District - home balcony

name: Rationally declined store expansion and launched a family security fund savings plan.
description: On August 2, the landlord Sister Li brought a friend to view the shop and tactfully asked whether they would like to expand into the neighboring unit. That evening, Song Yajing and her husband did the math late into the night: their daughter's enrollment required reserving 100,000 yuan in working capital, the loan balance was still 60,000 yuan, and the travel fund had not yet been started. After weighing the options, they decided to politely decline. It was the first time she said 'no' to temptation, and instead she felt more at ease. Over the next few days, the couple discussed financial security. On August 5, they officially launched the 'Family Safety Fund' plan, saving a fixed 4,000 yuan every month, prioritized for emergencies rather than travel. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang supported her wholeheartedly and voluntarily handed over a portion of his salary (via his salary card) to join the savings, thus laying a foundation for the family's ability to withstand risks.

subevent.name: Landlord Sister Li suggested expanding the storefront.
subevent.description: The landlady, Sister Li, brought a friend to look at the shop and tactfully asked Song Yajing whether she would like to expand into the neighboring storefront. Song Yajing said she needed to think it over.
subevent.location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Late at night, the couple reviewed their household finances.
subevent.description: After the store closed that evening, Song Yajing and her husband Chen Zhiqiang carefully calculated the family's income and expenses in their home study, including the 100,000 yuan liquidity needed for their daughter's upcoming enrollment, the store loan balance of 60,000 yuan, and the not-yet-started travel fund, weighing the feasibility of expansion.
subevent.location: Home study, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Called the landlord to politely decline the expansion proposal.
subevent.description: After discussing with her husband, Song Yajing decided to politely decline the expansion. She called the landlord, Sister Li, and politely refused the proposal to lease the neighboring shop, citing financial pressure, and felt relieved inside.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Siming District - home

subevent.name: Officially launched the family security fund savings plan
subevent.description: Song Yajing and Chen Zhiqiang went to the bank together and set a monthly automatic transfer of 4,000 yuan into a dedicated account for the family security fund. Chen Zhiqiang voluntarily turned over part of his salary card and authorized automatic deductions, formally laying the foundation for the family's ability to withstand risks.
subevent.location: ICBC Siming Sub-branch, Siming District, Xiamen

name: Was added to the primary school classmates group and attended the graduation dinner.
description: On the evening of August 15, Song Yajing was added to an elementary school classmates’ WeChat group. The class monitor announced that a first post-graduation dinner would be organized on the 17th. She hesitated about whether to attend, but after discussing it with her husband, she decided to go. On the afternoon of the 17th, she closed the store early and took a taxi to Minweixuan Restaurant. She dined and caught up with more than twenty elementary school classmates, took the initiative to add classmates on WeChat, and stayed until around 9 p.m., when she went home with a classmate who lived in the same direction.

subevent.name: After discussing with her husband, she decided to accept the invitation.
subevent.description: Song Yajing took her phone and walked into the study to discuss the dinner gathering with her husband Chen Zhiqiang, who was working overtime. She expressed her concerns: she was worried about not having enough staff at the store on the 17th, having no one to pick up and drop off her daughter Lexuan, and feeling a little nervous about classmates she hadn't seen in years. Chen Zhiqiang encouraged her to relax, said he could take leave on the 17th to pick up and drop off their daughter, and suggested that she let Xiaomei take full charge of the store that day. Song Yajing's concerns were dispelled, and she replied in the group chat, 'I'll sign up, looking forward to seeing everyone.'
subevent.location: Home study, South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Attend the first post-graduation dinner gathering of primary school classmates.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of August 17, Song Yajing closed the shop early, changed into a carefully chosen dress, and took a taxi to a restaurant called 'Minweixuan' in Siming District. At the gathering, she saw more than twenty elementary school classmates she had not seen for nearly twenty years. Everyone recalled childhood fun and shared their recent news. Monitor Liu Fang (who had come specially from Shenzhen) warmly pulled her aside to catch up. Song Yajing felt very warm and took the initiative to add many classmates on WeChat. The meal lasted until nine in the evening, and she took a taxi home with several classmates who went the same way.
subevent.location: Siming District, Xiamen - Minweixuan Restaurant

name: Gathering courage to try diving
description: On August 9, Song Yajing made a reservation at a diving club near Wutong Wharf. On August 10, she went there and did her first dive under the guidance of a one-on-one instructor. She was awed by the underwater world. After coming ashore, she shared the photos with her husband, and spent the following two days recovering at home due to leg soreness.

subevent.name: Book a diving experience
subevent.description: Contacted a diving club near Wutong Wharf by phone, booked the discovery diving experience on August 10, and confirmed the time, price, and instructor arrangements.
subevent.location: Siming District, Xiamen - Home

subevent.name: Went to the diving club.
subevent.description: Take a taxi or drive to the diving club near Wutong Pier in Huli District, and check diving precautions on the way.
subevent.location: Xiamen - near Wutong Wharf

subevent.name: Going on a discovery scuba dive
subevent.description: Under the one-on-one guidance of a professional instructor, she put on diving gear, learned basic hand signals and breathing techniques, and dived under the sea for the first time to watch tropical fish and coral reefs. She overcame her fear and was amazed by the underwater world.
subevent.location: Diving club near Wutong Wharf, Huli District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Rest after going ashore and share photos
subevent.description: After diving ended, she changed and washed up in the club's rest area, then used her phone to send the underwater photos to her husband Chen Zhiqiang, excitedly sharing her diving experience and feelings.
subevent.location: Diving club near Wutong Wharf, Huli District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Recovering from body soreness after diving.
subevent.description: After the trial dive, her leg muscles felt sore from exertion, affecting her daily walking and climbing stairs; it gradually eased with hot water foot soaks and rest.
subevent.location: Siming District, Xiamen - Home

name: After her condition stabilized, Zhao Li designed the autumn window display for the shop and shared her confusion in the community.
description: On September 16, after her mother's condition stabilized, Zhao Li took the initiative to offer free design of an autumn window display for Yajing's shop, conveying autumn vibes with fallen leaves and warm tones. That evening, for the first time she opened up in the group chat about her confusion over divorce. Song Yajing replied immediately, “I support whatever decision you make,” and group members cheered her on, making Zhao Li feel the power of being accepted. The friendship between the two grew stronger through mutual support.

subevent.name: Zhao Li contacted Song Yajing to offer free window display design.
subevent.description: Because her mother's condition was stable, Zhao Li took the initiative to contact Song Yajing via WeChat and offered to design the store's autumn window display for free. The two agreed to meet at the store that afternoon.
subevent.location: Online - WeChat

subevent.name: Zhao Li and Song Yajing decorate the autumn window display together
subevent.description: Zhao Li brought homemade decorations made of fallen leaves and warm tones, and together with Song Yajing creatively arranged the shop window to convey an autumn atmosphere. They finished in the afternoon.
subevent.location: Xiamen - Zhongshan Road store

subevent.name: Zhao Li opened up about her divorce confusion in the community group
subevent.description: In the evening, Zhao Li for the first time publicly expressed in the shared WeChat group the confusion and helplessness brought by her divorce, seeking comfort from group members.
subevent.location: Online - WeChat community

subevent.name: Song Yajing replied in support of Zhao Li
subevent.description: After seeing Zhao Li's message, Song Yajing immediately replied, 'I support whatever decision you make,' giving her firm support.
subevent.location: Online - WeChat community

subevent.name: Group members all encouraged Zhao Li.
subevent.description: After seeing this, the other group members spoke up one after another to cheer Zhao Li on, making her feel the power of being accepted.
subevent.location: Online - WeChat community

name: Started commuting by electric scooter.
description: Starting in early August, Song Yajing began using an electric scooter for short commutes, going between the shop, the nearby bank, and stocking up on goods. Occasionally she would glide to the flower market 2 kilometers away to pick up special floral materials for Zhao Li. The experience of working up a slight sweat made her unexpectedly realize that light exercise could be this fun. Although she still wasn't a sports enthusiast, the scooter dissolved her anxiety of 'never having enough time' and turned commuting into short stretches of free time where she could listen to podcasts and get some air. This 'micro-control' quietly strengthened her confidence in rebuilding her life in the second half of the year.

subevent.name: Selected and purchased an electric scooter.
subevent.description: Song Yajing selected and purchased an electric scooter suitable for short commutes through an online e-commerce platform or a local sporting goods store.

subevent.description: Song Yajing practiced riding her electric scooter in the open area of the residential complex or in a nearby park, getting familiar with the controls, brakes, and balance to ensure a safe commute.

subevent.name: Used an electric scooter to commute to the shop for the first time.

subevent.description: Song Yajing was used to riding an electric scooter between the shop, nearby banks, and stocking up on goods. Occasionally she went to the flower market 2 kilometers away to pick up flower materials for friends. During commutes she listened to podcasts and enjoyed free time.

subevent.description: At a friend's request, Song Yajing rode an electric scooter to the flower market 2 kilometers away to pick up pre-ordered flowers, enjoying the ride and a podcast along the way.

subevent.name: Used an electric scooter to go to the wholesale market to buy goods.
subevent.description: Song Yajing used an electric scooter to go to the clothing wholesale market to purchase new styles for the store, efficiently completing the stocking and enjoying the freedom of commuting.

subevent.name: Experience the fun of exercising with a scooter.
subevent.description: During the evening commute, Song Yajing felt lightly sweaty and unexpectedly found the mild exercise of riding the scooter enjoyable; it dissolved her anxiety about time and increased her sense of control over life.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Siming District - Hubin South Road

name: Primary school classmate Liu Fang paid a surprise visit to Xiamen; reminiscing, they sighed about growing old in a foreign land.
description: On September 28, Liu Fang, a primary school classmate, suddenly visited Xiamen. Song Yajing took her around the shop and to eat satay noodles. The two talked about their years of drifting. Liu Fang sighed, "People of our generation all grow old in a foreign land." They took selfies together, and that evening Song Yajing posted on Moments: "Childhood companions, still sharing a stretch of the road as adults — that is already a blessing." The reunion of old friends brought them the warmth of mutual understanding in midlife.

subevent.name: Liu Fang notified her via WeChat that she would visit.
subevent.description: Liu Fang, a primary school classmate, told Song Yajing via WeChat that she had arrived in Xiamen, and they agreed to meet that day to catch up. The two briefly discussed the itinerary.
subevent.location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen (boutique clothing store)

subevent.name: Hosting Liu Fang for a store visit and catching up
subevent.description: Song Yajing received Liu Fang, who had dropped by unexpectedly, at her boutique clothing store. She showed her around the shop, shared stories and business insights since opening, and Liu Fang also talked about how things were going at her job in Shenzhen.
subevent.location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen (boutique clothing store)

subevent.name: Shared satay noodles and reflected on life away from home
subevent.description: Song Yajing took Liu Fang to a nearby time-honored satay noodle shop to taste the Minnan specialty satay noodles. The two talked about their experiences of drifting from Quanzhou and Shenzhen to live far from home. Liu Fang sighed, “Our generation grows old in a foreign place.” They found deep emotional resonance with each other.
subevent.location: Siming District, Xiamen - Time-honored Satay Noodle Shop

subevent.name: Taking a group photo and posting it on Moments
subevent.description: The two took selfies together on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street and in front of the shop as souvenirs. That evening, after organizing the photos, Song Yajing posted on Moments: "Childhood companions, still walking the same path for a while as adults—that is already a blessing." She recorded this warm reunion.
subevent.location: Siming District, Xiamen - Home

name: Older sister Song Yawen returned to Xiamen; the sisters got their hair done and had dinner together, letting go of past grievances
description: On August 22, her elder sister Song Yawen returned to Xiamen from Shenzhen and met her younger sister Song Yajing at home. Her sister commented, 'There's not as much fire in your eyes anymore, but there's a bit more water — that's nice.' The sisters then went to a hair salon in Siming District. Song Yajing had her long hair, which she had kept for years, cut to shoulder length, saying lightly, 'Less time blow-drying my hair.' After the haircut, the two had dinner at a restaurant near Zhongshan Road. Recalling the past, Song Yajing let go of her past conflicts and stress, and felt a sense of lightness and growth.

subevent.name: Song Yawen, her elder sister, arrived in Xiamen, and the sisters met and talked
subevent.description: Song Yawen returned to Xiamen from Shenzhen and met with her younger sister Song Yajing. During their conversation, Song Yawen noticed the change in Song Yajing and commented, "There isn't as much fire in your eyes anymore, but there's a bit more water. That's good." Song Yajing felt her sister's affirmation and concern.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Siming District - home

subevent.name: The friends went to the hairdresser together, and Song Yajing had her long hair cut.
subevent.description: The two sisters agreed to meet at a hair salon in Siming District. Song Yajing had her long hair, which she had kept for years, cut to shoulder length, saying lightly, "Less time drying my hair." The haircut symbolized saying goodbye to her tense self, and her elder sister's company made the moment even more meaningful.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - a barbershop in Siming District.

subevent.name: After the haircut, the sisters had dinner together and made peace with the past
subevent.description: After getting their hair cut, the sisters had dinner together at a restaurant near Zhongshan Road. Looking back on old times, Song Yajing let go of past entanglements and pressure, feeling light inside and a sense of growth.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - a restaurant on Zhongshan Road, Siming District

name: Autumn new-arrival ordering communication and preparation.
description: On September 3, Song Yajing compiled autumn product selection needs based on sales data and customer feedback, and made a video appointment with Guangzhou supplier Susan via WeChat for the next day. On September 4, Song Yajing held a video meeting with Susan, selected 20 styles of women's clothing (including new Chinese style and modernized qipao), confirmed delivery times and discounts, and then informed shop assistant Xiao Mei of the display and promotion arrangements after arrival.

subevent.name: Organize autumn product selection requirements.
subevent.description: Song Yajing compiled a selection requirements list for the new autumn women's wear based on the shop's summer sales data and customer feedback, combined with local fashion trends, to prepare for her meeting with Susan.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - inside a boutique clothing store

subevent.name: Schedule a video conference
subevent.description: Song Yajing contacted supplier Susan via WeChat and scheduled a video conference for the morning of September 4 to order the new autumn collection.

subevent.name: Attended the video conference for ordering the new autumn collection.
subevent.description: Song Yajing connected with Susan, her supplier in Guangzhou, via WeChat video at the store. Susan showed the new season's design drafts and samples. Song Yajing selected 20 women's clothing items from the list, including new Chinese-style pieces and modernized cheongsams, and confirmed the delivery time and discount.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - inside a boutique clothing store

subevent.name: Notify staff of the new product arrival arrangements
subevent.description: After completing the order, Song Yajing informed the shop assistant Xiaomei about the fall new product orders and planned the display and promotion arrangements after the goods arrived.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - inside a boutique clothing store

name: Baking with her mother and reliving the flavors of childhood.
description: On the morning of July 10, before the shop's lunch break, Song Yajing went to the food market to buy ingredients such as rice flour and glutinous rice flour, then returned home to make Fuling cake, a traditional Minnan pastry, with her mother Lin Xiuying in the kitchen. Her mother guided her step by step in mixing the rice flour proportions, and as they worked, they chatted about funny stories of her sweet tooth as a child. The steamed cakes were fragrant, and the mother and daughter tasted them in the living room while reminiscing about warm memories. In the afternoon, Song Yajing brought some packed Fuling cakes to share with the shop assistant Xiaomei, strengthening their bond. This close mother-daughter time gave her a long-lost sense of stability and happiness.

subevent.name: Buy Poria cake ingredients.
subevent.description: During the free time before the shop's lunch break, Song Yajing went to the vegetable market near her home to buy the ingredients needed for making Fuling cake, including rice flour, glutinous rice flour, sugar, and Fuling powder, in preparation for making the traditional pastry together with her mother.
subevent.location: Xiamen City, Siming District - Hubin South Road Vegetable Market

subevent.name: Making Poria cake with her mother
subevent.description: Song Yajing and her mother Lin Xiuying made the traditional Minnan snack fuling cake together in the kitchen at home. Her mother personally demonstrated how to mix the ratio of rice flour to water and explained the steaming heat. Song Yajing carefully followed every step. While they worked, they chatted about funny stories of Song Yajing loving sweets when she was little, and the kitchen was filled with collaboration and laughter.
subevent.location: Siming District, Xiamen - home kitchen

subevent.name: Mother and daughter tasted Poria cake and recalled their childhood
subevent.description: After the poria cake was steamed, Song Yajing savored it with her mother in the living room. As they ate, the mother and daughter recalled warm memories of the desserts her mother used to make for Yajing in her childhood, sharing the happiness the pastries brought.
subevent.location: Siming District, Xiamen - living room at home

subevent.name: Delivered pastries to Xiao Mei, the shop assistant.
subevent.description: In the afternoon, when Song Yajing went to the store, she brought the packaged fuling cake for the shop assistant Xiaomei to taste, sharing the results of her mother-daughter baking and strengthening the bond with her employee.
subevent.location: Xiamen City, Siming District - No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Publish customer stories and distribute coupons.
description: On September 18, Song Yajing compiled and published more than ten customer stories in the community group, announced the five selected story authors, and issued 100 yuan coupons. The winning customers spontaneously expressed their thanks in the group, prompting other members to recall their first encounters with the store, and community engagement reached a new monthly high.

subevent.name: Organize customer stories and prepare publishing materials.
subevent.description: At the shop or at home, Song Yajing selected and laid out more than a dozen customer stories collected earlier, designed the copy and coupon images for community posts, and prepared the publishing materials in advance.

subevent.name: Post customer stories and award announcements in the community

subevent.name: Issued 100-yuan coupons to the winning customers.
subevent.description: Song Yajing sent a 100-yuan electronic coupon to each of the 5 selected story authors via WeChat private messages or within the community group, and thanked them for their sharing.
subevent.location: Inside the boutique clothing store in Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Customer interactions and feedback in the community group
subevent.description: The prize-winning customer spontaneously thanked everyone in the group, and other group members, infected by the atmosphere, also left messages recalling their first encounters with the store or sharing shopping experiences, bringing community activity to a new monthly high.
subevent.location: Siming District, Xiamen - boutique clothing store (online community).

subevent.name: Record activity results and conduct a review.
subevent.description: After the event, Song Yajing tallied the new interaction volume in the community, coupon redemption intent, and potential customer feedback, and recorded this event's experience in her business notes to optimize subsequent community operations.
subevent.location: Inside the boutique clothing store in Siming District, Xiamen

name: Post-disaster mutual aid and the establishment of community traditions
description: On August 9, a typhoon passed through, and some areas in Xiamen had flooding and power outages. Song Yajing started a "reporting safety" check-in chain in the community group and coordinated group members who were able to provide power banks and hot meals for neighbors in need. After this emergency cooperation, an unwritten tradition of "disaster mutual aid" formed in the group. Zhao Li also helped forward the floral studio's emergency contact number. Shortly afterward (August 16), Zhao Li's mother suddenly suffered a stroke, and the group's mutual aid network played a key role at a critical moment.

subevent.name: Safety check after the typhoon passed through
subevent.description: After the typhoon passed on August 9, Song Yajing checked the safety of her home and the store, confirmed there was no major damage, and used the community group to check on the situation of other neighbors.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Home

subevent.name: Initiated a safety check-in chain and coordinated supplies.
subevent.description: Song Yajing started a "check-in if safe" chain in the community group to gather information on neighbors in difficulty, and coordinated group members who were able to provide power banks and hot meals to neighbors in flooded, power-outage areas.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Online Community

subevent.name: The community formed a tradition of mutual aid during disasters.
subevent.description: After the successful emergency coordination, the community group formed an unwritten tradition of mutual aid during disasters. Zhao Li helped forward the emergency contact number of the florist studio so that neighbors in need could reach out.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Online Community

subevent.name: Urgent help: Zhao Li's mother had a stroke
subevent.description: On August 16, Zhao Li's mother suddenly suffered a stroke. Zhao Li urgently asked for help in the community group, explaining the situation and what assistance was needed.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Online Community

subevent.name: Community mutual aid network responds to help requests.
subevent.description: The community mutual-aid network responded quickly after receiving Zhao Li's request for help, assisting with contacting an ambulance and providing temporary care. Song Yajing played a key role in coordinating resources.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Online Community

name: Video call with parents and the interactions before and after it
description: On September 4, Song Yajing arranged with her parents via WeChat to have a video call at 8 pm on Saturday. At 7:30 pm on September 6, Song Yajing and her husband Chen Zhiqiang checked the equipment and set up the living room, while her daughter Xuanxuan changed clothes to get ready. At 8 pm, the family of three had a video call with her parents in Quanzhou. Xuanxuan showed off the pinyin she had just learned, Song Yajing shared the progress of the store's fifth-anniversary preparations and her daughter's school enrollment, her father reminded them to take care of their health, and her mother shared a new baking recipe. The call lasted nearly an hour. After the call, her mother sent over a tiramisu recipe. Song Yajing and Chen Zhiqiang shared their feelings about the call and planned to visit Quanzhou next time.

subevent.name: Scheduled a call time
subevent.description: Two days in advance, Song Yajing asked her parents on WeChat whether they were free on Saturday evening and arranged a video call for 8 PM that night.
subevent.location: Fujian Province - Xiamen City - Home

subevent.name: Prepare video call equipment and environment.
subevent.description: Saturday at 7:30 PM, Song Yajing checked the phone and tablet batteries to ensure a stable network; Chen Zhiqiang brightened the living room lights and tidied up the background; their daughter Xuanxuan put on new clothes, ready to perform pinyin.
subevent.location: Fujian Province - Xiamen City - living room at home

subevent.name: Video call with parents
subevent.description: At 8 p.m., Song Yajing and her family of three had a video call with her parents in Quanzhou via WeChat. Xuanxuan excitedly showed off her newly learned pinyin. Song Yajing shared the progress of the store's fifth-anniversary preparations and her daughter's adjustment to school. Her father reminded them to take care of their health, and her mother shared a new baking recipe she had learned. The call lasted nearly an hour.
subevent.location: Fujian Province - Xiamen City - living room at home

subevent.name: Received the baking recipe sent by my mother.
subevent.description: After the call, her mother, Lin Xiuying, sent the newly learned tiramisu recipe to Song Yajing via WeChat and left a message encouraging her to try it.
subevent.location: Fujian Province - Xiamen City - Home

subevent.name: Shared her feelings about the phone call with her husband
subevent.description: After the video call, Song Yajing and Chen Zhiqiang chatted for a while in the living room, marveling at how caring their parents were toward the family, and planned to visit Quanzhou next time.
subevent.location: Fujian Province - Xiamen City - living room at home

name: Sharing Lin Wei's flower illustrations in the community group, sparking cultural creative inspiration
description: On October 15, Song Yajing shared a series of floral illustrations by her elementary school classmate Lin Wei in the community group, and told the friendship story behind the artworks. Group members not only gave likes, but also asked for the same phone wallpapers; some customers asked whether the illustrations could be printed on clothing or accessories. This sharing provided a new direction for the store to explore cultural and creative co-branding.

subevent.name: Contact Lin Wei to obtain illustration authorization
subevent.description: Song Yajing contacted her elementary school classmate Lin Wei through WeChat, told her that she planned to share her floral illustration series in the customer community, and asked whether the illustrations could be used as phone wallpapers and as references for future co-branded designs. Lin Wei agreed and provided the high-resolution original images.
subevent.location: Own shop, Xiamen, Fujian Province

subevent.name: Write the share post and preview.
subevent.description: Song Yajing, in the rest area of the store, selected three or four floral illustrations provided by Lin Wei, wrote a caption telling the story of their friendship and the story behind the paintings, and designed an interactive question. Finally, she previewed to make sure the layout of text and images looked beautiful.
subevent.location: Own shop, Xiamen, Fujian Province

subevent.name: Post photos and text to share in the customer community.
subevent.description: Song Yajing posted the prepared illustrations and copy to the core customer WeChat group of the boutique clothing store, and also shared it to her personal Moments, with the caption "An old classmate's flower world—a gift across time."
subevent.location: Own shop, Xiamen, Fujian Province

subevent.name: Reply to group members' likes and wallpaper requests.
subevent.description: After the post was shared, group members liked it one after another, and some customers asked for the original phone wallpaper. Song Yajing responded to each one, sending the HD wallpaper authorized by Lin Wei via group files or private messages to those who asked, and thanked everyone for their appreciation.
subevent.location: Own shop, Xiamen, Fujian Province

subevent.name: Recorded customer co-branding requests and made preliminary plans
subevent.description: Several customers asked whether the floral illustrations could be printed on clothing or accessories. Song Yajing used a notebook at the store checkout counter to jot down customers' style suggestions (such as T-shirts and canvas bags), and wrote down her initial thoughts on collaborating with Lin Wei to launch a co-branded cultural and creative merchandise series.
subevent.location: Own shop, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Participated in the community Good Neighbor Festival baking competition and developed the 'Minnan Cakes from Memory' series
description: On September 17, Song Yajing took part in a community Neighborhood Day baking contest. She entered with her father's favorite low-sugar jujube paste cake. Although she did not win, she was interviewed by the community newspaper. An elderly person tasted it and sighed, "This taste is just like my childhood," which deeply moved her. After returning to the store, she spent three consecutive days developing the 'Minnan Cakes in Memory' series (starting improvements to the jujube paste cake on the evening of the 17th, trying different cake bases on the 18th, finalizing the combination on the 19th, and finishing up on the morning of the 20th). At noon on September 20, she recorded a short video in the store introducing the stories behind making Minnan cakes, posted it in her community groups and Moments, and it drew a large number of likes.

subevent.name: Pre-competition preparation and trial run of low-sugar jujube paste cake
subevent.description: To participate in the Community Good Neighbor Festival baking competition, Song Yajing went to a nearby supermarket a day early to buy cake flour, red dates, xylitol, and other ingredients, and in the kitchen behind her shop tried making her father's favorite low-sugar red date cake, adjusting the sweetness and texture.
subevent.location: Siming District, Xiamen - Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street (back kitchen of the boutique clothing store)

subevent.name: Participate in the community Good Neighbor Festival baking competition.
subevent.description: Song Yajing brought her homemade low-sugar jujube paste cake to the Community Good Neighbor Festival to participate in the baking competition. She competed alongside other residents and ultimately did not win any award.
subevent.location: Siming District, Xiamen City - Community Activity Center

subevent.name: After the race, she was interviewed by the community newspaper and was deeply moved
subevent.description: After the competition, a reporter from the community newspaper conducted a brief interview with Song Yajing. An elderly person who tasted the jujube paste cake sighed, "This taste is like when I was little," which deeply touched her and gave her the idea of developing a series called 'Minnan Cakes in Memory'.
subevent.location: Siming District, Xiamen City - Community Activity Center

subevent.name: R&D Day 1: Refining the low-sugar jujube paste cake
subevent.description: After returning to the shop that evening, Song Yajing started the first round of development in the back kitchen. Based on the original low-sugar jujube paste cake, she adjusted the ratio of red dates and the baking process, trying to restore the traditional flavor, and recorded the recipe.
subevent.location: Siming District, Xiamen - Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street (back kitchen of the boutique clothing store)

subevent.name: Day 2 of development: trying multiple traditional cake bases.
subevent.description: Song Yajing spent the whole day in the back kitchen continuing her research, trying to make the base for traditional Hokkien pastries (such as fa gao and rice cake), incorporating a modern low-sugar concept, and testing five varieties in total.
subevent.location: Siming District, Xiamen - Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street (back kitchen of the boutique clothing store)

subevent.name: Day 3 of development: finalization and assembly
subevent.description: Based on earlier experiments, Song Yajing combined and matched options to finalize the 'Minnan Cakes in Memory' series, consisting of three items: low-sugar jujube paste cake, old-fashioned rice cake, and peanut-crumb steamed sponge cake. She also refined the proportions and decorations for each item.
subevent.location: Siming District, Xiamen - Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street (back kitchen of the boutique clothing store)

subevent.name: R&D Wrap-Up and Final Product Approval
subevent.description: In the morning, she conducted the final round of trial production and quality control in the shop, confirmed the taste, appearance, and storage method of the three pastry items, and completed all the final development work for the 'Minnan Cakes in Memory' series.
subevent.location: Siming District, Xiamen - Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street (back kitchen of the boutique clothing store)

subevent.name: Record a short intro video and publish it.
subevent.description: Around noon, Song Yajing used the in-store setting to record a 2-minute short video on her phone, telling the story of being moved by the competition and the behind-the-scenes development of the “Minnan Cake in Memory.” She then posted it to the store’s WeChat group and Moments, which drew a lot of likes and comments.
subevent.location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen (boutique clothing store)

name: Calculate the costs for the fifth anniversary celebration
description: On September 16, the day after the fifth anniversary celebration, Song Yajing, in the office of the boutique clothing store, first sorted through all invoices, receipts, and electronic bills from the event, then checked one by one the costs of custom commemorative silk scarves, materials for low-sugar mung bean cakes, coupons, and the additional operating expenses incurred on the day of the event, totaling about 8,000 yuan. She then entered each itemized ledger entry into the store's financial system, generated a special expenditure report, assessed the event's impact on profits, and finally filed the vouchers and reports for safekeeping.

subevent.name: Organize the financial receipts for the celebration event
subevent.description: The fifth anniversary celebration had just ended. Song Yajing collected and sorted all the invoices, receipts, and electronic bills received during the event (including custom silk scarves, food purchases, promotional materials, temporary worker wages, etc.) from various places, preparing for the next day's accounting.
subevent.location: Boutique clothing store office, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Verify the cost of custom commemorative silk scarves
subevent.description: Song Yajing checked the customized unit price, total quantity, and total amount item by item against the silk scarf customization contract and the actual quantity received. After confirming that the cost was correct, she recorded it on a piece of scratch paper.
subevent.location: Boutique clothing store office, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Verify the ingredient cost of the low-sugar mung bean cakes
subevent.description: Song Yajing took out the purchase list and receipts and calculated the total cost of the ingredients used to make the low-sugar mung bean cakes, such as flour, butter, and sugar, plus the cost of packaging boxes and gift bags, confirming the amount was correct.
subevent.location: Boutique clothing store office, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Verify coupon costs
subevent.description: Song Yajing tallied the quantity and face value of coupons actually used and redeemed by customers during the event, calculated the total discount amount, and compared it with the printing/electronic coupon costs.
subevent.location: Boutique clothing store office, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Review the event's operating expenses.
subevent.description: Song Yajing calculated the extra operating expenses for the celebration day, including the temporarily added lighting, audio equipment rental, production of promotional posters and roll-up banners, and the wages paid to temporary helpers, and summed up the total.
subevent.location: Boutique clothing store office, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Enter into the store's financial system
subevent.description: Song Yajing entered all the verified detailed accounts (silk scarves, mung bean cakes, coupons, operating expenses) item by item into the store's financial software, and generated a special activity expenditure report.
subevent.location: Boutique clothing store office, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Evaluate the impact of the activity on profit
subevent.description: Song Yajing compared and analyzed the total cost of about 8,000 yuan against the sales growth brought by the event, calculated the change in net profit, assessed the degree of impact of the celebration on the store's overall profit, and recorded it in her business notes.
subevent.location: Boutique clothing store office, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Archive accounting vouchers and reports.
subevent.description: Song Yajing categorized and archived the sorted original receipts, handwritten drafts, and electronic reports, placed them in the finance folder for safekeeping, in case they were needed for taxes or audits in the future.
subevent.location: Boutique clothing store office, Siming District, Xiamen

name: Visiting Uncle Chen, an elderly man living alone.
description: On October 9, Song Yajing baked cookies at home and selected a bouquet. On October 10, she took the gifts to Uncle Chen's home. At first it was awkward, but then she quietly accompanied the old man as they listened to an entire CD of old songs. On the way home, she thought of her father and wrote in her diary: “Companionship itself is a language.” This visit made her realize the true weight of practicing her faith.

subevent.name: Baking cookies and preparing flower bouquets
subevent.description: Song Yajing baked cookies in advance in her home kitchen and selected flowers, preparing for the visit.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Siming District - home kitchen

subevent.name: Go to Uncle Chen's house
subevent.description: Song Yajing set off from home carrying a bouquet and cookies she had baked herself, and walked to Uncle Chen's house.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Siming District - Hubin South Road to Uncle Chen's home

subevent.name: Visited Uncle Chen to keep him company
subevent.description: After arriving at Uncle Chen's house, Song Yajing awkwardly sat quietly with the elderly man and listened to an entire CD of old songs, conveying companionship through her actions.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Siming District - Uncle Chen's home

name: Explore and plan a co-branded collaboration for New Chinese-style clothing.
description: On September 22, Song Yajing shared her experiences from the fashion forum in the shop's community group, which attracted the attention of regular customer Vivian. On the afternoon of the 23rd, Vivian came to the shop. The two had an in-depth discussion about co-branding New Chinese Style with local culture. Vivian suggested working with local designers and volunteered to serve as the fitting model. Afterwards, on the 30th, Song Yajing sorted out the collaboration framework and product direction, making preparations to contact designers.

subevent.name: Share fashion forum insights in the community group.
subevent.description: Song Yajing compiled what she had seen and heard at the fashion forum and posted it to the shop's community group, which caught the attention of Vivian, a regular customer.
subevent.location: Xiamen – Boutique Clothing Store

subevent.name: Discussing co-branded collaboration with Vivian
subevent.description: In the afternoon, regular customer Vivian came to the store and mentioned community content. The two had an in-depth discussion about a collaboration between New Chinese style and local culture. Vivian suggested working with local designers and volunteered to be a fitting model.
subevent.location: Xiamen – Boutique Clothing Store

subevent.name: Organize ideas for the co-branded collaboration.
subevent.description: Based on her discussion with Vivian, Song Yajing organized the collaboration framework, target designers, and product direction, getting ready to contact the designers.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - home study

name: Start a live-streaming segment on Tuesday and Thursday mornings and build a loyal audience.
description: To launch a morning live-streaming segment, Song Yajing adjusted the store's business hours on September 1, 2025, and prepared live-streaming equipment and a content outline. Starting September 2, she hosted "A Cup of Coffee After Dropping Off the Kids" every Tuesday and Thursday morning at 9:30, casually chatting about fashion, parenting, and Bible verses. In the beginning, the maximum concurrent viewers was only 25. She adjusted her mindset and did not chase sales, gradually attracting a steady group of followers, one of whom, a single father, became a loyal viewer. On October 1, she summarized the first month of live streaming and had an offline interaction with the single father to strengthen their relationship.

subevent.name: Adjusting business hours and preparing for the livestream.
subevent.description: To launch a morning live-streaming segment, she adjusted the shop's business hours, prepared live-streaming equipment (phone, fill light, backdrop), and planned the live-stream content outline, including outfit sharing, parenting insights, and Bible verse sharing.
subevent.location: Xiamen City, Siming District - No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

subevent.name: Running the Tuesday and Thursday morning live broadcast.
subevent.description: Every Tuesday and Thursday morning at 9:30, she runs a livestream called A Cup of Coffee After Dropping Off the Kid. The content is casual chat about outfits, parenting, and Bible verses; she doesn't aim for sales. In the early days, the maximum number of concurrent viewers was 25, and later she gained a stable group of fans, one of whom, a single father, became a loyal viewer.
subevent.location: Siming District, Xiamen – Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street (in-store livestream area)

subevent.name: Live-stream segment summary and interaction with loyal customers
subevent.description: Summarized the operational experience of the first month of the livestream program, had an offline exchange with a loyal fan (a single father) to express gratitude, consolidated customer relationships, and built word-of-mouth for the continued development of the livestream program.
subevent.location: Xiamen City, Siming District - No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Starting a morning jogging habit.
description: On September 4, Song Yajing bought running shoes and workout clothes and set an alarm, determined to start a regular morning running routine. Starting September 8, after dropping off her daughter every Monday, Wednesday, and Friday, she jogged for 20 minutes at Zhongshan Park. In the first week she alternated between running and walking; by the second week she could run two kilometers continuously; in the third week her shoulder and neck soreness had eased significantly and her energy improved. By September 29, morning running had become a natural habit.

subevent.name: Buying morning running gear and making a plan.
subevent.description: Song Yajing decided to start morning running from tomorrow. At noon, she went to a sports goods store and bought a pair of running shoes and two sets of workout clothes, and set an alarm reminder on her phone for every Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.
subevent.location: Sports goods store in Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: First week of morning running (adaptation period)
subevent.description: Every morning after taking her daughter to kindergarten, she went to Zhongshan Park to go jogging. At first she could only run a bit and walk a bit, 20 minutes each time; after finishing she felt a little out of breath but happy.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Zhongshan Park

subevent.name: Week 2 morning run (hitting its stride)
subevent.description: After the first week of adaptation, running has become smooth. This week I was able to run two kilometers continuously without stopping, and I feel more energetic after morning runs.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Zhongshan Park

subevent.name: Week 3 Morning Run (Consolidation and Improvement)
subevent.description: It's the third week of sticking to morning runs. My running pace is steady, and I can clearly feel the soreness in my shoulders and neck has eased. After each run I feel refreshed and more patient with work and childcare.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Zhongshan Park

subevent.name: Fourth week morning run (habit starting to form)
subevent.description: This week I completed two morning runs. Morning running has become a natural habit in my life. After dropping off my daughter, I automatically head to the park, run for 20 minutes, and then open the store — time management is more efficient.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Zhongshan Park

name: Her husband took the initiative to join the community, extending the overlap in their business lives.
description: On October 28, after discussing with Song Yajing, her husband Chen Zhiqiang took the initiative to join her customer community. In the afternoon, he shared computer tips in the group and was welcomed by the group members. That evening, the couple had an in-depth conversation, and her husband expressed appreciation for Song Yajing's career. Their relationship grew closer through mutual understanding of each other's work.

subevent.name: Couple discussed joining a community
subevent.description: During her lunch break, Song Yajing communicated with her husband Chen Zhiqiang via WeChat. Chen Zhiqiang said he wanted to join her customer community. Song Yajing welcomed him and briefly introduced the community rules and atmosphere.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Home

subevent.name: Her husband formally joined the community and interacted with it
subevent.description: That afternoon, Chen Zhiqiang appeared in the WeChat customer group run by Song Yajing and proactively shared a practical computer tip. The group members reacted enthusiastically and affectionately called him brother-in-law, and he actively responded to their questions.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Online Community

subevent.name: The couple privately shares their feelings
subevent.description: After closing the shop and returning home in the evening, Chen Zhiqiang said privately to Song Yajing, 'So your world is really interesting.' Song Yajing was surprised but pleased, and the two had an in-depth conversation about community management and each other's careers, bringing them closer.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - living room at home

name: Couple's Hot Spring Vacation
description: From September 12 to 14, Chen Zhiqiang received a two-day, two-person trip to Sun Moon Valley Hot Spring Resort as a reward for completing an important company project. On the 12th, Song Yajing entrusted her daughter to her mother, Lin Xiuying, and packed luggage with Chen Zhiqiang. On the 13th, the couple drove to the resort, checked in, enjoyed lunch, and then reminisced about their early romance and struggling years in the hot spring pool, which warmed their feelings; in the evening they shared a romantic dinner and took a walk. On the 14th, they checked out at noon, returned home, picked up their daughter, and organized their belongings, agreeing to schedule regular couple time in the future.

subevent.name: Entrusting her daughter to her mother.
subevent.description: Song Yajing entrusted her 5-year-old daughter Chen Lexuan to her mother Lin Xiuying, who had come from Quanzhou to Xiamen, and gave detailed instructions on kindergarten drop-off and pick-up, meals, and daily schedule, ensuring her daughter's daily life would be worry-free during the two days.
subevent.location: Xiamen - at home on Hubin South Road

subevent.name: Packing luggage for the hot spring vacation
subevent.description: Song Yajing and Chen Zhiqiang packed a change of clothes, swimsuits, sunscreen, toiletry bag, and phone chargers together, preparing for departure the next day
subevent.location: Xiamen - at home on Hubin South Road

subevent.name: Set off for Sun Moon Valley Hot Spring Resort
subevent.description: Song Yajing and Chen Zhiqiang drove from their home in Siming District, Xiamen, to Sun Moon Valley Hot Spring Resort in Haicang District. The drive took about 30 minutes, and they chatted happily on the way, looking forward to some rare time alone as a couple.
subevent.location: Xiamen City – en route to Riyuegu Hot Spring Resort

subevent.name: Check in and enjoy lunch
subevent.description: After arriving at Riyuegu Hot Spring Resort, the couple checked in at the front desk, put away their luggage, and went to the resort restaurant for a two-person lunch, chatting casually.
subevent.location: Xiamen - Sun Moon Valley Hot Spring Resort

subevent.name: An afternoon of hot springs and nostalgic heart-to-heart talk.
subevent.description: The couple changed into swimsuits and entered the hot spring area. They tried hot spring pools with different benefits one after another, and while in the pools talked about the sweet memories of falling in love ten years ago and their years of hard work building a business together and raising their daughter. Their feelings quickly warmed up.
subevent.location: Xiamen - Sun Moon Valley Hot Spring Resort

subevent.name: Romantic dinner and nighttime stroll
subevent.description: In the evening, the couple enjoyed a dinner for two at the resort's western restaurant, ordering a few exquisite dishes and red wine. After dinner, they strolled along the garden paths in the resort, opened their hearts to each other, and enjoyed the long-missed quiet time together as a couple.
subevent.location: Xiamen - Sun Moon Valley Hot Spring Resort

subevent.name: Check out and return home to Xiamen
subevent.description: At noon, they checked out of the hotel. The couple drove back to their home on Hubin South Road in Siming District, sharing their vacation feelings along the way and agreeing to regularly schedule time for just the two of them in the future.
subevent.location: Sun Moon Valley Hot Spring Resort, Xiamen, to home

subevent.name: Pick up our daughter and organize holiday items
subevent.description: After arriving home, Song Yajing picked up her daughter, who had been looked after by her mother Lin Xiuying, thanked her mother for her help, and sorted out the clothes and souvenirs used during the hot spring vacation.
subevent.location: Xiamen - at home on Hubin South Road

name: Try a light lunch.
description: Starting August 12, inspired by her longing for a healthy life after the diving experience, Song Yajing began trying light lunches during her lunch break at the shop. She prepared vegetable salad, fruit, and boiled eggs at home in advance, paired with whole wheat bread, replacing the satay noodles or fast food she usually ate. After sticking with it for a week, she found that she was no longer sleepy in the afternoon, had more energy, and her weight dropped slightly. She shared photos of the light meals in the baking hobby group, and Mrs. Liu liked the post and shared her own light meal recipe.

subevent.name: Purchased ingredients for light meals
subevent.description: Go to the supermarket to buy light-meal ingredients such as vegetables, fruit, eggs, and whole-wheat bread, in preparation for the following week's light lunches.
subevent.location: Supermarket near Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Daily light meal preparation and consumption
subevent.description: Every morning at home, make a vegetable salad with the purchased ingredients, paired with fruit and boiled eggs, and eat it at noon during the shop lunch break, instead of the usual satay noodles or fast food.
subevent.location: Xiamen – home kitchen (preparation), store (eating).

subevent.name: Sharing the light meal experience and gathering feedback
subevent.description: Shared a week of light meal photos and reflections in the baking enthusiast group. Mrs. Liu liked it and shared her own light meal recipes, exchanging healthy eating tips.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - store (online interaction)

subevent.name: Continue the light lunch habit
subevent.description: Encouraged by the positive results of the first week, Song Yajing continued the habit of a light lunch during the shop's lunch break, lasting until the end of August.
subevent.location: Xiamen – home kitchen (preparation), store (eating).

name: The co-branded new Chinese-style women's clothing project was officially signed.
description: On October 12, the Hangzhou independent designer introduced by former colleague Zheng Kai arrived in Xiamen, and the two sides discussed cooperation details in the store. The designer appreciated the store's community vibe and agreed to develop an affordable neo-Chinese style series. After discussing with her husband, Song Yajing decided to use part of the reserve fund and accept staff member Xiaomei's 10,000 yuan investment to share the risk. On October 15, they officially signed a co-branded agreement, marking a key step in combining the store's online transformation with community culture.

subevent.name: Zheng Kai introduced a designer for the meeting
subevent.description: Former colleague Zheng Kai introduced Chen Siyuan, an independent designer from Hangzhou, to Song Yajing via WeChat, and the two had a preliminary discussion about cooperating on a co-branded New Chinese style womenswear project.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Home

subevent.name: Designer arrives in Xiamen to discuss collaboration

The next day (the 20th), she launched an online preview and limited-time 10% off pre-order campaign in her WeChat community. Customers responded enthusiastically, and she received 12 orders that evening. On the 21st, she rallied staff member Xiaomei to pack and ship orders together. On the weekend of the 23rd, she updated the in-store displays as planned and put the new autumn items on display.

name: Hold the store's fifth anniversary celebration
description: On September 5, contacted Susan, a supplier in Guangzhou, to custom-order fifth-anniversary commemorative scarves. On September 14, set up the message wall, tested the sound system, and notified regular members who had spent 5000 yuan or more. On September 15, the day of the celebration, opened the store an hour early, distributed scarves to regular members, played light music all day, gave customers handmade low-sugar mung bean cakes with purchases, and encouraged them to leave messages. One regular customer's message—From a girl to a mother, thank you for the companionship—moved Song Yajing deeply. Zhao Min helped throughout. After closing, they cleaned the store, sorted through the messages, and reviewed the event results with staff member Xiaomei and Zhao Min.

subevent.name: Custom fifth-anniversary silk scarf
subevent.description: Contact supplier Susan in Guangzhou to discuss custom silk scarf requirements, including design, material, and quantity, and confirm that the delivery time will make it in time for the celebration.
subevent.location: Xiamen, Siming District - Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street Boutique Clothing Store (phone/WeChat contact)

subevent.name: Store ambiance setup and member notifications
subevent.description: Set up a message wall area in the store, prepare sticky notes and pens; adjust the sound system playlist; notify regular members who have spent over 5,000 yuan in the past two years via WeChat private messages or bulk messages, inviting them to come and pick up a commemorative silk scarf.
subevent.location: Xiamen City, Siming District - Boutique clothing store on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street.

subevent.name: Open the store early to welcome regular members coming to collect silk scarves.
subevent.description: On the anniversary day, the store opened an hour earlier than usual (8:00), specifically to verify eligibility for the notified long-time members, distribute customized commemorative silk scarves, and strengthen ties with them.
subevent.location: Xiamen City, Siming District - Boutique clothing store on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street.

subevent.name: In-store celebration activities and customer interaction.
subevent.description: Soft music played on loop all day. Every customer received handmade low-sugar mung bean cakes with their purchase. Customers were encouraged to leave sticky notes on the message wall, and photos were taken with customers as keepsakes. In particular, an old customer wrote, 'I have shopped here from a young girl to a mom,' which moved Song Yajing. Zhao Min helped welcome customers and take photos.
subevent.location: Xiamen City, Siming District - Boutique clothing store on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street.

subevent.name: Celebration wrap-up and cleanup
subevent.description: After closing, cleaned up the store, sorted the note messages on the message wall, and took photos of the touching ones to keep; counted the remaining scarves and the consumption of mung bean cakes; briefly reviewed the effectiveness of the event with clerk Xiao Mei and friend Zhao Min, and shared touching moments.
subevent.location: Xiamen City, Siming District - Boutique clothing store on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street.

On October 8, she posted the co-branding intention and displayed design sketches in the [Yajing Lifestyle Pavilion] group, receiving positive feedback from regular customers; many paid intention deposits. On October 10, she discussed the signing details online with Hangzhou designer Zheng Kai. On October 15, the two parties formally confirmed the collaboration through e-signing. On October 16, Song Yajing compiled the list of customers who had paid intention deposits, announced the successful signing in the group, and informed them of the subsequent arrangements.

name: After the gathering, accepted Zhou Ting's financial advice and decided to activate the merchant version of the cash register system.
description: After the gathering on October 11, 2025, ended, Song Yajing chatted with her college classmate Zhou Ting for half an hour in the parking lot of a restaurant in Xiamen. After reviewing the shop's simple accounts, Zhou Ting pointed out the problem of cash sitting idle and suggested switching to electronic bookkeeping and split-account management. Song Yajing noted down the key points on the spot, discussed it with her husband Chen Zhiqiang after returning home, and they finally decided to apply for a merchant cashier system to upgrade their finances.

subevent.name: Talked with Zhou Ting in the parking lot after the get-together.
subevent.description: After a gathering at a restaurant in Xiamen, Song Yajing and her college classmate Zhou Ting lingered in the parking lot and chatted for another half hour. Zhou Ting asked about the store's operations and proactively offered to look at the accounts.
subevent.location: A restaurant parking lot in Xiamen.

subevent.name: Zhou Ting checked the accounts and pointed out the problem of cash sitting idle.
subevent.description: After checking the simple accounts on Song Yajing's phone in the parking lot, Zhou Ting pointed out that the shop had several problems with delayed cash recovery and suggested that she adopt electronic bookkeeping and split-account management to improve capital turnover efficiency.
subevent.location: A restaurant parking lot in Xiamen.

subevent.name: Song Yajing recorded the key points and drove home.
subevent.description: Song Yajing immediately jotted down the key points of Zhou Ting's suggestions in her phone's memo app, then bid farewell to Zhou Ting, drove out of the parking lot, and returned to her home on Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen.
subevent.location: Xiamen: from a restaurant parking lot to home.

subevent.description: After Song Yajing got home, she immediately shared Zhou Ting's financial advice with her husband Chen Zhiqiang. subevent.description: After discussing with her husband, Song Yajing decided to adopt Zhou Ting's suggestion and planned to apply for a merchant cashier system for the shop, enabling electronic bookkeeping and fund split management to improve the shop's financial efficiency.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - home study

name: Mid-Autumn group-purchase flower gift box: a family accepts one another's flaws
description: On October 6, the Mid-Autumn Festival, Song Yajing organized a family group purchase in the community for Zhao Li's flower gift boxes and arranged to exchange handmade cards. Her daughter Xuanxuan drew a “Handsomest Dad” certificate and card for her father, and Chen Zhiqiang carefully put it up on the refrigerator. In the evening, the family of three ate pomelo on the balcony. Song Yajing poked fun at her own failed toast, but her daughter said seriously, “It’s the most delicious bread.” She realized that home is not about perfection but about accepting each other’s imperfections. The warmth of that moment made her let go of perfectionism.

subevent.name: Organizing a community group order to confirm flower gift boxes
subevent.description: Song Yajing initiated a Mid-Autumn Festival group buy through a WeChat community, confirmed the details of the group purchase of Zhao Lihua gift boxes with her neighbors, and agreed to exchange handmade cards with each other.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - home study

subevent.location: Xiamen City - living room at home

subevent.description: After receiving the award certificate his daughter had drawn, Chen Zhiqiang treasured it and personally put it up on the refrigerator door for display.
subevent.location: Xiamen - home kitchen

subevent.name: In the evening, the whole family enjoyed pomelo and had a heart-to-heart chat on the balcony.
subevent.description: On the evening of the Mid-Autumn Festival, Song Yajing, Chen Zhiqiang, and their daughter Chen Lexuan admired the moon and ate pomelo on their balcony, enjoying warm family time.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - home balcony

subevent.location: Xiamen City - home balcony

subevent.description: After the interaction on Mid-Autumn night, Song Yajing realized that family is not about pursuing perfection but about accepting each other's flaws. She recorded this insight in her diary and shared it on WeChat Moments.
subevent.location: Xiamen - home bedroom

description: From September 25 to 29, Song Yajing gathered information about trips around Xiamen through a mothers' group. On the evening of September 28, she discussed with her husband Chen Zhiqiang at home and chose the Zhangpu Volcanic Island Resort, keeping the budget within 3,000 yuan. On the 29th, she booked a cost-effective homestay based on recommendations. During this period, they also made a two-day National Day itinerary and packing list together, and prepared travel items and checked the vehicle in advance.

She told her husband Chen Zhiqiang about the plan, and the two jointly confirmed the savings goal, reinforcing the consistency of their family financial planning.

subevent.description: At the ICBC Siming Sub-branch, Song Yajing listened to account manager Lin Xiaofeng's advice on opening a dedicated savings account for overseas travel. She decided to open an account and prepared the required materials such as her ID card and bank card.

description: On Sunday afternoon, October 19, Song Yajing left her daughter with her husband and went alone to the Xinhua Bookstore on Zhongshan Road, where she picked out two novels and a baking guide. She sat in the bookstore's coffee area for two hours, immersed in reading, enjoying a rare moment of solitude. This was a relaxing activity she deliberately arranged for herself after several weeks of continuous busyness, to rediscover her hobby of reading novels and let her mind rest.

subevent.name: Schedule family rest time

name: A small gathering of college classmates, chatting freely about work and family.
description: On the evening of October 11 (Saturday), Song Yajing met up as planned with Zhou Ting and a male classmate who had come from Quanzhou. During the meal, they all complained about workplace involution and parenting anxiety. Zhou Ting said frankly, "Coming back to Xiamen is not a step backward; I just want to be closer to my family." Song Yajing could deeply relate, and shared her own journey from desperately running the store to letting go of control. The three also recalled the fun of shopping together during their junior college days, and laughter never stopped.

subevent.name: Confirm the gathering arrangements.
subevent.description: Song Yajing used WeChat to confirm the specific time and place of the October 11 evening gathering with Zhou Ting and Liu Lei, a male college classmate who came from Quanzhou (a Fujian restaurant in Siming District, Xiamen), and reserved a table.

subevent.description: That evening, Song Yajing arrived on time at the reserved Fujian restaurant and met Zhou Ting and Liu Lei, who had come from Quanzhou. The three chatted over dinner, venting about workplace rat race and parenting anxiety. Zhou Ting admitted her idea of returning to Xiamen, Song Yajing shared her experience running the business, and they recalled fond memories of shopping together during vocational college. The atmosphere was pleasant.

name: Completed the annual health checkup and decided to continue morning running.
description: On October 21, Song Yajing made preparations at home before the health checkup. On the morning of October 22, she went to the Health Examination Center of Xiamen First Hospital and completed all scheduled items including a complete blood count, electrocardiogram, and abdominal ultrasound. After receiving the preliminary results, the doctor told her that her indicators were basically normal but she should watch her blood lipids and recommended more aerobic exercise. She immediately decided to continue her daily morning running habit.

subevent.description: Prepare for the next day's physical examination, including fasting for 8 hours, going to bed early, and preparing the ID card and physical examination appointment form, etc.

subevent.name: Go to the hospital to complete the health check-up
subevent.description: In the morning, on an empty stomach, she went to the physical examination center of Xiamen First Hospital and completed all scheduled items in order, including blood routine, electrocardiogram, and abdominal ultrasound.
subevent.location: Xiamen - Physical Examination Center, Xiamen First Hospital

subevent.name: Obtain physical examination results and doctor's advice
subevent.description: After the physical exam, the preliminary results were obtained. The doctor said the indicators were basically normal, but reminded her to watch her blood lipid levels and suggested increasing aerobic exercise (such as morning jogging).

subevent.name: Deciding to continue the habit of morning running
subevent.description: After hearing the doctor's advice, she immediately decided to continue her daily morning running habit to improve cardiorespiratory function and control blood lipids.

name: Song Yajing accepted the visit task and visited the elderly man living alone, Uncle Chen.
description: On October 9, the church Bible reading group assigned a task to visit Uncle Chen, an elderly man living alone who had just been discharged from the hospital. Song Yajing was timid at first, but after thinking about her own mother's experience, she gathered her courage and accepted. That afternoon, she baked basil cookies in her kitchen at home in Xiamen and wrapped them carefully, while also confirming the next morning's visit plan with the group leader via WeChat or phone. On the morning of October 10, Song Yajing took the homemade cookies to Uncle Chen's home, asked about his recovery, and chatted with him.

subevent.location: Xiamen City - Home

subevent.name: Visit Uncle Chen at his home.
subevent.description: On the morning of October 10, Song Yajing brought homemade basil cookies and went to Uncle Chen's home in Xiamen at the agreed time to visit him, check on his recovery, keep him company and chat, and convey the church's care.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Uncle Chen's home

name: Attend an intensive spoken English workshop.
description: To achieve their overseas family trip, Song Yajing signed up for an online intensive English speaking course. On September 1, she completed registration and material preparation; on September 6, the first class (airport and hotel scenarios), she gradually caught up with the pace; on September 13, the second class (restaurant and shopping), she dared to speak; on September 24, the third class (transportation and asking directions), she adapted to role-play; on September 26, the fourth class, a comprehensive simulation, and she obtained the completion certificate; on September 29, after class, she organized her notes and retold the dialogues to her daughter, showing marked improvement.

subevent.name: Register and purchase study materials.
subevent.description: After searching online and comparing several online English-speaking workshops, she finally chose a four-week travel English crash course, completed the registration and payment, and downloaded the app and electronic textbooks needed for the course, preparing for the first class on September 6.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - home study

subevent.name: First online oral English course
subevent.description: At 9 a.m., she started her first online English conversation class for travel scenarios, with the theme of airport and hotel scenes. Although she was nervous at first, she gradually kept up with the pace through the teacher's guidance and group practice. She was able to participate in simple greetings and directions conversations. After class she felt she had gained something but knew she needed a lot of practice.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - home study

subevent.name: Second online English speaking class
subevent.description: The second Saturday class, with the theme of restaurant ordering and shopping scenarios. With the foundation from the first week, she dared to speak in class. Although she still often made grammar mistakes, she was able to complete basic situational dialogues. The teacher praised her progress.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - home study

subevent.name: Third online English speaking lesson
subevent.description: The theme of the third lesson was transportation and asking for directions. During class, I did several role-plays with my partner and felt increasingly comfortable speaking English spontaneously. Although I stumbled at times, I managed to keep the conversation going.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - home study

subevent.name: Fourth online English speaking lesson
subevent.description: The last class was a comprehensive simulated travel scenario, with the entire simulated trip conducted in English. Although she was nervous, she basically completed all parts and received a certificate of completion. At the end, the teacher encouraged her to continue with daily practice.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - home study

subevent.name: Evening shadow reading and review on the day the course ended
subevent.description: After the last class, in the evening at home, I sorted out the course notes and completely recited the simulated travel English dialogue in front of my daughter. Though not perfect, I could feel obvious improvement.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - living room at home
