name: Wedding anniversary wake-up call: agreed to set aside dedicated time each month and carried it out for the first time.
description: On September 30, 2025, Song Yajing booked a restaurant in advance and prepared a gift, planning to spend their wedding anniversary with her husband Chen Zhiqiang. On the afternoon of October 1, because a regular customer brought a friend to order bridesmaid dresses, she delayed leaving work until 7 and rushed to the restaurant. Her husband had already waited half an hour and looked displeased, saying bluntly, 'I always seem to be last.' Song Yajing was jolted awake and realized that work and family had become unbalanced. On the way home after dinner, she proactively proposed that the evening of the 1st of every month be reserved just for the two of them. Chen Zhiqiang was moved and agreed. On November 14, they carried out the agreement for the first time, going out to dinner alone, and their relationship was repaired.

subevent.name: Reserve a restaurant for the anniversary and prepare a gift
subevent.description: Song Yajing called a day ahead to reserve a restaurant for the wedding anniversary dinner and prepared an anniversary gift for her husband Chen Zhiqiang.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Home

subevent.name: Attending to a client's order for custom bridesmaid dresses
subevent.description: On the afternoon of October 1, 2025, a regular customer brought a friend to the shop. Song Yajing took detailed measurements for them and helped choose bridesmaid dress styles, which delayed her leaving work until 7 p.m.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Zhongshan Road Boutique Clothing Store

subevent.name: Rushed to the restaurant to keep the appointment
subevent.description: After finishing the store affairs at seven o'clock, Song Yajing hurriedly locked the door, took a taxi to the restaurant she had reserved, feeling anxious.
subevent.location: Xiamen - on the way from the clothing store to the restaurant

subevent.name: Wedding anniversary dinner and the outbreak of conflict
subevent.description: At the restaurant, Chen Zhiqiang had already been waiting alone for half an hour and looked displeased. Song Yajing apologized repeatedly. Chen Zhiqiang said quietly, "I always seem to come last," and the two ate in silence with a heavy atmosphere.
subevent.location: Xiamen - Restaurant reservation

subevent.name: Agreed on a monthly dedicated time on the way home.
subevent.description: On the way home after dinner, Song Yajing took the initiative to suggest, "From now on, the evening of the 1st of every month is just for us." Chen Zhiqiang nodded in agreement with red-rimmed eyes, and the couple's relationship was repaired through honesty.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - on the way home (in the car)

subevent.name: Carried out the monthly exclusive date for the first time.
subevent.description: As agreed, Song Yajing arranged matters at the shop in advance and went out alone with her husband Chen Zhiqiang for dinner in the evening, enjoying time meant just for the two of them.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - a restaurant

name: Planning the autumn stocking strategy and communicating with suppliers about new styles.
description: On October 1, Song Yajing organized the autumn customer preferences and size distributions for trench coats, knitwear, and skirts at the store, based on feedback from regular customers and information collected by staff member Xiaomei. On the morning of October 2, she browsed the autumn new-arrival catalog sent by supplier Susan on WeChat, selected 15 styles suitable for the Xiamen market, and marked the co-branded styles. She then had a video call with Susan to confirm order quantities, size ratios, shipping times, and co-branded fabric requirements. Finally, she entered the order into the system and informed staff member Xiaomei of the delivery and restocking plan.

subevent.name: Organize local customers' autumn demand feedback
subevent.description: Based on recent exchanges with regular customers such as Vivian and other customers, as well as fitting feedback collected by Xiaomei, Song Yajing compiled a preference list and size distribution for trench coats, knitwear, and skirts in the Xiamen market for autumn.
subevent.location: Fujian Province - Xiamen City - Siming District - Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

subevent.name: Browse the autumn new arrivals catalog and select styles.
subevent.description: Song Yajing browsed the fall new arrivals catalog Susan sent on WeChat. Taking local customers' needs into account, she selected 15 mid-to-high-end trench coats, knit tops, and skirts suitable for the Xiamen market, and marked the styles that might work for a co-branded collaboration.
subevent.location: Fujian Province - Xiamen City - Siming District - home study

subevent.name: Video call with Susan to confirm the order
subevent.description: Song Yajing had a video call with Su Shan to confirm, one by one, the order quantities, size ratios, and delivery times for the 15 styles (requesting arrival in the first week after the National Day holiday), and finalized the fabric requirement details for the co-branded series.
subevent.location: Fujian Province - Xiamen City - Siming District - home study

subevent.name: Organize orders and notify the staff.
subevent.description: After the video call, Song Yajing entered the final order information into the store management system and informed the shop assistant Xiaomei of the arrival time and shelving plan for the new styles.
subevent.location: Fujian Province - Xiamen City - Siming District - Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Attended an advanced French dessert course to learn mousse making
description: On Sunday, October 25, Song Yajing went to Master Chen's Baking Workshop for an advanced French dessert course, focusing on mango mousse techniques. During the course, she mastered the use of gelatin, the proper stirring level of the mousse batter, and the key points of unmolding. She successfully completed one finished dessert and brought it home to share with her family, further improving her baking skills and moving toward her goal of learning complex French desserts within a year.

subevent.name: Appointment confirmation and preparation
subevent.description: Song Yajing confirmed with Chef Chen via WeChat the schedule, ingredient list, and notes for the October 25 advanced French dessert course, and prepared an apron, notebook, and other supplies in advance.
subevent.location: Home on South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Set off for the baking workshop.
subevent.description: On the morning of October 25, Song Yajing left home and took public transportation or drove to Master Chen's Baking Workshop in Huli District.
subevent.location: Xiamen - from Hubin South Road in Siming District to Master Chen's Baking Workshop in Huli District

subevent.name: Course theory learning and demonstration.
subevent.description: In the workshop, Master Chen explained the principles of the mango mousse recipe, tips for using gelatin, and key points for unmolding, and gave a full demonstration. Song Yajing listened attentively and took notes.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Huli District, Master Chen's Bakery Workshop

subevent.name: Hands-on practice for trainees: making mango mousse.
subevent.description: Under Chef Chen's guidance, Song Yajing worked independently: she melted gelatin, whipped the cream, mixed in mango puree, layered it into the mold, and chilled it to set, focusing on controlling how much the mousse batter was stirred. In the end, she successfully made a mango mousse cake.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Huli District, Master Chen's Bakery Workshop

subevent.name: Demolding and packaging finished products
subevent.description: After the mousse was chilled, Song Yajing practiced unmolding, decorated the cake simply, and put it into a dedicated cake box to take home and share.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Huli District, Master Chen's Bakery Workshop

subevent.name: Return home.
subevent.description: After the class, Song Yajing took the finished mango mousse cake and returned to her home in Siming District by public transport.
subevent.location: Xiamen - from Master Chen's Bakery Workshop in Huli District to home on Hubin South Road in Siming District

subevent.name: Sharing the finished products with family
subevent.description: After returning home, Song Yajing tasted the mango mousse she had made with her husband Chen Zhiqiang and daughter Chen Lexuan, shared her takeaways from the class, and received praise from her family, which further boosted her confidence in baking.
subevent.location: Home on South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen

name: Zhou Ting resigned and returned to Xiamen to reunite with her college classmates.
description: On October 6, Zhou Ting returned to Xiamen from Shenzhen by high-speed rail. That evening, she told Song Yajing and Zhao Min in their college three-person group chat that she had resigned from her position as financial supervisor in Shenzhen and was returning to Xiamen to develop her career. Song Yajing immediately suggested a get-together and booked a Minnan private restaurant for the evening of October 11. On October 11, Song Yajing and Zhou Ting had dinner at the private restaurant, talking freely about career changes, while Zhao Min joined via video call.

subevent.name: Zhou Ting returned from Shenzhen to Xiamen
subevent.description: Zhou Ting took the high-speed rail from Shenzhen back home to Xiamen. After arriving, she sorted out her luggage, preparing to start a new phase of life.
subevent.location: Shenzhen - Shenzhen North Station to Xiamen - Xiamen Station

subevent.name: Zhou Ting announced in the university group chat that she had quit her job and was returning to Xiamen.
subevent.description: On the evening of October 6, the Mid-Autumn Festival, Zhou Ting sent a message in the college three-person group chat (including Song Yajing and Zhao Min), informing them that she had resigned from her job in Shenzhen and returned to Xiamen to develop her career.
subevent.location: Xiamen – Zhou Ting's home (online)

subevent.name: Song Yajing suggested and booked the gathering.
subevent.description: After seeing the message, Song Yajing immediately suggested in the group chat to get together during the tail end of the National Day holiday, and promptly phoned to reserve a private Minnan restaurant for the evening of October 11.
subevent.location: Xiamen - Song Yajing's home

subevent.name: Song Yajing had dinner with Zhou Ting at a private cuisine restaurant.
subevent.description: Song Yajing and Zhou Ting had dinner at a booked Minnan private home-style restaurant, chatting freely about Zhou Ting's career change and future development. Zhao Min joined part of the conversation via video call.
subevent.location: Xiamen - Minnan Private Restaurant

name: Keep healthy elements and adjust family eating habits
description: Starting November 13, Song Yajing no longer insisted on completely Westernizing their meals, but she kept baked salmon and chickpea salad as home-cooked dishes and reduced the amount of oil used in stir-frying by one third. She also began substituting some cooking oil with olive oil, and her husband gradually accepted it. This fine-tuning made the family diet healthier while retaining southern Fujian flavors, and it became a habit they kept up long term.

subevent.name: Diet adjustment preparation.
subevent.description: Song Yajing planned to adjust the family diet, buying ingredients in advance such as olive oil, salmon, and chickpeas, and discussed the adjustment plan with her husband Chen Zhiqiang, gaining his support.
subevent.location: Xiamen - home and nearby supermarkets

subevent.name: Implementation of family dietary habit adjustments.
subevent.description: Song Yajing kept grilled salmon and chickpea salad as home-style dishes, reduced the amount of oil used in stir-frying by one-third, and replaced part of the stir-fry oil with olive oil, gradually helping the whole family adapt to a healthier Minnan-style diet.
subevent.location: Xiamen - home kitchen

subevent.name: Purchase healthy ingredients
subevent.description: Went to the supermarket to buy extra virgin olive oil, fresh salmon, dried chickpeas, and various vegetables to prepare basic ingredients for dietary adjustments
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Siming District Walmart Supercenter

subevent.name: First experiment cooking with reduced oil
subevent.description: Replace part of the cooking oil with olive oil, reduce the usual amount of oil for stir-frying by one third, stir-fry a seasonal vegetable dish, invite her husband and daughter to taste it together, and observe their reactions.
subevent.location: Xiamen - home kitchen

subevent.name: Prepare and enjoy baked salmon.
subevent.description: Use the oven to make roasted salmon with a little olive oil and spices as the main dinner dish; at the same time, soak the chickpeas in advance and make the dressed chickpea salad, so the whole family could try these two dishes that were being kept on the menu for the first time.
subevent.location: Xiamen - home kitchen

subevent.name: Feedback communication on family dietary adjustments
subevent.description: After dinner, she communicated with her husband Chen Zhiqiang and daughter Chen Lexuan to learn how well they accepted the new dishes, recording her daughter's liking for chickpea salad and her husband's feelings about the reduced oil
subevent.location: Xiamen City - living room at home

subevent.name: Adjust the cooking method and try again.
subevent.description: Based on feedback, slightly improved the seasoning of the cold chickpea salad (adding a little honey), and replaced the baked salmon with herb pan-seared salmon for variety, while continuing to reduce the amount of oil.
subevent.location: Xiamen - home kitchen

subevent.name: Making a healthy version of Minnan satay noodles
subevent.description: Try substituting some olive oil for traditional lard, reduce the amount of satay sauce and increase the proportion of vegetables, to make a healthier Minnan-style satay noodles that suits family tastes and lets the family experience the improved flavor.
subevent.location: Xiamen - home kitchen

subevent.name: Interim summary of dietary adjustments
subevent.description: Organized the dietary records of the past month, summarized how family members adapted to the new eating habits, decided to keep baked salmon and cold chickpea salad as everyday dishes, and established reducing oil use and replacing it with olive oil as a fixed family cooking rule.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - home study

subevent.name: Confirm the next meal plan and buy groceries.
subevent.description: Based on the summary, create a healthy menu for January 2026 and restock essentials such as olive oil, salmon, and chickpeas to ensure the family's dietary habit adjustment continues.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Siming District Walmart Supercenter

name: Formulate and implement a family savings and insurance plan.
description: On the evening of November 18, Song Yajing and her husband Chen Zhiqiang reviewed the family income and expenses, then agreed to deposit 3,000 yuan per month into an education fund for their daughter Chen Lexuan, and planned to increase the health insurance budget next year. On the 18th, Song Yajing also consulted a bank account manager about insurance plans. On the 19th, Song Yajing completed the first month's deposit transfer, officially launching the plan.

subevent.name: Organize the family's income and expense accounts
subevent.description: After dinner, Song Yajing took out the account book and mobile banking app, and checked and organized the couple's November salary income, store revenue, and various household expenses item by item, preparing for the subsequent discussion of a savings plan.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - living room at home

subevent.name: Discussed the savings plan with her husband
subevent.description: On the living room sofa, Song Yajing and Chen Zhiqiang, based on the income and expenses they had reconciled that evening, discussed and decided to deposit 3,000 yuan into an education fund for their daughter Chen Lexuan every month, and planned to increase the health insurance budget next year to deal with unexpected risks such as the mother's sudden cerebral infarction.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - living room at home

subevent.name: Completed the first month's education fund deposit
subevent.description: Song Yajing transferred 3,000 yuan from her current account to a fixed-term education savings account opened specifically for her daughter via mobile banking, with the note 'Lexuan Education Fund - November 2025', marking the official launch of the plan.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Home

subevent.name: Consult the bank relationship manager about a health insurance plan
subevent.description: Song Yajing contacted account manager Lin Xiaofeng via WeChat to consult about middle-aged critical illness insurance and accident insurance products suitable for the family, and to learn about premiums and coverage, in preparation for increasing the budget next year.
subevent.location: Xiamen - online WeChat communication

name: Daughter qualified for the painting competition, so Song Yajing adjusted her work schedule and accompanied her throughout the competition.
description: At the end of November, her daughter Chen Lexuan was selected to participate in the citywide children's painting competition in early December. After receiving the notice, Song Yajing immediately adjusted the store schedule and communicated with her husband to arrange family matters. Before the competition, she prepared painting materials and travel items with her daughter. On the day of the competition, Song Yajing accompanied her daughter to the Children's Palace for the competition, and after the event, the whole family celebrated and encouraged her.

subevent.name: Received notice of her daughter's painting competition.
subevent.description: When Song Yajing picked up her daughter from school in the afternoon, she received a notice from the art teacher that her daughter Chen Lexuan, because of her outstanding performance in art class, had been selected to represent the class in the citywide 'Colorful Childlike Heart' children's live painting competition, scheduled for the morning of December 6 at Xiamen Children's Palace.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Hubin South Road Kindergarten

subevent.name: Communicating with store staff about adjusting the work schedule
subevent.description: After returning to the store, Song Yajing immediately discussed with shop assistant Xiaomei, explaining that she would need to accompany her daughter for the entire day on December 6 for a competition, and asked Xiaomei to be in charge of the store and handle daily sales matters that day, promising to give her a compensatory day off on another day.
subevent.location: Xiamen – Boutique Clothing Store

subevent.name: Inform her husband and arrange household affairs.
subevent.description: In the evening, Song Yajing discussed her daughter's competition matters with her husband Chen Zhiqiang. She confirmed that her husband could go to work normally that day, that she would accompany her daughter throughout, and asked her husband to pick them up directly at the competition venue after work. They also discussed lunch and itinerary details for the competition day.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Home

subevent.name: Prepare art materials and outing items.
subevent.description: On the night before the competition, Song Yajing and her daughter organized the drawing tools needed for the competition, including drawing boards, watercolor pens, paints, and aprons, and prepared snacks, a water bottle, and spare clothes to take the next day, ensuring everything was in order.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Home

subevent.name: Accompanying her daughter to a drawing competition.
subevent.description: On the morning of the competition, Song Yajing accompanied Chen Lexuan all the way to Xiamen Children's Palace to take part in the 'Colorful Childlike Heart' children's live painting competition. She waited outside and cheered her daughter on, took her to a nearby restaurant for lunch and rest at noon, and brought her back after the competition ended in the afternoon.
subevent.location: Xiamen - Municipal Children's Palace

subevent.name: Post-race celebration and family dinner.
subevent.description: After the competition, Song Yajing celebrated at home with her husband Chen Zhiqiang and daughter Chen Lexuan. She cooked dishes her daughter liked, listened to her share about the competition, encouraged and affirmed her, and felt proud of her daughter's performance.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Home

name: Upon learning that a high school classmate's father passed away, she organized condolences from classmates and attended the funeral Mass.
description: On November 12, 2025, Song Yajing saw the news in her high school classmates group that Wu Xiaoli's father had passed away. She immediately sent a private message to express her condolences, asked about the time and place of the funeral Mass, and contacted classmates in Xiamen to jointly send a funeral wreath. At the same time, she arranged for her husband to take care of their daughter on November 15, and on the 15th she drove to a church in Quanzhou to attend the Mass.

subevent.name: Learned that a high school classmate's father had passed away and expressed condolences.
subevent.description: After seeing in the high school classmates' WeChat group that Wu Xiaoli's father had passed away from lung cancer, Song Yajing immediately sent Wu Xiaoli a private message to express her condolences and concern.
subevent.location: Shop at No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Ask about the time and location of the farewell Mass.
subevent.description: Song Yajing asked Wu Xiaoli via WeChat private message about the specific time and place of the farewell Mass, and learned that the Mass was scheduled to be held at the church in her hometown in Quanzhou.
subevent.location: Shop at No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Contact classmates in Xiamen to prepare a joint funeral wreath
subevent.description: Song Yajing contacted several high school classmates also living in Xiamen (such as Li Meiling, Zhang Wei, etc.) via WeChat to discuss pooling money to order a funeral wreath to express condolences for Wu Xiaoli's father.
subevent.location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City - living room at home

subevent.name: Communicate and coordinate with her husband regarding the daughter's care arrangements.
subevent.description: After dinner, Song Yajing discussed with her husband Chen Zhiqiang, asking him to stay home all day on November 15 (Saturday) to take care of their 5-year-old daughter Chen Lexuan, so that she could drive round-trip to Quanzhou to attend the farewell Mass.
subevent.location: No. 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province - Home Chinese Restaurant

subevent.name: Drove to Quanzhou to attend the farewell Mass.
subevent.description: Song Yajing drove alone from Xiamen to the church in her hometown of Quanzhou to attend the funeral Mass for Wu Xiaoli's father. At the Mass, she met Wu Xiaoli and other classmates who had come to pay their condolences.
subevent.location: Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province - Church

name: Double 11 Kuaituantuan and livestream collaboration; insufficient stock led to apology and compensation; reflected on buyer restraint.
description: On November 10, Song Yajing and shop assistant Xiaomei conducted Double 11 stocking and previews: they sorted inventory, estimated sales, and posted livestream and group-buying notices in the community. On November 11, they ran a joint promotion with livestream and Kuaituantuan. Some popular styles went out of stock because of conservative stocking, leading to negative customer reviews. On November 12, Song Yajing publicly apologized in the community, promising that affected customers would get free shipping and a handwritten thank-you card next time. She then reflected and realized that as a buyer she needed to restrain impulse and forecast more accurately.

subevent.name: Stocking up and previews before the Double 11 event
subevent.description: According to the Double 11 Kuaituantuan-livestream joint plan, sort out inventory, estimate sales, and prepare the goods; also post the livestream preview and the Kuaituantuan group-buying notice in the community group.
subevent.location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen City.

subevent.name: Double 11 livestream and Kuaituantuan joint promotion.
subevent.description: Do live-stream product sales at the store, and also coordinate with Kuaituantuan to launch a group-buy at the same time, introducing clothing styles to customers and guiding them to place orders.
subevent.location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen City.

subevent.name: Discovered bestseller out of stock and negative customer reviews.
subevent.description: Because the stocking forecast was conservative, some popular styles sold out quickly, causing paid orders from customers to be undeliverable, and leading to a few negative reviews and complaints.
subevent.location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen City.

subevent.name: Public apology in the community group.
subevent.description: Publicly post an apology statement in the store's WeChat customer community, admit the insufficient stock, explain the reason, and ask customers for understanding.
subevent.location: No. 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen - home

subevent.name: Introduce a compensation plan.
subevent.description: For affected customers, she promised free shipping on their next purchase and would include a handwritten thank-you card with the package to show sincerity.
subevent.location: No. 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen - home

subevent.name: Reflection and journaling.
subevent.description: Song Yajing reflected on this experience in her personal notes, realizing that as a buyer she needed to restrain impulsiveness and make accurate estimates, turning the lesson into an opportunity to improve future service.
subevent.location: No. 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen - home

name: The community group held a bachelorette party for Vivian, and the emotional fees were donated to disabled children.
description: From October 18 to 20, the community planned and held a warm bachelorette party for Vivian, who was about to marry and move to Shanghai. On October 18, Song Yajing and core members discussed online and finalized the plan. On the 19th, Song Yajing purchased supplies and picked up the custom necklace engraved with 'Y.J'. On the 20th, the party was held at a themed café, including an emotional paid segment where each participant paid a small fee; all profits were donated to a community center for disabled children. At the party, Vivian was moved to tears. Song Yajing gave her the necklace, hugged her, and said, 'Yajing's home will always be your home,' blending business with charity and sisterhood, deepening the emotional bonds of the community.

subevent.name: Plan a bachelor party
subevent.description: Song Yajing and core community members (Li Meiling and others) discussed via WeChat group and determined the party theme, time, location, fundraising, and donation targets, and notified Vivian and all community members.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Siming District - Song Yajing's home

subevent.name: Preparing party supplies and gifts
subevent.description: Song Yajing purchased party decorations, desserts, drinks, and party favors, and went to the custom jewelry store to pick up a silver necklace engraved with the letters 'Y.J' as a farewell gift for Vivian.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Siming District - Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

subevent.name: Hold a bachelorette party.
subevent.description: Community members held a bachelorette party for Vivian at the reserved venue, including interactive games, memory sharing, and an emotional fee-charging segment (each participant paid a small fee). Song Yajing gave Vivian an engraved necklace and hugged her, saying, "Yajing's place will always be your family home."
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Siming District - themed coffee shop near Tianhong Mall

name: Won the first prize, an electric oven, in the supermarket shopping draw.
description: On Sunday, November 23, Song Yajing went to the supermarket to buy baking ingredients and used her membership points to enter a lucky draw. To her surprise, she won first prize — a branded electric oven worth about 600 yuan. That evening, she couldn't wait to use the new oven to bake a tray of egg tarts, which were snatched up by the family. This unexpected joy lifted the gloom caused by her mother's recent illness and her own health troubles.

subevent.name: Go to the supermarket to shop
subevent.description: Because of her interest in baking, Song Yajing decided to go to a supermarket near her home to buy baking ingredients (such as flour, butter, sugar, etc.), preparing for making desserts later.
subevent.location: A supermarket in Siming District, Xiamen.

subevent.name: Used membership points to enter the lucky draw and won first prize.
subevent.description: While checking out at the supermarket, Song Yajing used her membership points to join the supermarket's lucky draw and unexpectedly won the first prize—a branded electric oven worth about 600 yuan. She was very surprised and delighted on the spot.
subevent.location: Supermarket prize draw counter in Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Use the new oven to bake egg tarts
subevent.description: After returning home, Song Yajing couldn't wait to unbox the new oven, and using the ingredients she had just bought, she baked egg tarts for the first time. A tray of golden, crispy egg tarts came out successfully and was quickly devoured by her husband Chen Zhiqiang and daughter Chen Lexuan.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Siming District - home kitchen

name: Go shopping and watch a movie with my best friend, enjoying weekend leisure time.
description: On Saturday afternoon, November 16, Song Yajing invited her best friend Li Meiling to go shopping at SM City Plaza in Xiamen. The two visited several women's clothing stores, chatting about their recent life and work. Song Yajing bought a scarf for herself and a small skirt for her daughter Xuanxuan. Afterwards, they watched a healing movie, Warm Hug, together, laughing and crying in the cinema and releasing the stress of the past few days. In the evening, they had a simple meal at the mall, and Li Meiling shared amusing stories from her pregnancy, creating a relaxed and pleasant atmosphere. This short best-friend outing made her feel relaxed in mind and body and restored her sense of life's comfort.

subevent.name: Made plans with her best friend to go shopping on the weekend
subevent.description: Song Yajing confirmed the time, location, and specific arrangements for meeting her best friend Li Meiling that afternoon at SM City Plaza via WeChat.
subevent.location: Xiamen - Siming District - Home

subevent.name: Set off for SM City Plaza.
subevent.description: Song Yajing set off from home and took transportation to SM City Plaza in Xiamen to meet up with her best friend.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Siming District - on the way from home to SM City Plaza

subevent.name: Met up with her best friend at the mall and started shopping
subevent.description: Song Yajing and Li Meiling met at the agreed spot in SM City Plaza. They chatted while browsing several women's clothing stores and shared updates on their lives.
subevent.location: Xiamen - Siming District - SM City Plaza

subevent.name: Shopping for family and herself.
subevent.description: While shopping in the women's clothing store, Song Yajing picked out a scarf for herself and bought a little dress for her daughter Chen Lexuan.
subevent.location: Xiamen - Siming District - SM City Plaza - Women's Clothing Store

subevent.name: Watch the healing movie 'Warm Hug'
subevent.description: Song Yajing and Li Meiling watched the movie Warm Hug together at the cinema, releasing their stress amid laughter and emotion.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Siming District - SM City Plaza - Cinema

subevent.name: Having dinner together at the mall and chatting
subevent.description: After the movie, Song Yajing and Li Meiling had a light meal in the mall. Li Meiling shared funny stories from her pregnancy, and the atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Siming District - SM City Plaza - Restaurant

subevent.name: Said goodbye and went home separately.
subevent.description: After dinner, Song Yajing and Li Meiling said goodbye at the entrance of the mall and each went home, ending their pleasant weekend leisure time.
subevent.location: Xiamen - Siming District - SM City Plaza

name: Called father on the return trip and realized how precious family love is.
description: On the way back, Song Yajing pulled into a service area and called her father, who was far away in her hometown in Quanzhou. Hearing her father's voice, made clear by the hearing aid, say, "Hello? What's wrong?" she suddenly choked up. She urged him to take care of his health and have regular checkups, and offered to bring Xuanxuan back for an extra week during the 2026 Spring Festival. Her father laughed and agreed, telling her not to worry. After hanging up, she sat quietly in front of the steering wheel for a moment and wrote in her diary, "While parents are alive, life still has a place to return to." This event strengthened her commitment to calling or visiting her parents every month. Then she composed herself, put away her diary, started the car, left the service area, and continued along the highway back to her home in Xiamen.

subevent.name: She decided to stop at the service area.
subevent.description: On the highway back, Song Yajing thought about calling her father and decided to pull into the nearest service area to park and make the call safely.
subevent.location: Fujian Province - Shenhai Expressway.

subevent.name: Parked the car and called her father.
subevent.description: Song Yajing parked the car steadily in a service area parking space, took out her phone and dialed her father Song Minghui's number, and became emotional when she heard his clear voice.
subevent.location: Fujian Province - A service area on the Shenhai Expressway - Parking space

subevent.name: Called father to remind him to take care of his health.
subevent.description: On the phone, Song Yajing urged her father to take care of his health and have regular checkups, and she proactively suggested bringing Xuanxuan along to Quanzhou to stay for a week during the 2026 Spring Festival. Her father agreed with a smile.
subevent.location: Fujian Province - a service area on the Shenhai Expressway - inside the car.

subevent.name: Wrote a journal reflection after hanging up the phone
subevent.description: After hanging up, Song Yajing sat quietly in front of the steering wheel for a moment, took out her portable journal, and wrote "As long as parents are alive, life still has a place of origin," recorded how moved she was by the call, and reaffirmed her commitment to going home or calling every month.
subevent.location: Fujian Province - a service area on the Shenhai Expressway - inside the car.

subevent.name: Setting off again to continue the return trip
subevent.description: Song Yajing pulled herself together, put away her diary, started the car, left the service area, and continued on the expressway back to her home in Xiamen.
subevent.location: Fujian Province - Shenhai Expressway.

name: Reward yourself with a Coach tote bag to affirm a year of hard work.
description: On December 28, after the year-end inventory check, Song Yajing rewarded herself with a Coach tote bag using part of the profits from the co-branded collection. It was the most expensive item she had bought since starting her business. She took her daughter Xuanxuan to SM Shopping Mall to pick it out, letting her daughter help choose the color. When she put on the new bag, she said to herself, 'You deserve it.' This purchase marked an affirmation of her hard work over the past year and symbolized that she was beginning to learn how to reward herself.

subevent.name: After the year-end inventory check, decide to reward herself.
subevent.description: After completing the store's year-end inventory audit on December 28, 2025, Song Yajing saw that the co-branded products were profitable, and decided to use part of the funds to reward herself with a Coach tote bag as recognition for her year of hard work.

subevent.description: Song Yajing and her daughter returned home, showed her husband Chen Zhiqiang the newly bought Coach tote bag, shared interesting stories from the purchase, and expressed satisfaction with her year of hard work.

On October 6, the Mid-Autumn Festival, she had a reunion dinner with her husband, daughter, and her parents who had come from Quanzhou, showed the short film, shared interesting stories from the trip, and after dinner shared a travelogue and the homestay link in the parent-child community. On October 7, she went to the photo studio to pick up the developed family portrait photos and arranged the shop's photo wall.

subevent.location: Xiamen City - Home

During the meal, they played the edited travel video and shared amusing stories from the trip.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Home

subevent.name: Sharing travelogues and homestay links in the community

name: Filmed a co-branded outfit video and received over 1,000 likes on Xiaohongshu.
description: On November 19, Song Yajing shot five outfit showcase videos in her boutique clothing store in Siming District, Xiamen, for the upcoming co-branded new Chinese-style women's wear, and edited and published them on Xiaohongshu. The videos received over a thousand likes, and many local users asked for the address; she replied to each one and directed them to the store. After reviewing the data afterward, she realized the potential of short videos for driving traffic and planned to update regularly.

subevent.description: In the store, prepared 5 sets of co-branded new Chinese-style women's clothing samples, adjusted the store lighting and background, and set up a phone stand as advance preparation for shooting outfit videos.

subevent.name: Shoot 5 outfit videos.
subevent.description: Using her phone, she filmed outfit showcase videos of 5 co-branded new Chinese-style women's outfits one after another. Before each outfit, she introduced the design highlights and suitable scenarios, and appeared in front of the camera herself to demonstrate.
subevent.location: Inside the boutique clothing store in Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Edited and published a Xiaohongshu video
subevent.description: Use a mobile editing app to splice together the 5 video clips, add subtitles and background music, and after finishing, upload to her Xiaohongshu personal account, along with the store's location and call-to-action copy.
subevent.location: Inside the boutique clothing store in Siming District, Xiamen

name: Failed at making French mille-feuille and launched a "Baking Fail Contest" in the group.
description: On December 2, Song Yajing contacted Master Chen via WeChat to book the next day's French mille-feuille class at his studio. On December 3, she went to Master Chen's studio to take on the challenge. Because the butter temperature was off, the pastry leaked oil and collapsed, and the finished product came out crooked. She laughed, took a photo of the failed result, wrote a caption, and sent it to her friends' group chat. The group responded enthusiastically, posting their own baking fail photos one after another, spontaneously forming a "Baking Fail Contest." The number of interactions hit a new monthly high. Because of this, she decided to continue studying French pastry next year, but to enjoy the process without setting any goals.

subevent.name: Book Master Chen's baking class
subevent.description: Song Yajing contacted Master Chen via WeChat to schedule a time to go to his studio on December 3 to learn how to make French puff pastry, and confirmed the list of required ingredients.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Home

subevent.description: In the morning, Song Yajing left home and took a bus or drove to Master Chen's Bakery Workshop in Huli District, Xiamen.

subevent.name: Challenge of making French puff pastry
subevent.description: The operation was carried out under Master Chen’s guidance, but due to a mistake in controlling the butter temperature, the puff pastry leaked oil and collapsed in the oven. The finished product was misshapen and deformed; both attempts failed.
subevent.location: Xiamen – Master Chen's Baking Workshop

subevent.name: Photographed the failed creations and started a group rant.

Song Yajing replied to each one and encouraged everyone, enjoying the fun the failures brought.

On November 9, she followed up on logistics, confirmed the shipment, and obtained the tracking number. After the goods arrived on November 11, she checked and accepted them with shop assistant Xiaomei at the store and entered them into the inventory system, preparing for Double 11 sales.

name: Consulted the bank account manager about a family health insurance plan.
description: On the afternoon of December 16, Song Yajing used the store's break time to schedule an online consultation via WeChat with ICBC account manager Lin Xiaofeng, in preparation for increasing the family health insurance budget for next year. Taking into account her family's actual situation (lumbar spine problems, her mother's history of cerebral infarction, and a young daughter), Manager Lin recommended a combination of critical illness insurance and accident insurance covering family members. Song Yajing carefully asked about premiums, coverage, and the claims process, and sent the materials to her husband Chen Zhiqiang for their joint review. In the end, she decided to wait until after her husband's birthday and then have a detailed in-person discussion and complete the policy purchase during the New Year's Day holiday. This action marked a new stage in her emphasis on family risk management.

subevent.name: Schedule an insurance consultation
subevent.description: Song Yajing used her store break time to book an online insurance consultation for that afternoon via WeChat with bank account manager Lin Xiaofeng.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Siming District - Shop No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street (own store)

subevent.name: Online insurance plan consultation.
subevent.description: Song Yajing communicated online with Lin Xiaofeng on WeChat at the scheduled time. Manager Lin recommended a combination of critical illness insurance and accident insurance based on her family situation. She asked in detail about premiums, coverage, and the claims process.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Siming District - Shop No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street (own store)

subevent.location: Xiamen City - Siming District - 128 Hubin South Road (home)

name: The whole family decorated for Christmas together.
description: On Saturday afternoon, December 20, Song Yajing and her husband Chen Zhiqiang took their daughter Xuanxuan and brought out the Christmas tree, colored lights, and ornaments purchased in previous years from the storage room. The family of three divided the work: the husband was responsible for assembling the trunk and wrapping the colored lights, the daughter hung the little stars and baubles, and Song Yajing adjusted the spacing and took photos. The whole living room gradually filled with festive atmosphere, and Xuanxuan excitedly spun around under the tree. Song Yajing specially had her daughter's award-winning painting from a competition framed and hung it next to the Christmas tree, symbolizing that it was the best Christmas decoration. After decorating, the whole family stood in front of the tree for a group photo, which Song Yajing sent to her family group and close friends group, receiving likes and wishes. That night, she felt that home became warmer because of their shared efforts.

subevent.name: Assembling the Christmas tree and wrapping it with colored lights
subevent.description: Chen Zhiqiang was in charge of assembling the trunk and branches of the Christmas tree, and Song Yajing helped secure them. When finished, Chen Zhiqiang wrapped the string lights evenly around the tree and checked whether the lights were working properly.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - living room at home

subevent.name: Hung Christmas ornaments and the children's artwork
subevent.description: Chen Lexuan hung small ornaments such as stars and colorful balls on the Christmas tree, while Song Yajing adjusted the spacing beside her and hung her daughter's award-winning painting, framed, next to the Christmas tree.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - living room at home

subevent.name: Taking a family photo and sharing the holiday joy
subevent.description: After the decoration was completed, the family of three took a group photo in front of the Christmas tree. Song Yajing sent the photo to the family group and the close friends group and received likes and blessings from relatives and friends.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - living room at home

name: Thanksgiving thank-you gift packs boosted store foot traffic
description: On November 25, Song Yajing purchased small Thanksgiving gift bags and handwrote thank-you cards. On the morning of Thanksgiving Day, November 27, she posted the thank-you list in her community group and notified customers to pick up the gifts at the store. Afterward, she and her clerk Xiaomei handed out gift bags to customers in the store and mailed gift bags to out-of-town customers. After receiving them, customers spontaneously took photos and posted them on Moments, praising the thoughtfulness of the handwritten cards. One retired teacher wrote, "There are many shop owners, but very few who write cards by hand." Store foot traffic that day increased by 30% compared with normal days, and many new customers came to visit the store because of Moments posts. The natural conversion effect far exceeded expectations.

subevent.name: Purchasing items for the Thanksgiving gift packages
subevent.description: Song Yajing went to Zhongshan Road wholesale market or shopped online to buy small Thanksgiving gift bags for customers, containing customized small gifts and store coupons.

subevent.name: Writing a church visit reflection, "No Longer Demanding Love, but Learning to Give."

name: Her mother suffered a sudden stroke and was hospitalized. After returning to Xiamen, she made a recipe booklet and sold it to donate the proceeds to an elderly foundation.
description: On November 1, her mother Lin Xiuying suffered a mild stroke and was hospitalized. Song Yajing rushed back from Xiamen to Quanzhou that night, wiping away tears helplessly outside the ward. Her sister Song Yawen coordinated specialists remotely, and her husband Chen Zhiqiang immediately took leave from work to drive her there and take care of their daughter Xuanxuan. Her mother received timely treatment and recovered well. From November 2 to 3, Song Yajing combed her mother’s hair by the bed, recalling how her mother had taken care of her grandmother when she was young. On November 4, her mother’s condition stabilized, and she returned to Xiamen. After returning, she scanned and printed her mother’s hand-written baking recipes from 20 years ago into a booklet, sold it at the store on November 14, and donated all the proceeds to a foundation for the elderly. The tagline was “Mother’s recipes, the sweetness of time,” expressing her gratitude to her mother and her desire to carry it forward through action.

subevent.name: Rushed back to Quanzhou urgently
subevent.description: On the morning of November 1, Song Yajing learned that her mother had been hospitalized after a sudden cerebral infarction. She and her husband Chen Zhiqiang immediately drove from Xiamen back to Quanzhou, and called her elder sister Song Yawen to coordinate with specialists remotely.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street to Quanzhou City - Licheng District Hospital

subevent.name: First day accompanying mother at the hospital
subevent.description: Arrived at the hospital that evening. Her mother was undergoing emergency treatment. Song Yajing waited anxiously outside the ward, then went in to accompany her.
subevent.location: Quanzhou City - Licheng District Hospital

subevent.name: Combing hair by the hospital bed, remembering the past
subevent.description: On November 2, her mother's condition improved. Song Yajing combed her mother's hair by the hospital bed. Her mother recalled how she had taken care of Grandma in her youth, and mother and daughter had a heartfelt exchange.
subevent.location: Quanzhou City - Licheng District Hospital

subevent.name: Continue accompanying and caring for mother
subevent.description: On November 3, her mother was recovering well. Song Yajing stayed in the hospital ward all day, helping her mother get up, eat, and so on.

subevent.location: Xiamen - Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

Her daughter Xuanxuan sometimes accompanied her on a scooter, making it a little morning ritual for mother and daughter.

name: On the eve of Thanksgiving, planned and completed the preparation and distribution of member thank-you gift packages.
description: From November 23 to 27, 2025, Song Yajing reflected on the importance of community maintenance after learning from the lesson of insufficient Singles' Day stock. Taking Thanksgiving as an opportunity, she decided to write thank-you cards by hand and give baking gift packages to the 50 members with the most frequent interactions during the year. On the 23rd, she made the list at the store, designed the cards, and prepared materials. On the evening of the 24th, she baked low-sugar nut and oat crunch in the home kitchen and packed them into portions. On the 25th, she handwrote personalized thank-you cards at the store. On the 26th, she invited shop assistant Xiaomei and fellow church member Zhao Li to the store, where they decorated the cards with dried flower stickers and simple line drawings, sealed the gift packages together, and shared their personal growth. On the 27th, she sent out the gift packages by courier or notified members to pick them up at the store, with blessings attached, to strengthen member loyalty.

subevent.name: Reflecting on and planning the Thanksgiving event.
subevent.description: In the shop, Song Yajing reflected on the lesson of insufficient stock for Double 11 and decided to use Thanksgiving as an opportunity to maintain member relationships. She planned to handwrite thank-you cards to the 50 members with the most frequent annual interaction and give them baked gift packs, making a list of members, designing the thank-you card style, and listing the required materials.
subevent.location: Boutique clothing store at No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Hand-baked low-sugar nut and oat crunch
subevent.description: Song Yajing used her evening time to bake 50 portions of low-sugar nut oat crisp in her home kitchen following a recipe, individually packaging each portion as gifts included in the gift packs.
subevent.location: Home kitchen at No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Handwrite 50 thank-you cards.
subevent.description: Song Yajing, either at the shop or at home, handwrote personalized thank-you cards one by one to the 50 members who interacted most frequently during the year, based on the membership list, expressing gratitude for their support and trust.
subevent.location: Boutique clothing store at No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Decorative cards and sealed gift packs.

Zhao Li stuck dried-flower stickers on each thank-you card and drew simple line-art floral motifs. The three of them packed the baked oat crisps and thank-you cards into custom gift bags together, chatting about their growth over the past year while packing, in a warm atmosphere.

subevent.name: Distribute Thanksgiving member gift bags
subevent.description: Song Yajing shipped the 50 packaged Thanksgiving gift bags by courier or notified members to pick them up in store, with warm holiday wishes attached, to strengthen member loyalty and brand affinity.
subevent.location: Boutique clothing store at No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen

name: Held an Imperfect Works Exhibition at Christmas and donated the proceeds to stray animals.
description: On Christmas Day, December 25, Song Yajing did not organize a big sale, but instead set up an “Exhibition of Imperfect Works” in the store. The exhibits included a crooked ceramic cup she had fired, photos of burnt cakes, dresses remade from Kuaituantuan returns, and scraps of paper from her daughter Xuanxuan's calligraphy practice. The exhibition unexpectedly struck a chord with passersby, and the message board was covered with sticky notes. The most touching one read: “So no one is perfect.” The 500 yuan earned from the event that day was all used to buy cat food and donated to a stray animal rescue station. Zhao Li asked about her curatorial inspiration, and she replied: “Because this year I really haven't done anything perfect.”

subevent.name: Preparing exhibition items.
subevent.description: At home, Song Yajing selected and organized the items needed for the exhibition: a lopsided ceramic cup, a photo of a burnt cake, an altered dress, her daughter's used calligraphy practice paper, and more, and made display labels.
subevent.location: No. 128, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen (home).

subevent.name: Setting up the store display area
subevent.description: On Christmas morning, Song Yajing and store assistant Xiao Mei set up the display table, message board, and decorations for the "Imperfect Works Exhibition" in the clothing store, arranged the exhibits, and attached descriptions.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District (boutique clothing store)

subevent.name: Exhibition opening and customer interaction.
subevent.description: The exhibition officially opened to the public free of charge. Song Yajing received customers in the store, guided them to view the exhibits, stick up message notes, and recorded the most poignant message: 'So it turns out everyone is imperfect.' The event resonated with passersby.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District (boutique clothing store)

subevent.location: Xiamen City - Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District (boutique clothing store)

subevent.name: Use the earnings to buy cat food and donate it.
subevent.description: Song Yajing went to a nearby pet supply store, spent 500 yuan on cat food, then delivered the cat food to the stray animal rescue station in Siming District, Xiamen, completing the donation.
subevent.location: Siming District Stray Animal Rescue Station, Xiamen

name: Watched the movie 'Good Things' alone to relax and unwind.
description: On the evening of December 20, Song Yajing, who rarely had no family or shop matters to attend to, went alone to the MixC Cinema in Xiamen to watch a highly acclaimed domestic comedy film, Her Story. She bought a large popcorn and a cola, sat in a back corner seat, and completely emptied her mind. The film was light and funny, making her laugh heartily and temporarily forget the year-end stocktaking and performance pressure. After the film, she wandered around the mall for half an hour and spotted a discounted cashmere cardigan, but remembered that she had just rewarded herself with a handbag, so she restrained the urge to buy. She posted on WeChat Moments: At least once a month, give myself some cinema time—this is my own ritual.

subevent.name: Decided to watch a movie and buy tickets online
subevent.description: In the afternoon, during a free moment, Song Yajing checked movie showtimes on her phone app and bought tickets for that evening's showing of Good Things at Wanxiang Cinema, confirming seats in the back corner.
subevent.location: Xiamen - Home/Store

subevent.name: Go to Vientiane Cinema
subevent.description: In the evening, Song Yajing went to Xiamen Wanxiang Cinema alone by bus or taxi, ready to watch a movie.
subevent.location: Xiamen - Wanxiang Cinema

subevent.name: Watched the movie Her Story and bought snacks
subevent.description: Song Yajing bought a large popcorn and a cola at the cinema, sat in a back corner of the screening hall, and immersed herself in the Chinese comedy film Good Things, laughing heartily and relaxing.
subevent.location: Xiamen - MixC Cinema screening hall

subevent.name: After the event ended, she strolled around the mall.
subevent.description: After the movie ended, Song Yajing wandered around MixC mall for half an hour. She liked a discounted cashmere cardigan but resisted the urge to buy and made no purchase.
subevent.location: Xiamen - MixC Mall

subevent.name: Post to Moments to record the sense of ritual.
subevent.description: On her way home or after arriving home, Song Yajing edited and posted a WeChat Moments update, writing: "Give yourself at least one cinema moment a month—this is a ritual uniquely mine." She paired it with a movie ticket stub or a night-view photo of the mall.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Home

subevent.name: Return home and rest
subevent.description: Song Yajing returned from MixC to her home in Siming District, Xiamen, washed up, and rested, ending her personal relaxation activities for the evening.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Home

name: Develop and execute a spring clothing replenishment plan
description: From December 5 to 9, to optimize the store's spring clothing inventory, Song Yajing first analyzed sales data, then compiled a replenishment needs list. On December 8, she communicated with supplier Susan to confirm styles, order quantities, and fabric improvement plans, then updated the purchasing plan and informed staff member Xiaomei of the restocking arrangements, focusing on raising the proportion of plus-size women's clothing to 20%.

subevent.name: Analyze the store's spring clothing inventory and sales data
subevent.description: Song Yajing checked this season's spring clothing sales report in the store's back office, calculated the sales volume and inventory of each style, and focused on analyzing the sales proportion and customer feedback of plus-size women's clothing, providing data support for restocking.
subevent.location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District - Boutique Clothing Store

subevent.description: Song Yajing determined the specific styles, size distribution, and order quantity for the next batch of spring clothing based on sales data, prominently marked the need to raise the proportion of plus-size women's clothing to 20%, listed key points for improving fabric quality, and formed a written communication checklist.

subevent.description: Song Yajing contacted supplier Su Shan in Guangzhou via WeChat and sent a list of restocking needs. subevent.name: Organizing meeting minutes and updating the procurement plan
subevent.description: After the communication ended, Song Yajing organized the confirmed styles, order quantities, plus-size ratio, and fabric requirements into written minutes, updated the store's purchase plan, and entered the order information into the system.

subevent.description: Song Yajing informed shop assistant Xiaomei of the arrival time and style features of the new batch of spring clothing, arranged the display adjustment plan, and reminded her to focus on the recommended sales talk for plus-size women's clothing.
subevent.location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District - Boutique Clothing Store

name: The whole family prepared for and participated in Christmas Eve activities, giving gingerbread men to the homeless.
description: On December 21, Song Yajing went to the supermarket to buy baking supplies. On the afternoon of the 24th, the whole family baked gingerbread men together. That evening, the family of three attended Midnight Mass at Siming Catholic Church in Xiamen. After Mass, they went to a homeless care center, where her daughter Xuanxuan handed out more than thirty bags of gingerbread men, sharing warmth.

subevent.name: Buying baking ingredients for gingerbread men
subevent.description: In the morning, Song Yajing went to the supermarket to buy butter, flour, ginger powder, brown sugar, icing sugar, and other ingredients for baking gingerbread men, preparing for the whole family to bake together in the afternoon.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Siming District supermarket

subevent.name: The whole family baked gingerbread men together
subevent.description: In the afternoon, Song Yajing, Chen Zhiqiang, and their daughter Xuanxuan baked gingerbread men together in the home kitchen. Xuanxuan pressed out the shapes with a mold; although they were a bit lopsided, they were full of childlike charm.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Siming District - home kitchen

subevent.name: Attend the Christmas Eve midnight Mass.
subevent.description: Song Yajing went with her husband and daughter to Siming Catholic Church in Xiamen for the Christmas Eve Midnight Mass. They listened to Father Wang's sermon, and she was deeply moved.
subevent.location: Xiamen – Siming Catholic Church

subevent.name: Giving gingerbread men to the homeless care center
subevent.description: After Mass, Song Yajing and her family packed the gingerbread men baked that afternoon into more than thirty small bags and went to the homeless care center, where her daughter Xuanxuan personally handed them to the overnight guests, sharing the warmth of giving.
subevent.location: Xiamen - Homeless Care Center

name: The whole family worked together to bake and share Christmas gingerbread men.
description: On the afternoon of December 21, Song Yajing went to the supermarket to buy gingerbread man ingredients. That evening, the whole family made them together in the kitchen: her husband mixed the batter, her daughter cut out various shapes, and Song Yajing was in charge of baking. Flour got on the tips of their noses, and laughter never stopped. After the crooked gingerbread men came out of the oven, Song Yajing took photos and shared them on WeChat Moments with the caption, 'Perfect or imperfect, they are all shapes of love.' On Christmas Eve, December 24, the family packed the gingerbread men into gift bags, went to gathering places for homeless people, and handed them out to spread holiday warmth.

subevent.name: Buy ingredients for making gingerbread men
subevent.description: In the afternoon, Song Yajing went to a nearby supermarket to buy ingredients needed to make gingerbread people, such as cake flour, butter, brown sugar, ginger powder, honey, and eggs, to prepare for the evening's family baking activity.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Siming District supermarket

subevent.name: Daughter Chen Lexuan pressed molds to make gingerbread man shapes.
subevent.description: Chen Lexuan used Christmas tree, star, and angel-shaped cookie cutters to press shapes out of the chilled dough and neatly placed them on a baking sheet. During the process, flour got on the tip of her nose, and laughter never stopped.
subevent.location: Xiamen - home kitchen

subevent.name: Took photos and shared the finished gingerbread men.
subevent.description: Song Yajing took photos of the baked, lopsided gingerbread men with her phone and posted them to the family WeChat group and her WeChat Moments, captioning them Perfect or not, they are all shapes of love, and received likes and comments from relatives and friends.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - living room at home

subevent.name: Distributing gingerbread men to homeless people on Christmas Eve.
subevent.description: On Christmas Eve, Song Yajing and her family packed homemade gingerbread men into gift bags and went to a gathering spot for homeless people in downtown Xiamen, handing out these love-filled gifts to homeless people on the streets to spread the warmth of the holiday.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - gathering place for homeless people

name: Started twice-weekly core rehabilitation training.
description: On December 4, Song Yajing booked a personal trainer at the community gym and completed an initial fitness assessment. After discussing her old lumbar spine problem and weight-gain goal with the coach, she worked out a core rehabilitation training plan. Starting December 9, she did one hour of core muscle training every Tuesday and Thursday morning, including bridges, bird-dog, planks, and similar exercises. After two weeks of training, she had a mid-term assessment on December 19 and felt her lower back support was stronger and her posture was more upright when walking. Her daughter Xuanxuan sometimes went along and imitated the moves on the mat next to her, becoming her "little supervisor." Training continued steadily, and she completed the last session of the month on December 30.

subevent.name: Booking a personal trainer and taking the initial fitness assessment
subevent.description: At the community gym, she booked a personal trainer, had her first physical fitness test, and discussed her old lumbar spine condition and weight-gain goals with the trainer, working out a core rehabilitation training plan.
subevent.location: Siming District, Xiamen - Community Gym

subevent.name: First core rehabilitation training.
subevent.description: Did the first core muscle rehabilitation training at the community gym, completing exercises like bridges, bird dogs, and planks. My daughter Xuanxuan came along and imitated the movements from the side.

subevent.name: Second core rehabilitation training session
subevent.description: Completed the second core rehabilitation training session, repeating exercises such as glute bridges and bird-dogs, gradually adapting to the training intensity.
subevent.location: Siming District, Xiamen - Community Gym

subevent.name: Third core rehabilitation training session
subevent.description: Third core training session. Tried increasing the duration of the plank and felt the support in the lower back gradually strengthen.
subevent.location: Siming District, Xiamen - Community Gym

subevent.name: Fourth core rehabilitation training session
subevent.description: Fourth training session, reinforcing balance in the bird-dog pose, with more standard form.

subevent.description: After two weeks of training, self-assessment shows that her waist support strength has significantly increased and her posture is more upright while walking. She records progress and communicates with the trainer.

subevent.description: Fifth workout, continuing to consolidate core strength and increase movement stability.

name: Video-called her parents in Quanzhou to share recent news and discuss visiting them for New Year's Day.
description: On Sunday evening, December 13, after her daughter Xuanxuan had fallen asleep, Song Yajing and her husband Chen Zhiqiang had a WeChat video call in the living room of their home in Xiamen with her parents Song Minghui and Lin Xiuying, who lived in Quanzhou. She described in detail the fun stories about her daughter winning an award in a painting competition and her husband's birthday celebration. Her mother, Lin Xiuying, laughed heartily on the other end of the video, while her father, Song Minghui, reminded her to keep her lower back warm. Song Yajing also asked about her parents' health and was relieved to learn that her mother's blood pressure was stable and her father insisted on doing tai chi every day. At the end of the video call, Song Yajing had her husband say hello to her parents, and they agreed to visit Quanzhou after New Year's Day. The call lasted forty minutes. After the call, Song Yajing and her husband discussed the specific arrangements for visiting Quanzhou after New Year's Day, tentatively set the travel schedule, and entered it into the family calendar.

subevent.name: Video call with parents in Quanzhou.
subevent.description: Song Yajing and her husband had a WeChat video call with her parents in Quanzhou. They shared that their daughter had won an award in a painting competition and told funny stories from her husband's birthday, and they asked about her parents' health. The call lasted about 40 minutes.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - living room at home

subevent.name: Agreed to go back to Quanzhou to visit for New Year's Day
subevent.description: After the call ended, Song Yajing and her husband discussed the specific arrangements for visiting her parents in Quanzhou after New Year's Day. They initially set the travel dates and entered them into the family calendar.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - living room at home

name: Prepare and host a regular customer appreciation dinner.
description: From November 28 to December 12, 2025, Song Yajing carefully prepared and successfully held a thank-you dinner for regular customers. On November 28, she selected the 20 regular customers with the highest annual spending at the store, finalized the list, and calculated the budget. The next day, she went to a nearby Minnan cuisine restaurant to book a private event, discussing the menu and decoration needs. On December 5, she purchased baking ingredients and gift packaging. On December 11, she baked low-sugar cookies by hand and packed them into gift boxes. At noon on December 12, she decorated the restaurant with clerk Xiao Mei and friend Zhao Li, arranging flowers, table cards, and gifts. The dinner was held from 18:00 to 20:30 that evening, with welcome speeches and cookie gifts. Vivian, a regular customer, came specially from Shanghai. The atmosphere was warm, and the emotional bond within the community was further deepened.

subevent.name: Finalize the dinner guest list and budget
subevent.description: Song Yajing selected the 20 regular customers with the highest spending based on the store's annual sales data, confirmed the invitation list, and calculated the dinner budget (including restaurant buyout, ingredients, party favors, and other costs).
subevent.location: Xiamen City, Siming District - Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street (inside the shop)

subevent.name: Reserved the whole Minnan cuisine restaurant
subevent.description: Song Yajing went to a Minnan cuisine restaurant near the shop, discussed the private booking time, menu, and venue decoration requirements with the store manager, paid a deposit, and completed the reservation.

subevent.name: Purchase baking ingredients and gift packaging
