subevent.location: Minnan cuisine restaurant, Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Hold a thank-you dinner for regular customers.
subevent.description: From 18:00 to 20:30, Song Yajing greeted guests at the restaurant entrance, thanking regular customers for their support over the past year. She joined the meal and gave a toast, presenting each guest with a gift of homemade low-sugar cookies. Vivian, a regular customer who had rushed back from Shanghai, was also present.
subevent.location: Minnan cuisine restaurant, Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen

name: Year-end inventory count and sales data analysis.
description: On December 30, 2025, Song Yajing and Xiaomei organized the inventory counting equipment, printed lists, and prepared labels during breaks in business. After closing, the two scanned and checked every item of stock one by one, moving styles that had been slow-selling for more than 6 months, severe broken-size one-offs, and some depreciated items to the clearance area. Then Song Yajing exported the full-year sales data from WeChat Mall and Kuaituantuan, and together with Xiaomei found that demand for plus-size women's clothing was far higher than expected, but purchases accounted for only 5%, while basic T-shirts had a high return rate due to insufficient quality. Based on this, Song Yajing set the procurement adjustment direction after the Spring Festival: increase the procurement share of plus-size women's clothing to 20%, and strictly screen suppliers for basic-style fabrics and patterns. Finally, the two organized the inventory results and action plan into an electronic document, flagging key suppliers to contact.

subevent.name: Pre-inventory preparations.
subevent.description: Song Yajing and Xiaomei, during a break in business that day, organized and inventoried the scanning equipment, printed the latest inventory list, and prepared category labels and sale-area marker stickers.
subevent.location: Boutique clothing store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Scan and count inventory item by item and categorize it
subevent.description: After closing, Song Yajing and Xiaomei scanned and checked all inventory item by item, and separately marked styles that had been slow-moving for more than 6 months, severely broken-size one-off pieces, and some depreciated items, and moved them into the clearance area.
subevent.location: Boutique clothing store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Export full-year sales data.
subevent.description: After completing the inventory count, Song Yajing used her computer to export the full-year 2025 sales data from both channels, WeChat Mall and Kuaituantuan, including sales by category, return records, and so on.
subevent.location: Boutique clothing store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Analyzing sales data to uncover key issues
subevent.description: Song Yajing and Xiaomei reviewed the exported data together and found that demand for plus-size women's clothing was far higher than expected, but procurement accounted for only 5%; basic T-shirts had a high return rate due to insufficient quality; other categories were relatively balanced.
subevent.location: Boutique clothing store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Formed a direction for purchasing adjustments
subevent.description: Based on the data analysis, Song Yajing set the direction for adjusting her purchasing plan after the Spring Festival: increase the proportion of plus-size women's clothing purchases from 5% to 20%, and strictly screen suppliers for the fabric and fit of basic T-shirts to reduce the return rate.
subevent.location: Boutique clothing store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Organizing inventory report and action plan
subevent.description: Song Yajing organized the inventory results (clearance item list) and purchasing adjustment directions into an electronic document, and flagged the suppliers that need to be contacted during the Spring Festival so that execution can be fast after the holiday.
subevent.location: Boutique clothing store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen

name: Co-branded New Chinese-style women's clothing sells well in store; the community announcement brings together collective signatures
description: After the contract signing in October, the first batch of new Chinese-style women's clothing co-developed with an independent designer from Hangzhou arrived at the store on November 20. Because of the elegant design and affordable price, local lifestyle bloggers spontaneously visited and shared it, and over 100 pieces were sold that day. In the community announcement, Song Yajing wrote: “This is Xiaomei's 10,000 yuan, Zhao Li's midnight flower branches, Zheng Kai's overnight pattern revisions, and the recipe inspiration from my mother—this piece of clothing embodies so many people.” She attributed the success to the joint contributions of the team and family, strengthening the community's emotional attachment and spirit of collaboration.

subevent.name: Communication and confirmation before the co-branded product arrives
subevent.description: Song Yajing had a video call with designer Zheng Kai to confirm the final fit and shipping logistics of the co-branded new Chinese-style women's clothing, ensuring that it would arrive at the store smoothly the next day.
subevent.location: Home, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Delivery acceptance and inspection
subevent.description: In the morning, the first batch of co-branded new Chinese-style women's clothing arrived at the store. Song Yajing and store clerk Xiaomei opened the boxes together to inspect and verify the styles, sizes, and quantities.
subevent.location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Put items on the shelf, arrange the display, and take photos as a preview
subevent.description: Song Yajing and Xiaomei styled and displayed the new Chinese-style women's clothing, adjusted the window display, and used their phones to take photos and short videos, posting arrival previews in the store's community group.
subevent.location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Local lifestyle blogger's store visit sharing
subevent.description: At noon, local lifestyle blogger 'Xiamen Store Explorer Xiao Chen' passed by the shop, was attracted by the new Chinese-style window display, came in to try on clothes and take photos, and posted about the store visit on social media, praising the elegant design and affordable prices.
subevent.location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Sales exceeded 100 items that day, hot seller
subevent.description: In the afternoon, thanks to blogger store-visit promotions and community warm-up, customers came in an endless stream. Song Yajing and Xiaomei worked together to receive them and make styling recommendations. Sales for the day exceeded 100 pieces, far exceeding expectations.
subevent.location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Post a thank-you announcement in the community group.
subevent.description: After closing, Song Yajing posted a thank-you message in the shop's community group, mentioning the contributions of Xiao Mei, Zhao Li, Zheng Kai, and her mother, attributing the success to collective teamwork, and stirring emotional resonance among the group members.
subevent.location: Home, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen

subevent.name: Community interaction and secondary sharing
subevent.description: The next day, community members liked and commented on the announcement. Zhao Li, Zheng Kai, and others who had been thanked also appeared to respond, and other members shared their own stories about clothing, strengthening the community's sense of belonging and cooperative spirit.
subevent.location: Home, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen

name: Old lumbar spine condition recurred; adjusted working hours; during recuperation returned to reading and journaling, and received heartwarming care from close friends.
description: On November 5, after days of running around and exhaustion, Song Yajing's old lumbar spine problem flared up. After her medical visit, the doctor advised her to reduce time spent standing. She decided to cut her weekly working hours from 56 to 40 and posted a part-time job listing. From November 6 to 7, she stayed home resting flat, started reading a novel, and used a diary app to record her daily 'three small blessings.' On the 6th, she wrote: '1. Xuanxuan brought me water when my back hurt; 2. My husband secretly bought a massage chair; 3. Zhao Li sent a photo from the flower room and said she had kept a bouquet for me.' On November 9, her close friend Wang Jia sent a complete set of lumbar protective gear from Shenzhen with the note: 'At 38, you have to admit defeat.' She took a photo and posted it on Moments: 'Admitting defeat is a philosophy.' Li Meiling, whose pregnancy made it hard for her to move around, also sent some pickled plums she had made herself. The care from her friends made her feel warm despite the pain.

subevent.name: Medical appointment and work adjustments
subevent.description: Due to days of rushing around and fatigue, her old lumbar problem flared up, so she went to the hospital. The doctor advised reducing standing time. Song Yajing decided to cut her weekly working hours from 56 to 40 and planned to hire a part-time shop assistant to rotate shifts.
subevent.location: Xiamen – Hospital

subevent.name: Post a part-time job listing
subevent.description: Song Yajing posted part-time shop assistant job openings on recruitment websites and in the local community, looking for candidates who can rotate shifts.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Home

subevent.name: First day of recuperation.
subevent.description: Song Yajing stayed home lying down to rest and recover, started reading her first novel, and used a diary app to record the day's "three little blessings," including Xuanxuan bringing her water, her husband buying a massage chair, and Zhao Li sending photos of the flower room.
subevent.location: Xiamen City - Home

subevent.name: Second day of recuperation
subevent.description: Continued to rest and recuperate at home, read most of the same novel, and kept using the diary app to record the day's small joys.

name: Celebrating her husband Chen Zhiqiang's 35th birthday.
description: December 10 is her husband Chen Zhiqiang's 35th birthday. The day before (December 9), Song Yajing ordered a bouquet of his favorite sunflowers in advance at the flower shop, bought low-sugar baking ingredients, and also called to reserve a table at a cozy Western restaurant in Xiamen. On the morning of his birthday, she picked up the bouquet and baked a low-sugar tiramisu cake herself. In the evening, the family of three had dinner at a cozy local Western restaurant in Xiamen. Daughter Xuanxuan gave him a birthday card she had drawn herself, and Song Yajing wrote on the card: "Thank you for always being my strongest support. For the rest of our lives, let's continue standing side by side." After dinner they went home, and the whole family blew out candles and shared the cake. Her husband was deeply moved.
